Here’s a minimal, low-conflict way to deploy `dex-stream-universal` with a smaller image:

### Recommendation
- Avoid port conflicts:
  - Option A (safest): Run only `dex-stream-universal` against your existing/external Kafka. Use a tiny compose overlay that defines just this service (no `depends_on`, no `ports`) and points `KAFKA_BROKER` at your external broker.
  - Option B: Keep local Kafka but remove port mappings and gate all port-exposed services (Kafka UI, Redis UI, Grafana, Prometheus, Adminer, Postgres, Redis, Zookeeper) behind profiles so they don’t start unless explicitly requested.

- Slim the image:
  - Update `crates/dex-stream-universal/Dockerfile` to produce a stripped binary and use a distroless nonroot runtime. Add a `.dockerignore` in the crate to reduce build context. Expected image size: ~25–40MB.
  - No host ports needed for `dex-stream-universal`; it only needs `KAFKA_BROKER`, `ENDPOINT`, `X_TOKEN`, `PROGRAM_IDS`, and an output `--topic`.

### Run example (Option A: external Kafka, zero ports)
- Set env for your external Kafka and Shyft:
```bash
export KAFKA_BROKER=host.docker.internal:29092
export ENDPOINT=YOUR_SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT
export X_TOKEN=YOUR_SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN
export PROGRAM_IDS="whirLbMiicVdio4qvUfM5KAg6Ct8VwpYzGff3uctyCc"
```
- Bring up only the universal streamer (no infra/UI):
```bash
docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.universal.yml up -d --build dex-stream-universal
```

```dockercompose
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-mev}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-mevpassword}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-mevdb}
      POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS: "--encoding=UTF-8 --lc-collate=C --lc-ctype=C"
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./migrations:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-mev} -d ${POSTGRES_DB:-mevdb}"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 10s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.25'

  adminer:
    image: adminer
    container_name: adminer
    ports:
      - "8082:8080"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--no-verbose", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:8080/"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
          cpus: '0.1'

  # =============================================================================
  # DEVELOPMENT SERVICES (Optional)
  # =============================================================================

  # Development service with hot reloading
  stream-orca-dev:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: stream-orca/Dockerfile.dev
    environment:
      - SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT=${SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT}
      - SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN=${SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN}
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-debug}
      - HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL=30
    volumes:
      - ../stream-orca:/app
      - cargo_cache:/usr/local/cargo/registry
      - target_cache:/app/target
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "pgrep", "-f", "cargo-watch"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 20s
    profiles:
      - dev
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'

  # =============================================================================
  # CACHE LAYERS (for faster rebuilds)
  # =============================================================================

  stream-orca-cache:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: stream-orca/Dockerfile
      target: builder
    image: arbitrage-stream-orca:cache
    profiles:
      - cache

  stream-raydium-cache:
    build:
      context: ../stream-raydium
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: builder
    image: arbitrage-stream-raydium:cache
    profiles:
      - cache

networks:
  mevana_net:
    driver: bridge
    name: mevana_net
    ipam:
      config:
        - subnet: 172.20.0.0/16
          gateway: 172.20.0.1

volumes:
  postgres_data:
    driver: local
  prometheus_data:
    driver: local
  grafana_data:
    driver: local
  cargo_cache:
    driver: local
  target_cache:
    driver: local
```

```bash
export SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN=YOUR_TOKEN

docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --build dex-stream-universal
```

Notes:
- No host ports are exposed by `dex-stream-universal`.
- You can override the output topic with the existing command flag in compose: `["--topic","orca-swaps"]` (adjust in compose if needed).
- If you later want to point it back to a local Kafka, just set `KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092` when running.

```dockercompose
    restart: unless-stopped

      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-mev} -d ${POSTGRES_DB:-mevdb}"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 10s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.25'

  adminer:
    image: adminer
    container_name: adminer
    ports:
      - "8082:8080"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--no-verbose", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:8080/"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
          cpus: '0.1'

  # =============================================================================
  # DEVELOPMENT SERVICES (Optional)
  # =============================================================================

  # Development service with hot reloading
  stream-orca-dev:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: stream-orca/Dockerfile.dev
    environment:
      - SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT=${SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT}
      - SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN=${SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN}
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-debug}
      - HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL=30
    volumes:
      - ../stream-orca:/app
      - cargo_cache:/usr/local/cargo/registry
      - target_cache:/app/target
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "pgrep", "-f", "cargo-watch"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 20s
    profiles:
      - dev
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'

  # =============================================================================
  # CACHE LAYERS (for faster rebuilds)
  # =============================================================================

  stream-orca-cache:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: stream-orca/Dockerfile
      target: builder
    image: arbitrage-stream-orca:cache
    profiles:
      - cache

  stream-raydium-cache:
    build:
      context: ../stream-raydium
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: builder
    image: arbitrage-stream-raydium:cache
    profiles:
      - cache

networks:
  mevana_net:
    driver: bridge
    name: mevana_net
    ipam:
      config:
        - subnet: 172.20.0.0/16
          gateway: 172.20.0.1

volumes:
  postgres_data:
    driver: local
  prometheus_data:
    driver: local
  grafana_data:
    driver: local
  cargo_cache:
    driver: local
  target_cache:
    driver: local

```

Done. I reattached `dex-stream-universal` to the internal Kafka:

- depends_on: `kafka` (waits for healthy)
- default `KAFKA_BROKER`: `kafka:9092`
- No ports exposed by `dex-stream-universal`

Validated compose syntax successfully.

Run options:
- Start `dex-stream-universal` (will also start `kafka`/`zookeeper` via depends_on):
```bash
export SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT=YOUR_ENDPOINT
export SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN=YOUR_TOKEN
# optionally: export PROGRAM_IDS="..."

docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --build dex-stream-universal
```
- If Kafka is already running in Docker and you don’t want compose to touch dependencies:
```bash
docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --no-deps dex-stream-universal
```

Note: If you hit port conflicts on 9092/29092 from another Kafka, stop the conflicting container or adjust ports on that stack.

- Updated `infra/docker/docker-compose.yml` to depend on internal `kafka` and set `KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092`.
- Verified compose config; provided run instructions to start only `dex-stream-universal`.

```shellscript

export SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN=YOUR_TOKEN
# optionally: export PROGRAM_IDS="..."

docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --build dex-stream-universal
```

---

**User**

thos services are already running inside docker. You need to determin the name of the docker network they are already running on and use the same network so they can communicate together.

---

**Cursor**

I'll inspect running containers to find the Kafka container's network and name, then update the compose service to attach to that network and remove depends_on to avoid conflicts.

I'll update the compose network to use the existing external network `mevana_net`, then validate the compose file.

```dockercompose
# =============================================================================
# SOLANA AI TRADING PLATFORM - ENHANCED DOCKER COMPOSE
# =============================================================================
# Enhanced version with improved connectivity, monitoring, and resource management

services:
  # =============================================================================
  # INFRASTRUCTURE SERVICES
  # =============================================================================
  
  zookeeper:
    image: confluentinc/cp-zookeeper:7.4.0
    container_name: zookeeper
    environment:
      ZOOKEEPER_CLIENT_PORT: 2181
      ZOOKEEPER_TICK_TIME: 2000
      ZOOKEEPER_MAX_CLIENT_CNXNS: 60
      ZOOKEEPER_SYNC_LIMIT: 2
      ZOOKEEPER_INIT_LIMIT: 5
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "bash", "-c", "echo stat | nc localhost 2181"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 10s
    ports:
      - "2181:2181"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'

  kafka:
    image: confluentinc/cp-kafka:7.4.0
    container_name: kafka
    depends_on:
      zookeeper:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      KAFKA_BROKER_ID: 1
      KAFKA_ZOOKEEPER_CONNECT: zookeeper:2181
      KAFKA_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://0.0.0.0:9092,PLAINTEXT_HOST://0.0.0.0:29092
      KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://kafka:9092,PLAINTEXT_HOST://host.docker.internal:29092
      KAFKA_LISTENER_SECURITY_PROTOCOL_MAP: PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,PLAINTEXT_HOST:PLAINTEXT
      KAFKA_INTER_BROKER_LISTENER_NAME: PLAINTEXT
      KAFKA_AUTO_CREATE_TOPICS_ENABLE: "true"
      KAFKA_OFFSETS_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
      KAFKA_HEAP_OPTS: "-Xmx1G -Xms1G"
      KAFKA_LOG_RETENTION_HOURS: 168
      KAFKA_LOG_SEGMENT_BYTES: 1073741824
      KAFKA_NUM_PARTITIONS: 3
      KAFKA_DEFAULT_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
      KAFKA_MIN_INSYNC_REPLICAS: 1
      KAFKA_DELETE_TOPIC_ENABLE: "true"
    ports:
      - "9092:9092"
      - "29092:29092"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "kafka-topics --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 --list"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2G
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '0.5'

  kafka-ui:
    image: provectuslabs/kafka-ui:latest
    container_name: kafka-ui
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    environment:
      KAFKA_CLUSTERS_0_NAME: local
      KAFKA_CLUSTERS_0_BOOTSTRAPSERVERS: kafka:9092
      KAFKA_CLUSTERS_0_READONLY: false
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--no-verbose", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:8080/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'

  dex-stream-universal:
    build:
      context: ../../crates/dex-stream-universal
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: dex-stream-universal:latest
    container_name: dex-stream-universal
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      - KAFKA_BROKER=${KAFKA_BROKER:-kafka:9092}
      - ENDPOINT=${SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT}
      - X_TOKEN=${SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN}
      - PROGRAM_IDS=${PROGRAM_IDS:-whirLbMiicVdio4qvUfM5KAg6Ct8VwpYzGff3uctyCc,5Q544fKrFoe6tsEbD7S8EmxGTJYAKtTVhAW5Q5pge4j1,cpamdpZCGKUy5JxQXB4dcpGPiikHawvSWAd6mEn1sGG}
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}
    command: ["--topic","orca-swaps"]
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
          cpus: '0.10'

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: redis
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "--raw", "incr", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 5s
    command: redis-server --appendonly yes --maxmemory 512mb --maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru --save 900 1 --save 300 10 --save 60 10000
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.25'

  redis-ui:
    image: rediscommander/redis-commander:latest
    container_name: redis-ui
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      - REDIS_HOSTS=local:redis:6379
      - HTTP_USER=admin
      - HTTP_PASSWORD=admin123
    ports:
      - "8083:8081"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--no-verbose", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:8081/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
          cpus: '0.1'

  # =============================================================================
  # STREAMING SERVICES
  # =============================================================================

  stream-orca:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: stream-orca/Dockerfile
      target: runtime
      args:
        BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE: 1
    image: arbitrage-stream-orca:latest
    container_name: stream-orca
    env_file:
      - .env
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      - SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT=${SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT}
      - SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN=${SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN}
      - LOG_LEVEL=${LOG_LEVEL:-info}
      - METRICS_PORT=9090
      - IDL_PATH=/app
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}
      - HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL=30
      - CONNECTION_TIMEOUT=30
      - RECONNECT_DELAY=5
      - ENABLE_TIMER=${ENABLE_TIMER:-false}
      - TIMER_DURATION_SECONDS=${TIMER_DURATION_SECONDS:-20}
      - PROGRAM_IDS=${PROGRAM_IDS:-whirLbMiicVdio4qvUfM5KAg6Ct8VwpYzGff3uctyCc}
    ports:
      - "9094:9090"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "pgrep", "-f", "stream-orca"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 15s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'

  stream-raydium:
    build:
      context: ../stream-raydium
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: runtime
      args:
        BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE: 1
    image: arbitrage-stream-raydium:latest
    container_name: stream-raydium
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      - SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT=${SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT}
      - SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN=${SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN}
      - LOG_LEVEL=${LOG_LEVEL:-info}
      - METRICS_PORT=9090
      - IDL_PATH=/app
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}
      - HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL=30

    ports:

    networks:

    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "pgrep", "-f", "stream-raydium"]
      interval: 30s

      retries: 3

    logging:

  # =============================================================================

  swap-ingest:
    build:
      context: ../Arbitrage/solana-arbitrage/swap-ingest

    image: arbitrage-swap-ingest:latest

      - METRICS_PORT=9090
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}
      - HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL=30
      - BATCH_SIZE=50
      - PROCESSING_TIMEOUT=30
    ports:
      - "9094:9090"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "pgrep", "-f", "swap-ingest"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 15s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'

  data-stream-processor:
    build:
      context: ../data-stream-processor
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      args:
        BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE: 1
    image: data-stream-processor:latest

        reservations:

  pathfinder:

        reservations:

  # =============================================================================

  redis-viewer:

  # Prometheus for metrics collection

      interval: 30s

      retries: 3

    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'

  # Grafana for metrics visualization
  grafana:

    healthcheck:

      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'

  # =============================================================================
  # DATABASE SERVICES
  # =============================================================================

  postgres:
    image: postgres:15
    container_name: postgres
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-mev}

      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data

    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-mev} -d ${POSTGRES_DB:-mevdb}"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 10s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.25'

  adminer:
    image: adminer
    container_name: adminer
    ports:
      - "8082:8080"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--no-verbose", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:8080/"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:

      context: ..

    environment:
      - SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT=${SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT}

      - HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL=30

      - ../stream-orca:/app
      - cargo_cache:/usr/local/cargo/registry
      - target_cache:/app/target
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "pgrep", "-f", "cargo-watch"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 20s
    profiles:
      - dev
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'

  # =============================================================================
  # CACHE LAYERS (for faster rebuilds)
  # =============================================================================

  stream-orca-cache:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: stream-orca/Dockerfile
      target: builder
    image: arbitrage-stream-orca:cache
    profiles:
      - cache

  stream-raydium-cache:
    build:
      context: ../stream-raydium
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: builder
    image: arbitrage-stream-raydium:cache
    profiles:
      - cache

  cargo_cache:
    driver: local
  target_cache:
```

```dockercompose
# =============================================================================
# SOLANA AI TRADING PLATFORM - ENHANCED DOCKER COMPOSE
# =============================================================================
# Enhanced version with improved connectivity, monitoring, and resource management

services:
  # =============================================================================
  # INFRASTRUCTURE SERVICES
  # =============================================================================
  
  zookeeper:
    image: confluentinc/cp-zookeeper:7.4.0
    container_name: zookeeper
    environment:
      ZOOKEEPER_CLIENT_PORT: 2181
      ZOOKEEPER_TICK_TIME: 2000
      ZOOKEEPER_MAX_CLIENT_CNXNS: 60
      ZOOKEEPER_SYNC_LIMIT: 2
      ZOOKEEPER_INIT_LIMIT: 5
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "bash", "-c", "echo stat | nc localhost 2181"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 10s
    ports:
      - "2181:2181"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'

  kafka:
    image: confluentinc/cp-kafka:7.4.0
    container_name: kafka
    depends_on:
      zookeeper:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      KAFKA_BROKER_ID: 1
      KAFKA_ZOOKEEPER_CONNECT: zookeeper:2181
      KAFKA_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://0.0.0.0:9092,PLAINTEXT_HOST://0.0.0.0:29092
      KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://kafka:9092,PLAINTEXT_HOST://host.docker.internal:29092
      KAFKA_LISTENER_SECURITY_PROTOCOL_MAP: PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,PLAINTEXT_HOST:PLAINTEXT
      KAFKA_INTER_BROKER_LISTENER_NAME: PLAINTEXT
      KAFKA_AUTO_CREATE_TOPICS_ENABLE: "true"
      KAFKA_OFFSETS_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
      KAFKA_HEAP_OPTS: "-Xmx1G -Xms1G"
      KAFKA_LOG_RETENTION_HOURS: 168
      KAFKA_LOG_SEGMENT_BYTES: 1073741824
      KAFKA_NUM_PARTITIONS: 3
      KAFKA_DEFAULT_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
      KAFKA_MIN_INSYNC_REPLICAS: 1
      KAFKA_DELETE_TOPIC_ENABLE: "true"
    ports:
      - "9092:9092"
      - "29092:29092"
    networks:

    healthcheck:

    healthcheck:
```

```rust
use anyhow::Result;
use backoff::{future::retry, ExponentialBackoff};
use clap::Parser;
use dotenv::dotenv;
use env_logger;
use futures_util::{sink::SinkExt, stream::StreamExt, TryFutureExt};
use log::{error, info};
use rdkafka::producer::{FutureProducer, FutureRecord};
use rdkafka::ClientConfig;
use std::time::Duration;
use tonic::transport::channel::ClientTlsConfig;
use yellowstone_grpc_client::{GeyserGrpcClient, Interceptor};
use yellowstone_grpc_proto::{
    geyser::SubscribeRequestFilterTransactions,
    prelude::{
        subscribe_update::UpdateOneof, CommitmentLevel, SubscribeRequest, SubscribeRequestPing,
    },
    prost::Message as _,
};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Parser)]
#[command(author, version, about)]
struct Args {
    #[arg(short, long)]
    broker: Option<String>,
    #[arg(short, long, help = "Output topic", default_value = "geyser.raw")]
    topic: String,
    #[arg(short, long)]
    endpoint: Option<String>,
    #[arg(long)]
    x_token: Option<String>,
    #[arg(long, help = "Comma-separated list of program ids")]
    program_ids: Option<String>,
}

type TxnFilterMap = std::collections::HashMap<String, SubscribeRequestFilterTransactions>;

fn build_request(program_ids: Vec<String>) -> SubscribeRequest {
    let mut transactions: TxnFilterMap = std::collections::HashMap::new();
    transactions.insert(
        "client".to_owned(),
        SubscribeRequestFilterTransactions {
            vote: Some(false),
            failed: Some(false),
            account_include: program_ids,
            account_exclude: vec![],
            account_required: vec![],
            signature: None,
        },
    );
    SubscribeRequest {
        accounts: Default::default(),
        slots: Default::default(),
        transactions,
        transactions_status: Default::default(),
        blocks: Default::default(),
        blocks_meta: Default::default(),
        entry: Default::default(),
        commitment: Some(CommitmentLevel::Processed as i32),
        accounts_data_slice: vec![],
        ping: None,
        from_slot: None,
    }
}

fn create_producer(broker: &str, fast_mode: bool) -> Result<FutureProducer> {
    let mut config = ClientConfig::new();
    config.set("bootstrap.servers", broker);
    if fast_mode {
        config
            .set("linger.ms", "0")
            .set("acks", "1")
            .set("compression.type", "lz4")
            .set("enable.idempotence", "false")
            .set("message.timeout.ms", "100");
    } else {
        config
            .set("enable.idempotence", "true")
            .set("compression.type", "lz4")
            .set("acks", "all")
            .set("linger.ms", "5");
    }
    let p: FutureProducer = config.create()?;
    Ok(p)
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    dotenv().ok();
    env_logger::init();
    let args = Args::parse();

    let broker = args
        .broker
        .or_else(|| std::env::var("KAFKA_BROKER").ok())
        .expect("KAFKA_BROKER");
    let topic = args.topic;
    let endpoint = args
        .endpoint
        .or_else(|| std::env::var("ENDPOINT").ok())
        .expect("ENDPOINT");
    let x_token = args
        .x_token
        .or_else(|| std::env::var("X_TOKEN").ok())
        .expect("X_TOKEN");
    let program_ids_csv = args
        .program_ids
        .or_else(|| std::env::var("PROGRAM_IDS").ok())
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let program_ids: Vec<String> = program_ids_csv
        .split(',')
        .map(|s| s.trim().to_string())
        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
        .collect();

    info!(
        "universal stream: broker={broker} topic={topic} endpoint={endpoint} pids={:?}",
        program_ids
    );

    let fast_mode = std::env::var("FAST_MODE").ok().as_deref() == Some("1");
    let producer = create_producer(&broker, fast_mode)?;

    retry(ExponentialBackoff::default(), move || {
        let producer = producer.clone();
        let endpoint = endpoint.clone();
        let x_token = x_token.clone();
        let topic = topic.clone();
        let request = build_request(program_ids.clone());

        async move {
            let mut client = GeyserGrpcClient::build_from_shared(endpoint.clone())
                .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?
                .x_token(Some(x_token.clone()))
                .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?
                .connect_timeout(Duration::from_secs(10))
                .timeout(Duration::from_secs(10))
                .tls_config(ClientTlsConfig::new().with_native_roots())
                .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?
                .max_decoding_message_size(1024 * 1024 * 1024)
                .connect()
                .await
                .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;

            let (mut subscribe_tx, mut stream) =
                client.subscribe_with_request(Some(request)).await?;
            info!("stream opened");
            while let Some(msg) = stream.next().await {
                match msg {
                    Ok(update_msg) => match update_msg.update_oneof {
                        Some(UpdateOneof::Transaction(update)) => {
                            let mut buf = Vec::new();
                            update.encode(&mut buf)?;
                            let _ = producer
                                .send(
                                    FutureRecord::to(&topic).payload(&buf),
                                    Duration::from_secs(10),
                                )
                                .await;
                        }
                        Some(UpdateOneof::Ping(_)) => {
                            let _ = subscribe_tx
                                .send(SubscribeRequest {
                                    ping: Some(SubscribeRequestPing { id: 1 }),
                                    ..Default::default()
                                })
                                .await;
                        }
                        _ => {}
                    },
                    Err(e) => {
                        error!("stream error: {e:?}");
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            info!("stream closed");
            Ok::<(), anyhow::Error>(())
        }
        .map_err(backoff::Error::transient)
    })
    .await?;

    Ok(())
}

```

```rust
// crates/normalizer-service/src/bin/tap_orca_extract.rs

// Pull in the generated registry (built by build.rs via normalizer-codegen)
mod generated {
    include!(concat!(env!("OUT_DIR"), "/registry.rs"));
}

use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use bs58;
use chrono::Utc;
use dotenv::dotenv;
use env_logger;
use log::{error, info, warn};
use normalizer_runtime as rt;
use rdkafka::consumer::{CommitMode, Consumer, StreamConsumer};
use rdkafka::producer::{FutureProducer, FutureRecord};
use rdkafka::ClientConfig;
use rdkafka::Message as _;
use redis::{aio::MultiplexedConnection, AsyncCommands};
use serde_json;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::time::Instant;
use yellowstone_grpc_proto::prelude as ypp;
use yellowstone_grpc_proto::prost::Message as _;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    dotenv().ok();
    env_logger::init();

    let broker = std::env::var("KAFKA_BROKER").unwrap_or_else(|_| "localhost:29092".into());
    let in_topic = std::env::var("IN_TOPIC").unwrap_or_else(|_| "orca-swaps".into());
    let out_topic = std::env::var("OUT_TOPIC").unwrap_or_else(|_| "orca-swaps.parsed.v2".into());
    let group_id = std::env::var("GROUP_ID").unwrap_or_else(|_| "tap-orca-extract".into());
    let redis_url =
        std::env::var("REDIS_URL").unwrap_or_else(|_| "redis://127.0.0.1:6379/0".into());

    info!("tap_orca_extract: broker={broker} in={in_topic} out={out_topic} group_id={group_id}");

    let fast = std::env::var("FAST_MODE").ok().as_deref() == Some("1");
    let mut cconf = ClientConfig::new();
    cconf
        .set("bootstrap.servers", &broker)
        .set("group.id", &group_id)
        .set("enable.auto.commit", "false")
        .set("auto.offset.reset", "latest");
    if fast {
        cconf
            .set("fetch.min.bytes", "1")
            .set("fetch.wait.max.ms", "1")
            .set("queued.min.messages", "1");
    }
    let consumer: StreamConsumer = cconf.create().context("create consumer")?;

    consumer.subscribe(&[&in_topic]).context("subscribe")?;

    // Producer for v2 output
    let mut pconf = ClientConfig::new();
    pconf.set("bootstrap.servers", &broker);
    if fast {
        pconf
            .set("linger.ms", "0")
            .set("acks", "1")
            .set("compression.type", "lz4")
            .set("enable.idempotence", "false")
            .set("message.timeout.ms", "100");
    } else {
        pconf
            .set("compression.type", "lz4")
            .set("linger.ms", "5")
            .set("acks", "all");
    }
    let producer: FutureProducer = pconf.create().context("create producer")?;

    // Redis (optional enrich) with local read-through caches
    let redis_client = redis::Client::open(redis_url.clone())?;
    let mut redis_conn: MultiplexedConnection = redis_client
        .get_multiplexed_tokio_connection()
        .await
        .context("redis connect")?;

    // Verify decoders are registered
    {
        let regs = generated::registry();
        if regs.is_empty() {
            warn!("No generated extractors registered. Check idls/ and profiles/.");
        } else {
            info!("{} extractor(s) registered", regs.len());
            for e in regs {
                info!(" - program_id={}", e.program_id());
            }
        }
    }

    loop {
        match consumer.recv().await {
            Err(e) => warn!("kafka recv error: {e:?}"),
            Ok(m) => {
                if let Some(bytes) = m.payload() {
                    let t0 = Instant::now();
                    if let Err(e) = handle(bytes, &producer, &out_topic, &mut redis_conn).await {
                        error!("handle error: {e:#}");
                    }
                    let dt_ms = t0.elapsed().as_micros() as f64 / 1000.0;
                    if dt_ms > 25.0 {
                        warn!("extract path latency high: {:.2} ms", dt_ms);
                    }
                } else {
                    warn!("empty payload");
                }
                let _ = consumer.commit_message(&m, CommitMode::Async);
            }
        }
    }
}

async fn handle(
    payload: &[u8],
    producer: &FutureProducer,
    out_topic: &str,
    redis: &mut MultiplexedConnection,
) -> Result<()> {
    // Decode the Yellowstone SubscribeUpdateTransaction
    let update = ypp::SubscribeUpdateTransaction::decode(payload)
        .context("prost decode SubscribeUpdateTransaction")?;

    let Some(info) = update.transaction.as_ref() else {
        return Ok(());
    };

    let (keys_b58, tb_changes) = build_keys_and_balance_changes(info);

    // Iterate compiled instructions and attempt IDL decode + normalization
    if let Some(msg) = info.transaction.as_ref().and_then(|t| t.message.as_ref()) {
        for (ix_index, ci) in msg.instructions.iter().enumerate() {
            let pid_idx = ci.program_id_index as usize;
            if pid_idx >= keys_b58.len() {
                continue;
            }
            let pid = &keys_b58[pid_idx];

            // IDL decode
            let Some(dec) = generated::decoder_for(pid) else {
                continue;
            };
            let Some((decoded_name, roles)) = dec(&ci.data, &ci.accounts, &keys_b58) else {
                continue;
            };

            // Find extractor for this program id
            let extractor = generated::registry()
                .into_iter()
                .find(|e| e.program_id() == pid);
            let Some(extractor) = extractor else {
                continue;
            };

            let sig = bs58::encode(&info.signature).into_string();

            // Build TxContext
            let ctx = rt::TxContext {
                slot: update.slot,
                block_time_unix: Utc::now().timestamp(),
                signature: sig,
                ix_index: ix_index as u16,
                program_id: pid.clone(),
                meta_ok: true,
                token_balance_changes: &tb_changes,
                account_data_by_pubkey: None,
                decoded_name: Some(decoded_name),
                decoded_args_json: None,
                decoded_accounts_by_role: Some(roles),
            };

            if let Some(n) = extractor.try_extract(&ctx) {
                // Enrich with pool/mint info from Redis if present
                // Expect keys: dex:pool:{pool_id}, dex:mint:{mint}
                let pool_id = ctx
                    .decoded_accounts_by_role
                    .as_ref()
                    .and_then(|m| ["whirlpool", "pool"].iter().find_map(|r| m.get(*r)))
                    .cloned()
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                let pool_key = format!("dex:pool:{}", pool_id);
                let mut tick_hint: Option<i64> = None;
                let mut sqrt_price_hint: Option<String> = None;
                if !pool_key.ends_with(':') {
                    // crude check; empty id yields trailing ':'
                    if let Ok::<std::collections::HashMap<String, String>, _>(snap) =
                        redis.hgetall(&pool_key).await
                    {
                        if let Some(sp) = snap.get("sqrt_price_x64") {
                            sqrt_price_hint = Some(sp.clone());
                        }
                        if let Some(t) = snap.get("tick").and_then(|s| s.parse::<i64>().ok()) {
                            tick_hint = Some(t);
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Optional decimals → UI amounts (with local LRU + TTL read-through)
                let dec_in = get_mint_decimals_cached(redis, &n.token_in_mint).await;
                let dec_out = get_mint_decimals_cached(redis, &n.token_out_mint).await;
                let amount_in_ui = dec_in.map(|d| to_ui(n.amount_in, d));
                let amount_out_ui = dec_out.map(|d| to_ui(n.amount_out, d));
                let price_ui = match (amount_in_ui, amount_out_ui) {
                    (Some(ai), Some(ao)) if ai > 0.0 => Some(ao / ai),
                    _ => None,
                };

                // Merge into JSON object
                let mut obj = serde_json::to_value(&n)?
                    .as_object()
                    .cloned()
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                if let Some(v) = amount_in_ui {
                    obj.insert("amount_in_ui".into(), serde_json::json!(v));
                }
                if let Some(v) = amount_out_ui {
                    obj.insert("amount_out_ui".into(), serde_json::json!(v));
                }
                if let Some(v) = price_ui {
                    obj.insert("price_ui".into(), serde_json::json!(v));
                }
                if let Some(v) = tick_hint {
                    obj.insert("tick_hint".into(), serde_json::json!(v));
                }
                if let Some(v) = sqrt_price_hint {
                    obj.insert("sqrt_price_x64_hint".into(), serde_json::json!(v));
                }

                // Emit to Kafka as JSON with key = signature
                let key = ctx.signature.clone();
                let payload = serde_json::to_vec(&obj)?;
                let _ = producer
                    .send(
                        FutureRecord::to(out_topic).key(&key).payload(&payload),
                        std::time::Duration::from_secs(5),
                    )
                    .await;
                // Also echo to stdout for quick inspection
                println!("{}", serde_json::to_string(&obj)?);
            }
        }
    }

    Ok(())
}

fn build_keys_and_balance_changes(
    info: &ypp::SubscribeUpdateTransactionInfo,
) -> (Vec<String>, Vec<rt::TokenBalanceChange>) {
    // Account keys (base58)
    let keys_b58: Vec<String> = info
        .transaction
        .as_ref()
        .and_then(|t| t.message.as_ref())
        .map(|msg| {
            msg.account_keys
                .iter()
                .map(|k| bs58::encode(k).into_string())
                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        })
        .unwrap_or_default();

    // Build pre/post maps over (owner, mint)
    let mut pre_map: HashMap<(String, String), u128> = HashMap::new();
    let mut post_map: HashMap<(String, String), u128> = HashMap::new();

    if let Some(meta) = info.meta.as_ref() {
        for b in &meta.pre_token_balances {
            let owner = b.owner.clone();
            let mint = b.mint.clone();
            let raw = b
                .ui_token_amount
                .as_ref()
                .map(|x| x.amount.clone())
                .unwrap_or_else(|| "0".to_string());
            let val = raw.parse::<u128>().unwrap_or(0);
            pre_map.insert((owner, mint), val);
        }
        for b in &meta.post_token_balances {
            let owner = b.owner.clone();
            let mint = b.mint.clone();
            let raw = b
                .ui_token_amount
                .as_ref()
                .map(|x| x.amount.clone())
                .unwrap_or_else(|| "0".to_string());
            let val = raw.parse::<u128>().unwrap_or(0);
            post_map.insert((owner, mint), val);
        }
    }

    // Union of keys
    let mut out: Vec<rt::TokenBalanceChange> = Vec::new();
    let mut seen: HashMap<(String, String), bool> = HashMap::new();
    for (k, v) in pre_map.iter() {
        seen.insert(k.clone(), true);
        let post = post_map.get(k).copied().unwrap_or(0);
        out.push(rt::TokenBalanceChange {
            owner: k.0.clone(),
            mint: k.1.clone(),
            pre: *v,
            post,
        });
    }
    for (k, post) in post_map.into_iter() {
        if seen.contains_key(&k) {
            continue;
        }
        out.push(rt::TokenBalanceChange {
            owner: k.0,
            mint: k.1,
            pre: 0,
            post,
        });
    }

    (keys_b58, out)
}

fn to_ui(raw: u128, decimals: u8) -> f64 {
    if decimals == 0 {
        return raw as f64;
    }
    let scale = 10u128.saturating_pow(decimals as u32);
    (raw as f64) / (scale as f64)
}

use once_cell::sync::Lazy;
use std::num::NonZeroUsize;
use std::sync::Mutex as StdMutex;

struct TtlEntry<T> {
    value: T,
    expires_at_unix_ms: i64,
}

static MINT_DECIMALS_CACHE: Lazy<StdMutex<lru::LruCache<String, TtlEntry<u8>>>> = Lazy::new(|| {
    StdMutex::new(lru::LruCache::new(NonZeroUsize::new(1024).unwrap()))
});

static POOL_SNAPSHOT_CACHE: Lazy<StdMutex<lru::LruCache<String, TtlEntry<HashMap<String, String>>>>> = Lazy::new(|| {
    StdMutex::new(lru::LruCache::new(NonZeroUsize::new(1024).unwrap()))
});

fn now_unix_ms() -> i64 { (std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap_or_default().as_millis() as i64) }

async fn get_mint_decimals_cached(redis: &mut MultiplexedConnection, mint: &str) -> Option<u8> {
    let ttl_ms: i64 = std::env::var("MINT_DECIMALS_TTL_MS").ok().and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(60_000);
    {
        let mut guard = MINT_DECIMALS_CACHE.lock().unwrap();
        if let Some(entry) = guard.get(mint) {
            if entry.expires_at_unix_ms > now_unix_ms() {
                return Some(entry.value);
            }
        }
    }
    let key = format!("dex:mint:{}", mint);
    if let Ok(Some(d)) = redis::cmd("HGET").arg(&key).arg("decimals").query_async::<Option<i64>>(redis).await {
        if d >= 0 && d <= 255 {
            let entry = TtlEntry { value: d as u8, expires_at_unix_ms: now_unix_ms() + ttl_ms };
            let mut guard = MINT_DECIMALS_CACHE.lock().unwrap();
            guard.put(mint.to_string(), entry);
            return Some(d as u8);
        }
    }
    None
}
```

```rust
// crates/normalizer-service/src/bin/tap_orca_extract.rs

// Pull in the generated registry (built by build.rs via normalizer-codegen)
mod generated {
    include!(concat!(env!("OUT_DIR"), "/registry.rs"));
}

use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use bs58;
use chrono::Utc;
use dotenv::dotenv;
use env_logger;
use log::{error, info, warn};
use normalizer_runtime as rt;
use rdkafka::consumer::{CommitMode, Consumer, StreamConsumer};
use rdkafka::producer::{FutureProducer, FutureRecord};
use rdkafka::ClientConfig;
use rdkafka::Message as _;
use redis::{aio::MultiplexedConnection, AsyncCommands};
use serde_json;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::time::Instant;
use yellowstone_grpc_proto::prelude as ypp;
use yellowstone_grpc_proto::prost::Message as _;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    dotenv().ok();
    env_logger::init();

    let broker = std::env::var("KAFKA_BROKER").unwrap_or_else(|_| "localhost:29092".into());
    let in_topic = std::env::var("IN_TOPIC").unwrap_or_else(|_| "orca-swaps".into());
    let out_topic = std::env::var("OUT_TOPIC").unwrap_or_else(|_| "orca-swaps.parsed.v2".into());
    let group_id = std::env::var("GROUP_ID").unwrap_or_else(|_| "tap-orca-extract".into());
    let redis_url =
        std::env::var("REDIS_URL").unwrap_or_else(|_| "redis://127.0.0.1:6379/0".into());

    info!("tap_orca_extract: broker={broker} in={in_topic} out={out_topic} group_id={group_id}");

    let fast = std::env::var("FAST_MODE").ok().as_deref() == Some("1");
    let mut cconf = ClientConfig::new();
    cconf
        .set("bootstrap.servers", &broker)
        .set("group.id", &group_id)
        .set("enable.auto.commit", "false")
        .set("auto.offset.reset", "latest");
    if fast {
        cconf
            .set("fetch.min.bytes", "1")
            .set("fetch.wait.max.ms", "1")
            .set("queued.min.messages", "1");
    }
    let consumer: StreamConsumer = cconf.create().context("create consumer")?;

    consumer.subscribe(&[&in_topic]).context("subscribe")?;

    // Producer for v2 output
    let mut pconf = ClientConfig::new();
    pconf.set("bootstrap.servers", &broker);
    if fast {
        pconf
            .set("linger.ms", "0")
            .set("acks", "1")
            .set("compression.type", "lz4")
            .set("enable.idempotence", "false")
            .set("message.timeout.ms", "100");
    } else {
        pconf
            .set("compression.type", "lz4")
            .set("linger.ms", "5")
            .set("acks", "all");
    }
    let producer: FutureProducer = pconf.create().context("create producer")?;

    // Redis (optional enrich) with local read-through caches
    let redis_client = redis::Client::open(redis_url.clone())?;
    let mut redis_conn: MultiplexedConnection = redis_client
        .get_multiplexed_tokio_connection()
        .await
        .context("redis connect")?;

    // Verify decoders are registered
    {
        let regs = generated::registry();
        if regs.is_empty() {
            warn!("No generated extractors registered. Check idls/ and profiles/.");
        } else {
            info!("{} extractor(s) registered", regs.len());
            for e in regs {
                info!(" - program_id={}", e.program_id());
            }
        }
    }

    loop {
        match consumer.recv().await {
            Err(e) => warn!("kafka recv error: {e:?}"),
            Ok(m) => {
                if let Some(bytes) = m.payload() {
                    let t0 = Instant::now();
                    if let Err(e) = handle(bytes, &producer, &out_topic, &mut redis_conn).await {
                        error!("handle error: {e:#}");
                    }
                    let dt_ms = t0.elapsed().as_micros() as f64 / 1000.0;
                    if dt_ms > 25.0 {
                        warn!("extract path latency high: {:.2} ms", dt_ms);
                    }
                } else {
                    warn!("empty payload");
                }
                let _ = consumer.commit_message(&m, CommitMode::Async);
            }
        }
    }
}

async fn handle(
    payload: &[u8],
    producer: &FutureProducer,
    out_topic: &str,
    redis: &mut MultiplexedConnection,
) -> Result<()> {
    // Decode the Yellowstone SubscribeUpdateTransaction
    let update = ypp::SubscribeUpdateTransaction::decode(payload)
        .context("prost decode SubscribeUpdateTransaction")?;

    let Some(info) = update.transaction.as_ref() else {
        return Ok(());
    };

    let (keys_b58, tb_changes) = build_keys_and_balance_changes(info);

    // Iterate compiled instructions and attempt IDL decode + normalization
    if let Some(msg) = info.transaction.as_ref().and_then(|t| t.message.as_ref()) {
        for (ix_index, ci) in msg.instructions.iter().enumerate() {
            let pid_idx = ci.program_id_index as usize;
            if pid_idx >= keys_b58.len() {
                continue;
            }
            let pid = &keys_b58[pid_idx];

            // IDL decode
            let Some(dec) = generated::decoder_for(pid) else {
                continue;
            };
            let Some((decoded_name, roles)) = dec(&ci.data, &ci.accounts, &keys_b58) else {
                continue;
            };

            // Find extractor for this program id
            let extractor = generated::registry()
                .into_iter()
                .find(|e| e.program_id() == pid);
            let Some(extractor) = extractor else {
                continue;
            };

            let sig = bs58::encode(&info.signature).into_string();

            // Build TxContext
            let ctx = rt::TxContext {
                slot: update.slot,
                block_time_unix: Utc::now().timestamp(),
                signature: sig,
                ix_index: ix_index as u16,
                program_id: pid.clone(),
                meta_ok: true,
                token_balance_changes: &tb_changes,
                account_data_by_pubkey: None,
                decoded_name: Some(decoded_name),
                decoded_args_json: None,
                decoded_accounts_by_role: Some(roles),
            };

            if let Some(n) = extractor.try_extract(&ctx) {
                // Enrich with pool/mint info from Redis if present
                // Expect keys: dex:pool:{pool_id}, dex:mint:{mint}
                let pool_id = ctx
                    .decoded_accounts_by_role
                    .as_ref()
                    .and_then(|m| ["whirlpool", "pool"].iter().find_map(|r| m.get(*r)))
                    .cloned()
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                let pool_key = format!("dex:pool:{}", pool_id);
                let mut tick_hint: Option<i64> = None;
                let mut sqrt_price_hint: Option<String> = None;
                if !pool_key.ends_with(':') {
                    if let Some(snap) = get_pool_snapshot_cached(redis, &pool_key).await {
                        if let Some(sp) = snap.get("sqrt_price_x64") {
                            sqrt_price_hint = Some(sp.clone());
                        }
                        if let Some(t) = snap.get("tick").and_then(|s| s.parse::<i64>().ok()) {
                            tick_hint = Some(t);
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Optional decimals → UI amounts (with local LRU + TTL read-through)
                let dec_in = get_mint_decimals_cached(redis, &n.token_in_mint).await;
                let dec_out = get_mint_decimals_cached(redis, &n.token_out_mint).await;
                let amount_in_ui = dec_in.map(|d| to_ui(n.amount_in, d));
                let amount_out_ui = dec_out.map(|d| to_ui(n.amount_out, d));
                let price_ui = match (amount_in_ui, amount_out_ui) {
                    (Some(ai), Some(ao)) if ai > 0.0 => Some(ao / ai),
                    _ => None,
                };

                // Merge into JSON object
                let mut obj = serde_json::to_value(&n)?
                    .as_object()
                    .cloned()
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                if let Some(v) = amount_in_ui {
                    obj.insert("amount_in_ui".into(), serde_json::json!(v));
                }
                if let Some(v) = amount_out_ui {
                    obj.insert("amount_out_ui".into(), serde_json::json!(v));
                }
                if let Some(v) = price_ui {
                    obj.insert("price_ui".into(), serde_json::json!(v));
                }
                if let Some(v) = tick_hint {
                    obj.insert("tick_hint".into(), serde_json::json!(v));
                }
                if let Some(v) = sqrt_price_hint {
                    obj.insert("sqrt_price_x64_hint".into(), serde_json::json!(v));
                }

                // Emit to Kafka as JSON with key = signature
                let key = ctx.signature.clone();
                let payload = serde_json::to_vec(&obj)?;
                let _ = producer
                    .send(
                        FutureRecord::to(out_topic).key(&key).payload(&payload),
                        std::time::Duration::from_secs(5),
                    )
                    .await;
                // Also echo to stdout for quick inspection
                println!("{}", serde_json::to_string(&obj)?);
            }
        }
    }

    Ok(())
}

fn build_keys_and_balance_changes(
    info: &ypp::SubscribeUpdateTransactionInfo,
) -> (Vec<String>, Vec<rt::TokenBalanceChange>) {
    // Account keys (base58)
    let keys_b58: Vec<String> = info
        .transaction
        .as_ref()
        .and_then(|t| t.message.as_ref())
        .map(|msg| {
            msg.account_keys
                .iter()
                .map(|k| bs58::encode(k).into_string())
                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        })
        .unwrap_or_default();

    // Build pre/post maps over (owner, mint)
    let mut pre_map: HashMap<(String, String), u128> = HashMap::new();
    let mut post_map: HashMap<(String, String), u128> = HashMap::new();

    if let Some(meta) = info.meta.as_ref() {
        for b in &meta.pre_token_balances {
            let owner = b.owner.clone();
            let mint = b.mint.clone();
            let raw = b
                .ui_token_amount
                .as_ref()
                .map(|x| x.amount.clone())
                .unwrap_or_else(|| "0".to_string());
            let val = raw.parse::<u128>().unwrap_or(0);
            pre_map.insert((owner, mint), val);
        }
        for b in &meta.post_token_balances {
            let owner = b.owner.clone();
            let mint = b.mint.clone();
            let raw = b
                .ui_token_amount
                .as_ref()
                .map(|x| x.amount.clone())
                .unwrap_or_else(|| "0".to_string());
            let val = raw.parse::<u128>().unwrap_or(0);
            post_map.insert((owner, mint), val);
        }
    }

    // Union of keys
    let mut out: Vec<rt::TokenBalanceChange> = Vec::new();
    let mut seen: HashMap<(String, String), bool> = HashMap::new();
    for (k, v) in pre_map.iter() {
        seen.insert(k.clone(), true);
        let post = post_map.get(k).copied().unwrap_or(0);
        out.push(rt::TokenBalanceChange {
            owner: k.0.clone(),
            mint: k.1.clone(),
            pre: *v,
            post,
        });
    }
    for (k, post) in post_map.into_iter() {
        if seen.contains_key(&k) {
            continue;
        }
        out.push(rt::TokenBalanceChange {
            owner: k.0,
            mint: k.1,
            pre: 0,
            post,
        });
    }

    (keys_b58, out)
}

fn to_ui(raw: u128, decimals: u8) -> f64 {
    if decimals == 0 {
        return raw as f64;
    }
    let scale = 10u128.saturating_pow(decimals as u32);
    (raw as f64) / (scale as f64)
}

use once_cell::sync::Lazy;
use std::num::NonZeroUsize;
use std::sync::Mutex as StdMutex;

struct TtlEntry<T> {
    value: T,
    expires_at_unix_ms: i64,
}

static MINT_DECIMALS_CACHE: Lazy<StdMutex<lru::LruCache<String, TtlEntry<u8>>>> = Lazy::new(|| {
    StdMutex::new(lru::LruCache::new(NonZeroUsize::new(1024).unwrap()))
});

static POOL_SNAPSHOT_CACHE: Lazy<StdMutex<lru::LruCache<String, TtlEntry<HashMap<String, String>>>>> = Lazy::new(|| {
    StdMutex::new(lru::LruCache::new(NonZeroUsize::new(1024).unwrap()))
});

fn now_unix_ms() -> i64 { (std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap_or_default().as_millis() as i64) }

async fn get_mint_decimals_cached(redis: &mut MultiplexedConnection, mint: &str) -> Option<u8> {
    let ttl_ms: i64 = std::env::var("MINT_DECIMALS_TTL_MS").ok().and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(60_000);
    {
        let mut guard = MINT_DECIMALS_CACHE.lock().unwrap();
        if let Some(entry) = guard.get(mint) {
            if entry.expires_at_unix_ms > now_unix_ms() {
                return Some(entry.value);
            }
        }
    }
    let key = format!("dex:mint:{}", mint);
    if let Ok(Some(d)) = redis::cmd("HGET").arg(&key).arg("decimals").query_async::<Option<i64>>(redis).await {
        if d >= 0 && d <= 255 {
            let entry = TtlEntry { value: d as u8, expires_at_unix_ms: now_unix_ms() + ttl_ms };
            let mut guard = MINT_DECIMALS_CACHE.lock().unwrap();
            guard.put(mint.to_string(), entry);
            return Some(d as u8);
        }
    }
    None
}

async fn get_pool_snapshot_cached(
    redis: &mut MultiplexedConnection,
    pool_key: &str,
) -> Option<HashMap<String, String>> {
    let ttl_ms: i64 = std::env::var("POOL_SNAPSHOT_TTL_MS").ok().and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(60_000);
    {
        let mut guard = POOL_SNAPSHOT_CACHE.lock().unwrap();
        if let Some(entry) = guard.get(pool_key) {
            if entry.expires_at_unix_ms > now_unix_ms() {
                return Some(entry.value.clone());
            }
        }
    }
    match redis.hgetall::<_, HashMap<String, String>>(pool_key).await {
        Ok(map) if !map.is_empty() => {
            let entry = TtlEntry { value: map.clone(), expires_at_unix_ms: now_unix_ms() + ttl_ms };
            let mut guard = POOL_SNAPSHOT_CACHE.lock().unwrap();
            guard.put(pool_key.to_string(), entry);
            Some(map)
        }
        _ => None,
    }
}
```

```rust
// shyft_graphql_backfill.rs
// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Purpose: Seed Redis with Whirlpool pool snapshots + mint metadata
// using Shyft GraphQL (pools) and Shyft REST (mint info). Adds:
//  - Tiny in-memory LRU for mint metadata (decimals/symbol/name)
//  - Writes both address-based pair mapping and optional symbol-based mapping
//
// ✅ Hot path remains your Geyser streamer → Redis. This file is an offline backfill/helper.
//
// USAGE
// -----
// Cargo.toml (add these deps):
//
// [dependencies]
// anyhow = "1"
// bs58 = "0.5"
// chrono = "0.4"
// clap = { version = "4.5", features = ["derive", "env"] }
// dotenv = "0.15"
// env_logger = "0.11"
// lru = "0.12"                # ← LRU cache
// log = "0.4"
// redis = { version = "0.32", features = ["tokio-comp"] }
// reqwest = { version = "0.12", features = ["json", "gzip", "brotli", "deflate", "rustls-tls"] }
// serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
// serde_json = "1"
// tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }
//
// .env (examples):
// SHYFT_API_KEY=fWrVh_mDygK358FC
// SHYFT_NETWORK=mainnet-beta
// REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:6379/0
//
// Run:
// cargo run --release --bin shyft_graphql_backfill -- \
//   --page-size 250 --max-pages 200
//
// Optional:
//   --mint-filter EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v
//
// Redis keys written
// ------------------
// HSET dex:pool:{POOL} => mint_a, mint_b, decimals_a, decimals_b, fee_bps,
//                         sqrt_price_x64, tick, updated_at, pair, [pair_symbol]
// SET  dex:pair:latest_pool:{mintA/mintB} -> {POOL}
// SET  dex:pair_symbol:latest_pool:{SYM_A/SYM_B} -> {POOL}    (only if both symbols known)
// HSET dex:mint:{MINT} => decimals, [symbol], [name], updated_at

use anyhow::{bail, Context, Result};
use log::info;
use chrono::Utc;
use clap::{Parser, ArgAction};
use dotenv::dotenv;
use lru::LruCache;
use redis::{aio::MultiplexedConnection, AsyncCommands, pipe};
use reqwest::Client;
use serde::Deserialize;
use serde_json::json;
use std::{num::NonZeroUsize, time::Duration};

#[derive(Debug, Parser)]
#[command(author, version, about = "Shyft backfill: Whirlpool pools + mint metadata → Redis (with LRU)")]
struct Args {
    /// Shyft API key
    #[arg(long, env = "SHYFT_API_KEY")]
    shyft_api_key: String,

    /// Network: devnet | mainnet-beta
    #[arg(long, env = "SHYFT_NETWORK", default_value = "mainnet-beta")]
    network: String,

    /// Redis URL
    #[arg(long, env = "REDIS_URL", default_value = "redis://127.0.0.1:6379/0")]
    redis_url: String,

    /// Page size (client-side truncation)
    #[arg(long, default_value_t = 250)]
    page_size: usize,

    /// Max pages to fetch
    #[arg(long, default_value_t = 200)]
    max_pages: usize,

    /// Only pull pools where either mint equals this address
    #[arg(long)]
    mint_filter: Option<String>,

    /// LRU capacity for mint metadata
    #[arg(long, default_value_t = 1024)]
    mint_cache_cap: usize,

    /// Dry run (don’t write to Redis)
    #[arg(long, action = ArgAction::SetTrue)]
    dry_run: bool,
}

// ---------- Shyft endpoints ----------
fn graphql_endpoint(api_key: &str, network: &str) -> String {
    format!("https://programs.shyft.to/v0/graphql/?api_key={api_key}&network={network}")
}
fn token_info_url(network: &str, mint: &str) -> String {
    format!("https://api.shyft.to/sol/v1/token/get_info?network={network}&token_address={mint}")
}

// ---------- Models ----------
#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct GraphQLResponse<T> { data: T }

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct WhirlpoolRows { #[serde(rename = "ORCA_WHIRLPOOLS_whirlpool")] rows: Vec<PoolRow> }

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, Clone)]
struct PoolRow {
    pubkey: String,
    tokenMintA: String,
    tokenMintB: String,
    feeRate: i64,
    tickCurrentIndex: i32,
    sqrtPrice: String, // Shyft returns as string
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct ShyftTokenInfoResp { success: bool, result: Option<ShyftTokenInfo>, message: Option<String> }
#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, Clone)]
struct ShyftTokenInfo { address: String, decimals: u8, #[serde(default)] symbol: Option<String>, #[serde(default)] name: Option<String> }

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct MintMeta { decimals: u8, symbol: Option<String>, name: Option<String> }

// ---------- LRU cache for mint metadata ----------
struct MintCache {
    lru: LruCache<String, MintMeta>,
    client: Client,
    api_key: String,
    network: String,
}
impl MintCache {
    fn new(cap: usize, client: Client, api_key: String, network: String) -> Self {
        let cap = NonZeroUsize::new(cap.max(16)).unwrap();
        Self { lru: LruCache::new(cap), client, api_key, network }
    }
    async fn get(&mut self, mint: &str) -> Result<MintMeta> {
        if let Some(v) = self.lru.get(mint).cloned() { return Ok(v); }
        let url = token_info_url(&self.network, mint);
        let resp = self.client
            .get(&url)
            .header("x-api-key", &self.api_key)
            .timeout(Duration::from_secs(10))
            .send().await?.error_for_status()?;
        let info: ShyftTokenInfoResp = resp.json().await?;
        let r = info.result.ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("No token info for {mint}: {:?}", info.message))?;
        let meta = MintMeta { decimals: r.decimals, symbol: r.symbol, name: r.name };
        self.lru.put(mint.to_string(), meta.clone());
        Ok(meta)
    }
}

// ---------- GraphQL page pull ----------
async fn backfill_page(
    http: &Client,
    redis: &mut MultiplexedConnection,
    endpoint: &str,
    mint_cache: &mut MintCache,
    offset: usize,
    page_size: usize,
    mint_filter: &Option<String>,
    dry_run: bool,
) -> Result<usize> {
    // Build filter (liquidity > 0 is a good heuristic; Shyft supports where/order_by/offset)
    let where_clause = if let Some(m) = mint_filter {
        format!(r#"where: {{ _and: [ {{ liquidity: {{ _gt: "0" }} }}, {{ _or: [ {{ tokenMintA: {{ _eq: "{m}" }} }}, {{ tokenMintB: {{ _eq: "{m}" }} }} ] }} ] }}"#)
    } else {
        r#"where: { liquidity: { _gt: "0" } }"#.to_string()
    };

    let query = format!(r#"
        query Pools($offset: Int!) {{
          ORCA_WHIRLPOOLS_whirlpool(
            {where_clause}
            order_by: {{ liquidity: desc }}
            offset: $offset
          ) {{
            pubkey
            tokenMintA
            tokenMintB
            feeRate
            tickCurrentIndex
            sqrtPrice
          }}
        }}
    "#, where_clause = where_clause);

    #[derive(serde::Serialize)]
    struct Body<'a> { query: &'a str, variables: serde_json::Value }
    let body = Body { query: &query, variables: json!({ "offset": offset as i64 }) };

    let resp: GraphQLResponse<WhirlpoolRows> = http
        .post(endpoint)
        .json(&body)
        .timeout(Duration::from_secs(20))
        .send().await?.error_for_status()?
        .json().await?;

    let mut rows = resp.data.rows;
    if rows.is_empty() { return Ok(0); }
    if rows.len() > page_size { rows.truncate(page_size); }

    for pool in rows {
        // LRU-backed mint metadata
        let a = mint_cache.get(&pool.tokenMintA).await?;
        let b = mint_cache.get(&pool.tokenMintB).await?;

        let pair_addr = format!("{}/{}", pool.tokenMintA, pool.tokenMintB);
        let pair_sym = match (&a.symbol, &b.symbol) {
            (Some(sa), Some(sb)) if !sa.is_empty() && !sb.is_empty() => Some(format!("{}/{}", sa, sb)),
            _ => None,
        };

        if dry_run {
            info!("DRY: pool={} pair={} decA={} decB={} symA={:?} symB={:?}",
                pool.pubkey, pair_addr, a.decimals, b.decimals, a.symbol, b.symbol);
            continue;
        }

        // Single pipeline per pool: write pool hash, pair mappings, and both mint metas
        let now = Utc::now().timestamp();
        let pool_key = format!("dex:pool:{}", pool.pubkey);
        let mint_a_key = format!("dex:mint:{}", pool.tokenMintA);
        let mint_b_key = format!("dex:mint:{}", pool.tokenMintB);

        let mut p = pipe();
        // Pool snapshot
        p.cmd("HSET").arg(&pool_key)
            .arg("mint_a").arg(&pool.tokenMintA)
            .arg("mint_b").arg(&pool.tokenMintB)
            .arg("decimals_a").arg(a.decimals as i64)
            .arg("decimals_b").arg(b.decimals as i64)
            .arg("fee_bps").arg(pool.feeRate as i64)
            .arg("sqrt_price_x64").arg(&pool.sqrtPrice)
            .arg("tick").arg(pool.tickCurrentIndex as i64)
            .arg("updated_at").arg(now)
            .arg("pair").arg(&pair_addr);
        if let Some(ps) = &pair_sym { p.arg("pair_symbol").arg(ps); }

        // Pair mappings
        p.cmd("SET").arg(format!("dex:pair:latest_pool:{}", pair_addr)).arg(&pool.pubkey).ignore();
        if let Some(ps) = &pair_sym {
            p.cmd("SET").arg(format!("dex:pair_symbol:latest_pool:{}", ps)).arg(&pool.pubkey).ignore();
        }

        // Mint A meta
        p.cmd("HSET").arg(&mint_a_key)
            .arg("decimals").arg(a.decimals as i64)
            .arg("updated_at").arg(now);
        if let Some(sym) = &a.symbol { p.arg("symbol").arg(sym); }
        if let Some(name) = &a.name { p.arg("name").arg(name); }

        // Mint B meta
        p.cmd("HSET").arg(&mint_b_key)
            .arg("decimals").arg(b.decimals as i64)
            .arg("updated_at").arg(now);
        if let Some(sym) = &b.symbol { p.arg("symbol").arg(sym); }
        if let Some(name) = &b.name { p.arg("name").arg(name); }

        p.ignore();
        p.query_async::<()>(&mut *redis).await
            .with_context(|| format!("redis write failed for pool {}", pool.pubkey))?;
    }

    Ok(page_size)
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    dotenv().ok();
    env_logger::init();
    let args = Args::parse();

    let http = Client::builder()
        .user_agent("shyft-backfill/1.0")
        .pool_idle_timeout(Duration::from_secs(30))
        .build()?;

    let endpoint = graphql_endpoint(&args.shyft_api_key, &args.network);

    // Redis connect
    let redis_client = redis::Client::open(args.redis_url.clone())?;
    let mut redis_conn: MultiplexedConnection = redis_client
        .get_multiplexed_tokio_connection().await?;

    // LRU for mint meta
    let mut mint_cache = MintCache::new(
        args.mint_cache_cap,
        http.clone(),
        args.shyft_api_key.clone(),
        args.network.clone(),
    );

    let mut total = 0usize;
    for page in 0..args.max_pages {
        let offset = page * args.page_size;
        let got = backfill_page(
            &http,
            &mut redis_conn,
            &endpoint,
            &mut mint_cache,
            offset,
            args.page_size,
            &args.mint_filter,
            args.dry_run,
        ).await.with_context(|| format!("pull failed at offset {}", offset))?;

        if got == 0 { break; }
        total += got;
        println!("wrote {} pools (page {}, offset {})", total, page + 1, offset);
        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(200)).await; // be polite
    }

    println!("backfill complete: {} pools", total);
    Ok(())
}
```

```rust
use anyhow::Result;
use backoff::{future::retry, ExponentialBackoff};
use clap::Parser;
use dotenv::dotenv;
use env_logger;
use futures_util::{sink::SinkExt, stream::StreamExt, TryFutureExt};
use log::{error, info};
use rdkafka::producer::{FutureProducer, FutureRecord};
use rdkafka::ClientConfig;
use std::time::Duration;
use tonic::transport::channel::ClientTlsConfig;
use yellowstone_grpc_client::{GeyserGrpcClient, Interceptor};
use yellowstone_grpc_proto::{
    geyser::SubscribeRequestFilterTransactions,
    prelude::{
        subscribe_update::UpdateOneof, CommitmentLevel, SubscribeRequest, SubscribeRequestPing,
    },
    prost::Message as _,
};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Parser)]
#[command(author, version, about)]
struct Args {
    #[arg(short, long)]
    broker: Option<String>,
    #[arg(short, long, help = "Output topic", default_value = "geyser.raw")]
    topic: String,
    #[arg(short, long)]
    endpoint: Option<String>,
    #[arg(long)]
    x_token: Option<String>,
    #[arg(long, help = "Comma-separated list of program ids")]
    program_ids: Option<String>,
}

type TxnFilterMap = std::collections::HashMap<String, SubscribeRequestFilterTransactions>;

fn build_request(program_ids: Vec<String>) -> SubscribeRequest {
    let mut transactions: TxnFilterMap = std::collections::HashMap::new();
    transactions.insert(
        "client".to_owned(),
        SubscribeRequestFilterTransactions {
            vote: Some(false),
            failed: Some(false),
            account_include: program_ids,
            account_exclude: vec![],
            account_required: vec![],
            signature: None,
        },
    );
    SubscribeRequest {
        accounts: Default::default(),
        slots: Default::default(),
        transactions,
        transactions_status: Default::default(),
        blocks: Default::default(),
        blocks_meta: Default::default(),
        entry: Default::default(),
        commitment: Some(CommitmentLevel::Processed as i32),
        accounts_data_slice: vec![],
        ping: None,
        from_slot: None,
    }
}

fn create_producer(broker: &str, fast_mode: bool) -> Result<FutureProducer> {
    let mut config = ClientConfig::new();
    config.set("bootstrap.servers", broker);
    if fast_mode {
        config
            .set("linger.ms", "0")
            .set("acks", "1")
            .set("compression.type", "lz4")
            .set("enable.idempotence", "false")
            .set("message.timeout.ms", "100");
    } else {
        config
            .set("enable.idempotence", "true")
            .set("compression.type", "lz4")
            .set("acks", "all")
            .set("linger.ms", "5");
    }
    let p: FutureProducer = config.create()?;
    Ok(p)
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    dotenv().ok();
    env_logger::init();
    let args = Args::parse();

    let broker = args
        .broker
        .or_else(|| std::env::var("KAFKA_BROKER").ok())
        .expect("KAFKA_BROKER");
    let topic = args.topic;
    let endpoint = args
        .endpoint
        .or_else(|| std::env::var("ENDPOINT").ok())
        .expect("ENDPOINT");
    let x_token = args
        .x_token
        .or_else(|| std::env::var("X_TOKEN").ok())
        .expect("X_TOKEN");
    let program_ids_csv = args
        .program_ids
        .or_else(|| std::env::var("PROGRAM_IDS").ok())
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let program_ids: Vec<String> = program_ids_csv
        .split(',')
        .map(|s| s.trim().to_string())
        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
        .collect();

    info!(
        "universal stream: broker={broker} topic={topic} endpoint={endpoint} pids={:?}",
        program_ids
    );

    let fast_mode = std::env::var("FAST_MODE").ok().as_deref() == Some("1");
    let producer = create_producer(&broker, fast_mode)?;

    retry(ExponentialBackoff::default(), move || {
        let producer = producer.clone();
        let endpoint = endpoint.clone();
        let x_token = x_token.clone();
        let topic = topic.clone();
        let request = build_request(program_ids.clone());

        async move {
            let mut client = GeyserGrpcClient::build_from_shared(endpoint.clone())
                .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?
                .x_token(Some(x_token.clone()))
                .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?
                .connect_timeout(Duration::from_secs(10))
                .timeout(Duration::from_secs(10))
                .tls_config(ClientTlsConfig::new().with_native_roots())
                .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?
                .max_decoding_message_size(1024 * 1024 * 1024)
                .connect()
                .await
                .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;

            let (mut subscribe_tx, mut stream) =
                client.subscribe_with_request(Some(request)).await?;
            info!("stream opened");
            while let Some(msg) = stream.next().await {
                match msg {
                    Ok(update_msg) => match update_msg.update_oneof {
                        Some(UpdateOneof::Transaction(update)) => {
                            let mut buf = Vec::new();
                            update.encode(&mut buf)?;
                            let _ = producer
                                .send(
                                    FutureRecord::<(), _>::to(&topic).payload(&buf),
                                    Duration::from_secs(10),
                                )
                                .await;
                        }
                        Some(UpdateOneof::Ping(_)) => {
                            let _ = subscribe_tx
                                .send(SubscribeRequest {
                                    ping: Some(SubscribeRequestPing { id: 1 }),
                                    ..Default::default()
                                })
                                .await;
                        }
                        _ => {}
                    },
                    Err(e) => {
                        error!("stream error: {e:?}");
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            info!("stream closed");
            Ok::<(), anyhow::Error>(())
        }
        .map_err(backoff::Error::transient)
    })
    .await?;

    Ok(())
}
```

```dockercompose
      - CONNECTION_TIMEOUT=30
```
