```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Parser)]
#[clap(author, version, about)]
struct AppArgs {
    /// Subscribe to ALL accounts owned by the Whirlpool program (debug only)
    #[arg(long, env = "OWNER_ONLY", action = ArgAction::SetTrue)]
    owner_only: bool,

    /// Include TickArray accounts (stored to a Redis stream)
    #[arg(long, env = "INCLUDE_TICKARRAYS", action = ArgAction::SetTrue)]
    include_tickarrays: bool,

    /// Include Position accounts (stored to a Redis stream)
    #[arg(long, env = "INCLUDE_POSITIONS", action = ArgAction::SetTrue)]
    include_positions: bool,

    /// Backfill starting slot (optional)
    #[arg(long, env = "FROM_SLOT")]
    from_slot: Option<u64>,
}

impl AppArgs {
    fn build_connection_args(&self) -> ConnArgs {
        let endpoint = env::var("ENDPOINT").expect("ENDPOINT not found in .env file");
        let x_token = env::var("X_TOKEN").expect("X_TOKEN not found in .env file");
        let redis_url = env::var("REDIS_URL").expect("REDIS_URL not found in .env file");
        
        ConnArgs { endpoint, x_token, redis_url }
    }

    fn build_subscribe_request(&self) -> SubscribeRequest {
        let mut accounts: AccountFilterMap = HashMap::new();

        // helper: owner + optional memcmp(0, disc)
        let mut push = |label: &str, owner: &str, disc: Option<[u8; 8]>| {
            let filters = match disc {
                Some(bytes8) => vec![SubscribeRequestFilterAccountsFilter {
                    filter: Some(AccountsFilterOneOf::Memcmp(
                        SubscribeRequestFilterAccountsFilterMemcmp {
                            offset: 0,
                            data: Some(MemcmpData::Bytes(bytes8.to_vec())),
                        },
                    )),
                }],
                None => vec![],
            };
            accounts.insert(
                label.to_string(),
                SubscribeRequestFilterAccounts {
                    account: vec![],
                    owner: vec![owner.to_string()],
                    nonempty_txn_signature: None,
                    filters,
                },
            );
        };

        if self.owner_only {
            // Firehose
            push("whirlpool_owner_only", WHIRLPOOL_PROGRAM_ID, None);
        } else {
            // Safe default: only Whirlpool POOL accounts (ok to IDL-parse)
            push("whirlpool_pools", WHIRLPOOL_PROGRAM_ID, Some(WHIRLPOOL_ACCOUNT_DISCM));
            if self.include_tickarrays {
                push("whirlpool_tickarrays", WHIRLPOOL_PROGRAM_ID, Some(TICK_ARRAY_ACCOUNT_DISCM));
            }
            if self.include_positions {
                push("whirlpool_positions", WHIRLPOOL_PROGRAM_ID, Some(POSITION_ACCOUNT_DISCM));
            }
        }

        SubscribeRequest {
            accounts,
            slots: HashMap::default(),
            transactions: HashMap::default(),
            transactions_status: HashMap::default(),
            blocks: HashMap::default(),
            blocks_meta: HashMap::default(),
            entry: HashMap::default(),
            commitment: Some(CommitmentLevel::Processed as i32),
            accounts_data_slice: Vec::default(),
            ping: None,
            from_slot: self.from_slot,
        }
    }
}

async fn main() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    dotenv().ok();
    
    // Set up logging
    env::set_var(
        env_logger::DEFAULT_FILTER_ENV,
        env::var_os(env_logger::DEFAULT_FILTER_ENV).unwrap_or_else(|| "info".into()),
    );
    env_logger::init();

    // At the start of your main function
    info!("🔍 Loading IDL files...");
    info!("📁 Current working directory: {:?}", std::env::current_dir()?);

    // Check if IDL files exist
    let idl_path = "idls/whirlpool_idl.json";
    if std::path::Path::new(idl_path).exists() {
        info!("✅ IDL file found: {}", idl_path);
    } else {
        error!("❌ IDL file not found: {}", idl_path);
    }

    // Read environment variables
    let endpoint = env::var("ENDPOINT").expect("ENDPOINT not found in .env file");
    let x_token = env::var("X_TOKEN").expect("X_TOKEN not found in .env file");
    let redis_url = env::var("REDIS_URL").expect("REDIS_URL not found in .env file");
    
    // Filter flags
    let flags = AppArgs::parse();

    let _zero_attempts = Arc::new(Mutex::new(true));

    // Display configuration at startup
    println!("🚀 Starting Whirlpool Account Updates Streamer");
    println!("================================================");
    println!("📡 Endpoint: {}", endpoint);
    println!("🔑 X-Token: {}...{}", &x_token[..8], &x_token[x_token.len()-4..]);
    println!("🗄️  Redis URL: {}", redis_url);
    println!("⚙️  Configuration:");
    println!("   Owner only mode: {}", flags.owner_only);
    println!("   Include tick arrays: {}", flags.include_tickarrays);
    println!("   Include positions: {}", flags.include_positions);
    if let Some(from_slot) = flags.from_slot {
        println!("   Starting from slot: {}", from_slot);
    } else {
        println!("   Starting from latest slot");
    }
    println!("================================================");

    info!("Starting Whirlpool streamer");
    info!("Endpoint: {}", endpoint);
    info!("Redis: {}", redis_url);
    info!("X-Token: {}", x_token);
    info!("Configuration flags: {:?}", flags);

    // Network creds
    let _conn_args = ConnArgs { endpoint, x_token, redis_url };

    // Simple retry loop for connection
    let mut attempts = 0;
    let max_attempts = 5;
    
    loop {
        attempts += 1;
        info!("🔄 Attempt {} of {}: Attempting to connect to geyser...", attempts, max_attempts);
        
        match try_connect(&flags).await {
            Ok(_) => {
                info!("✅ Connection and processing completed successfully");
                break;
            }
            Err(e) => {
                error!("❌ Attempt {} failed: {}", attempts, e);
                if attempts >= max_attempts {
                    error!("❌ Failed to establish connection after {} attempts", max_attempts);
                    return Err(e);
                }
                
                // Exponential backoff: wait longer between attempts
                let delay = std::cmp::min(1000 * (2_u64.pow(attempts as u32)), 30000);
                info!("⏳ Waiting {}ms before retry...", delay);
                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay)).await;
            }
        }
    }

    Ok(())
}

async fn try_connect(flags: &AppArgs) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    info!("🔌 Building connection arguments...");
    let conn_args = flags.build_connection_args();
    
    info!("📡 Connection details:");
    info!("   Endpoint: {}", conn_args.endpoint);
    info!("   X-Token: {}...{}", 
        &conn_args.x_token[..8], 
        &conn_args.x_token[conn_args.x_token.len()-4..]
    );
    info!("   Redis URL: {}", conn_args.redis_url);
    
    info!("🔄 Attempting to connect to geyser...");
    info!("   Setting connection timeout: 20s");
    info!("   Setting request timeout: 20s");
    info!("   Max message size: 1GB");
    
    let client = match conn_args.connect().await {
        Ok(client) => {
            info!("✅ Successfully connected to geyser!");
            client
        }
        Err(e) => {
            error!("❌ Failed to connect to geyser");
            error!("🔍 Connection error details: {:#?}", e);
            error!("📡 Endpoint: {}", conn_args.endpoint);
            error!("🔑 X-Token: {}...{}", 
                &conn_args.x_token[..8], 
                &conn_args.x_token[conn_args.x_token.len()-4..]
            );
            
            // Check if it's a TLS/certificate issue
            if e.to_string().contains("certificate") || e.to_string().contains("UnknownIssuer") {
                error!("🔒 TLS Certificate Issue Detected");
                error!("💡 This might be a certificate validation problem with the endpoint");
                error!("💡 Try checking if the endpoint URL is correct or if there are certificate issues");
            }
            
            // Check if it's a network issue
            if e.to_string().contains("transport") {
                error!("🌐 Network/Transport Issue Detected");
                error!("💡 Check your internet connection and firewall settings");
            }
            
            // Check if it's an authentication issue
            if e.to_string().contains("Unauthenticated") || e.to_string().contains("Invalid") {
                error!("🔐 Authentication Issue Detected");
                error!("💡 Check if your X-Token is valid and not expired");
                error!("💡 Verify your Shyft account status and API limits");
            }
            
            return Err(e);
        }
    };
    
    info!("📋 Building subscribe request...");
    let request = flags.build_subscribe_request();
    info!("   Account filters: {:?}", request.accounts.keys().collect::<Vec<_>>());
    info!("   Commitment level: {:?}", request.commitment);
    if let Some(from_slot) = request.from_slot {
        info!("   Starting from slot: {}", from_slot);
    }
    
    info!("🚀 Starting geyser subscription...");
    geyser_subscribe(client, request, &conn_args.redis_url, flags).await?;
    
    info!("✅ Geyser subscription completed successfully");
    Ok(())
}

async fn geyser_subscribe(
    mut client: GeyserGrpcClient<impl Interceptor>,
    request: SubscribeRequest,
    redis_url: &str,
    flags: &AppArgs,
) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    let (mut _tx, mut stream) = client.subscribe_with_request(Some(request)).await?;
    info!("stream opened");

    let redis_client = redis::Client::open(redis_url)?;
    let mut redis_conn: MultiplexedConnection = redis_client
        .get_multiplexed_tokio_connection()
        .await?;

    let pong: String = redis::cmd("PING").query_async(&mut redis_conn).await.unwrap_or_else(|_| "PONG".to_string());
    info!("Redis ping: {}", pong);

    // // Test Redis connection with a simple command
    // let pong: String = redis_conn.get("test_connection").await.unwrap_or_else(|_| "connected".to_string());
    // info!("Redis connection test: {}", pong);

    // In-process cache for mint metadata
    let mut mint_cache = MintCache::new(1024);

    // Redis client
    let redis_client = redis::Client::open(redis_url)?;
    let mut redis_conn: MultiplexedConnection = redis_client
        .get_multiplexed_tokio_connection()
        .await?;


    while let Some(message) = stream.next().await {
        match message {
            Ok(msg) => match msg.update_oneof {
                Some(UpdateOneof::Account(account)) => {
                    if let Err(e) = handle_account_update(&mut redis_conn, flags, &mut mint_cache, &account ).await {
                        error!("handle_account_update error: {e:?}");
                    }
                }
                Some(UpdateOneof::Ping(_)) => {
                    // no-op; some servers send ping/pong automatically
                }
                _ => {}
            },
            Err(e) => {
                error!("stream error: {e:?}");
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    info!("stream closed");
    Ok(())
}

async fn handle_account_update(
    redis: &mut MultiplexedConnection,
    flags: &AppArgs,
    mint_cache: &mut MintCache,
    upd: &SubscribeUpdateAccount
) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    let Some(acct) = &upd.account else { return Ok(()); };
    let data: &[u8] = &acct.data;
    if data.len() < 8 { return Ok(()); }

    let disc = &data[..8];

    // Only IDL-parse Whirlpool pools
    if disc == WHIRLPOOL_ACCOUNT_DISCM {
        let whirlpool_acc = WhirlpoolAccount::deserialize(data)
            .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("WhirlpoolAccount::deserialize: {e}"))?;
        let whirlpool: Whirlpool = whirlpool_acc.0;
    
        let pool_pubkey = bs58::encode(&acct.pubkey).into_string();
        let mint_a = whirlpool.token_mint_a.to_string();
        let mint_b = whirlpool.token_mint_b.to_string();
    
        // Pull decimals/symbols from Redis (w/ in-process LRU)
        let meta_a = mint_cache.get_from_redis(redis, &mint_a).await?;
        let meta_b = mint_cache.get_from_redis(redis, &mint_b).await?;
    
        let pair_symbol = match (&meta_a.symbol, &meta_b.symbol) {
            (Some(sa), Some(sb)) if !sa.is_empty() && !sb.is_empty() => Some(format!("{}/{}", sa, sb)),
            _ => None,
        };
    
        // Write full snapshot including decimals (+ optional pair_symbol)
        cache_whirlpool_snapshot(
            redis,
            &pool_pubkey,
            &whirlpool,
            meta_a.decimals,
            meta_b.decimals,
            pair_symbol.as_deref(),
            upd.slot,
        ).await?;
    
        // Optional verification
        let pool_key = format!("dex:pool:{pool_pubkey}");
        let snap: HashMap<String, String> = redis.hgetall(&pool_key).await?;
        info!("cached {}", pool_key);
        if let (Some(sp), Some(t)) = (snap.get("sqrt_price_x64"), snap.get("tick")) {
            info!("  sqrt_price_x64={} tick={}", sp, t);
        }
        return Ok(());
    }
    

    // Optionally stash TickArrays / Positions
    let now = Utc::now().timestamp();
    if flags.include_tickarrays && disc == TICK_ARRAY_ACCOUNT_DISCM {
        // Parse and emit a compact summary for depth builder
        let tick_array = TickArrayAccount::deserialize(data)
            .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("TickArrayAccount::deserialize: {e}"))?;
        let ta = tick_array.0;
        let pool_pubkey = ta.whirlpool.to_string();
        let start_tick = ta.start_tick_index as i64;
        let mut num_initialized: i64 = 0;
        let mut sum_gross: u128 = 0;
        for t in ta.ticks.iter() {
            if t.initialized {
                num_initialized += 1;
                sum_gross = sum_gross.saturating_add(t.liquidity_gross);
            }
        }
        let array_pubkey = bs58::encode(&upd.account.as_ref().unwrap().pubkey).into_string();

        let _id: String = redis::cmd("XADD")
            .arg("dex:whirlpool:tickarray_updates").arg("*")
            .arg("slot").arg(upd.slot as i64)
            .arg("pool").arg(&pool_pubkey)
            .arg("array").arg(&array_pubkey)
            .arg("start").arg(start_tick)
            .arg("num_init").arg(num_initialized)
            .arg("sum_gross").arg(sum_gross.to_string())
            .arg("ts").arg(now)
            .query_async(redis).await?;
        return Ok(());
    }

    if flags.include_positions && disc == POSITION_ACCOUNT_DISCM {
        let _id: String = redis::cmd("XADD")
            .arg("dex:whirlpool:position_updates").arg("*")
            .arg("slot").arg(upd.slot as i64)
            .arg("len").arg(data.len() as i64)
            .arg("ts").arg(now)
            .query_async(redis).await?;
        return Ok(());
    }

    // If --owner-only, you will see many other accounts; ignore by default
    Ok(())
}

/// Writes a single "latest snapshot" for a Whirlpool pool into Redis.
/// Creates the keys if they do not exist (Redis is schemaless).
/// Writes a single \"latest snapshot\" for a Whirlpool pool into Redis.
pub async fn cache_whirlpool_snapshot(
    redis_conn: &mut MultiplexedConnection,
    pool_pubkey: &str,
    whirlpool: &Whirlpool,
    decimals_a: u8,
    decimals_b: u8,
    pair_symbol: Option<&str>,
    slot: u64,
) -> redis::RedisResult<()> {
    let pool_key = format!("dex:pool:{pool_pubkey}");

    let mint_a = whirlpool.token_mint_a.to_string();
    let mint_b = whirlpool.token_mint_b.to_string();
    let fee_bps = whirlpool.fee_rate as i64;
    let sqrt_price_x64 = whirlpool.sqrt_price.to_string();
    let tick = whirlpool.tick_current_index as i64;
    let pair = format!("{mint_a}/{mint_b}");
    let now = Utc::now().timestamp();

    let mut p = pipe();
    p.cmd("HSET").arg(&pool_key)
        .arg("mint_a").arg(&mint_a)
        .arg("mint_b").arg(&mint_b)
        .arg("decimals_a").arg(decimals_a as i64)
        .arg("decimals_b").arg(decimals_b as i64)
        .arg("fee_bps").arg(fee_bps)
        .arg("sqrt_price_x64").arg(sqrt_price_x64)
        .arg("tick").arg(tick)
        .arg("updated_slot").arg(slot as i64)
        .arg("updated_at").arg(now)
        .arg("pair").arg(&pair);

    if let Some(ps) = pair_symbol {
        p.arg("pair_symbol").arg(ps);
        // symbol-based mapping too (if both symbols known)
        p.cmd("SET").arg(format!("dex:pair_symbol:latest_pool:{ps}")).arg(pool_pubkey).ignore();
    }

    // address-based pair mapping
    p.cmd("SET").arg(format!("dex:pair:latest_pool:{pair}")).arg(pool_pubkey).ignore();

    // Use explicit generic for older redis versions; both are fine:
    p.query_async::<()>(&mut *redis_conn).await
}
```

```rust
use anyhow::Result;
use dotenv::dotenv;
use env_logger;
use log::{info, warn};
use redis::AsyncCommands;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    dotenv().ok();
    env_logger::init();

    let redis_url = std::env::var("REDIS_URL").unwrap_or_else(|_| "redis://127.0.0.1:6379/0".into());
    let client = redis::Client::open(redis_url.clone())?;
    let mut conn = client.get_multiplexed_tokio_connection().await?;
    info!("depth-builder: redis={}", redis_url);

    // Simple loop: read from XREAD on tickarray stream; compute/update per-pool summaries
    // Stream: dex:whirlpool:tickarray_updates
    let mut last_id = String::from("$"); // start now; change to "0" for history
    loop {
        let resp: redis::Value = redis::cmd("XREAD").arg("BLOCK").arg(5000).arg("STREAMS").arg("dex:whirlpool:tickarray_updates").arg(&last_id).query_async(&mut conn).await.unwrap_or(redis::Value::Nil);
        match resp {
            redis::Value::Bulk(mut streams) if !streams.is_empty() => {
                // streams = [ [stream_key, [ [id, [field, val, ...]], ...]] ]
                if let Some(entries) = streams.pop() {
                    if let redis::Value::Bulk(mut v) = entries {
                        // v[0] = stream key, v[1] = entries
                        if v.len() >= 2 {
                            if let redis::Value::Bulk(items) = v.remove(1) {
                                for item in items {
                                    if let redis::Value::Bulk(mut pair) = item {
                                        if pair.len() == 2 {
                                            let id = if let redis::Value::Data(b) = &pair[0] { String::from_utf8_lossy(b).to_string() } else { continue };
                                            last_id = id.clone();
                                            // fields
                                            let mut pool = String::new();
                                            let mut start: i64 = 0;
                                            let mut num_init: i64 = 0;
                                            let mut sum_gross = String::new();
                                            if let redis::Value::Bulk(kvs) = &pair[1] {
                                                let mut it = kvs.iter();
                                                while let (Some(k), Some(v)) = (it.next(), it.next()) {
                                                    let key = match k { redis::Value::Data(b) => String::from_utf8_lossy(b).to_string(), _ => continue };
                                                    match key.as_str() {
                                                        "pool" => if let redis::Value::Data(b) = v { pool = String::from_utf8_lossy(b).to_string() },
                                                        "start" => if let redis::Value::Data(b) = v { start = String::from_utf8_lossy(b).parse().unwrap_or(0) },
                                                        "num_init" => if let redis::Value::Data(b) = v { num_init = String::from_utf8_lossy(b).parse().unwrap_or(0) },
                                                        "sum_gross" => if let redis::Value::Data(b) = v { sum_gross = String::from_utf8_lossy(b).to_string() },
                                                        _ => {}
                                                    }
                                                }
                                            }
                                            if pool.is_empty() { continue; }
                                            // Update summary key per pool
                                            let key = format!("dex:pool_depth:{}", pool);
                                            let _: () = redis::cmd("HSET")
                                                .arg(&key)
                                                .arg("last_start").arg(start)
                                                .arg("last_num_init").arg(num_init)
                                                .arg("last_sum_gross").arg(&sum_gross)
                                                .query_async(&mut conn).await.unwrap_or(());
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            redis::Value::Nil => {
                // timeout; loop
            }
            other => {
                warn!("unexpected XREAD response: {:?}", other);
            }
        }
    }
}


```

```dockercompose
# =============================================================================

      ZOOKEEPER_TICK_TIME: 2000
      ZOOKEEPER_MAX_CLIENT_CNXNS: 60
      ZOOKEEPER_SYNC_LIMIT: 2

      test: ["CMD", "bash", "-c", "echo stat | nc localhost 2181"]

    networks:

      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: price-aggregator:latest
    container_name: price-aggregator
    environment:
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      - IN_TOPIC=${AGG_IN_TOPIC:-orca-swaps.parsed.v2}
      - OUT_TOPIC=${AGG_OUT_TOPIC:-prices.latest}
      - GROUP_ID=${AGG_GROUP_ID:-price-aggregator}
      - EMIT_SECS=${AGG_EMIT_SECS:-5}
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped

networks:
  mevana_net:
    external: true
    name: mevana_net

volumes:
  postgres_data:
    driver: local
  prometheus_data:
    driver: local
  grafana_data:
    driver: local
  cargo_cache:
    driver: local
  target_cache:
    driver: local

```

```dockerfile
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM rust:1.83 as builder
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y cmake build-essential pkg-config && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
WORKDIR /app
# Build from workspace root with .dockerignore trimming the context
COPY . .
RUN cargo build --release -p normalizer-service --bin tap_orca_extract --bin depth_builder

FROM debian:bookworm-slim as runtime
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y ca-certificates && update-ca-certificates && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /app/target/release/tap_orca_extract /usr/local/bin/normalizer-extract
COPY --from=builder /app/target/release/depth_builder /usr/local/bin/depth-builder
ENV RUST_LOG=info
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/normalizer-extract"]



```

```dockercompose
# =============================================================================
# SOLANA AI TRADING PLATFORM - ENHANCED DOCKER COMPOSE
# =============================================================================
# Enhanced version with improved connectivity, monitoring, and resource management

services:
  # =============================================================================
  # INFRASTRUCTURE SERVICES
  # =============================================================================
  
  zookeeper:
    image: confluentinc/cp-zookeeper:7.4.0
    container_name: zookeeper
    environment:
      ZOOKEEPER_CLIENT_PORT: 2181
      ZOOKEEPER_TICK_TIME: 2000
      ZOOKEEPER_MAX_CLIENT_CNXNS: 60
      ZOOKEEPER_SYNC_LIMIT: 2
      ZOOKEEPER_INIT_LIMIT: 5
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "bash", "-c", "echo stat | nc localhost 2181"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 10s
    ports:
      - "2181:2181"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'

  kafka:
    image: confluentinc/cp-kafka:7.4.0
    container_name: kafka
    depends_on:
      zookeeper:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      KAFKA_BROKER_ID: 1
      KAFKA_ZOOKEEPER_CONNECT: zookeeper:2181
      KAFKA_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://0.0.0.0:9092,PLAINTEXT_HOST://0.0.0.0:29092
      KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://kafka:9092,PLAINTEXT_HOST://host.docker.internal:29092
      KAFKA_LISTENER_SECURITY_PROTOCOL_MAP: PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,PLAINTEXT_HOST:PLAINTEXT
      KAFKA_INTER_BROKER_LISTENER_NAME: PLAINTEXT
      KAFKA_AUTO_CREATE_TOPICS_ENABLE: "true"
      KAFKA_OFFSETS_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
      KAFKA_HEAP_OPTS: "-Xmx1G -Xms1G"
      KAFKA_LOG_RETENTION_HOURS: 168
      KAFKA_LOG_SEGMENT_BYTES: 1073741824
      KAFKA_NUM_PARTITIONS: 3
      KAFKA_DEFAULT_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
      KAFKA_MIN_INSYNC_REPLICAS: 1
      KAFKA_DELETE_TOPIC_ENABLE: "true"
    ports:
      - "9092:9092"
      - "29092:29092"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "kafka-topics --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 --list"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2G
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '0.5'

  kafka-ui:
    image: provectuslabs/kafka-ui:latest
    container_name: kafka-ui
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    environment:
      KAFKA_CLUSTERS_0_NAME: local
      KAFKA_CLUSTERS_0_BOOTSTRAPSERVERS: kafka:9092
      KAFKA_CLUSTERS_0_READONLY: false
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--no-verbose", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:8080/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:

          memory: 256M

  dex-stream-universal:

    image: dex-stream-universal:latest
    container_name: dex-stream-universal
    depends_on:

        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      - ENDPOINT=${SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT}
      - X_TOKEN=${SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN}
      - PROGRAM_IDS=${PROGRAM_IDS:-whirLbMiicVdio4qvUfM5KAg6Ct8VwpYzGff3uctyCc,675kPX9MHTjS2zt1qfr1NYHuzeLXfQM9H24wFSUt1Mp8,cpamdpZCGKUy5JxQXB4dcpGPiikHawvSWAd6mEn1sGG}
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}

    command: ["--topic","orca-swaps"]
    networks:

  redis:

    logging:

  graphql-backfill:
    build:
      context: ../../crates/graphql-backfill

    image: graphql-backfill:latest
    container_name: graphql-backfill
    environment:

  dex-backfill:

    environment:

  normalizer-extract:
    build:

      - GROUP_ID=${GROUP_ID:-tap-orca-extract}
      - REDIS_URL=${REDIS_URL:-redis://redis:6379/0}
      - FAST_MODE=${FAST_MODE:-1}

  depth-builder:

  # =============================================================================

  stream-orca:

      - SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN=${SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN}

      - METRICS_PORT=9090

      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}
      - HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL=30
      - CONNECTION_TIMEOUT=30
      - RECONNECT_DELAY=5
      - ENABLE_TIMER=${ENABLE_TIMER:-false}
      - TIMER_DURATION_SECONDS=${TIMER_DURATION_SECONDS:-20}
      - PROGRAM_IDS=${PROGRAM_IDS:-whirLbMiicVdio4qvUfM5KAg6Ct8VwpYzGff3uctyCc}

      - "9094:9090"
    networks:

  stream-raydium:
    build:
      context: ../stream-raydium
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: runtime
      args:
        BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE: 1
    image: arbitrage-stream-raydium:latest
    container_name: stream-raydium
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      - SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT=${SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT}
      - SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN=${SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN}
      - LOG_LEVEL=${LOG_LEVEL:-info}
      - METRICS_PORT=9090
      - IDL_PATH=/app
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}
      - HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL=30

        condition: service_healthy

      - MIN_PROFIT_THRESHOLD=${MIN_PROFIT_THRESHOLD:-1.001}

      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}

    ports:
      - "9094:9090"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "pgrep", "-f", "swap-ingest"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 15s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'

  data-stream-processor:
    build:
      context: ../data-stream-processor
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      args:
        BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE: 1
    image: data-stream-processor:latest
    container_name: data-stream-processor

    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "ps aux | grep data-stream-processor | grep -v grep || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 15s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
          cpus: '0.1'

  pathfinder:
    build:
      context: ../Arbitrage/solana-arbitrage/pathfinder
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: runtime
      args:
        BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE: 1
    image: arbitrage-pathfinder:latest
    container_name: pathfinder
    depends_on:
      swap-ingest:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      - LOG_LEVEL=${LOG_LEVEL:-info}
      - MIN_PROFIT_THRESHOLD=${MIN_PROFIT_THRESHOLD:-1.001}
      - MAX_PATH_LENGTH=${MAX_PATH_LENGTH:-5}
      - SCAN_INTERVAL_SECONDS=${SCAN_INTERVAL_SECONDS:-1}
      - METRICS_PORT=9090
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info}
      - HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL=30
      - MAX_CONCURRENT_PATHS=100
      - PATH_CACHE_TTL=300
    ports:
      - "9095:9090"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "pgrep", "-f", "pathfinder"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 15s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'

  # =============================================================================
  # MONITORING & DEBUGGING
  # =============================================================================

  redis-viewer:
    build:
      context: ../Arbitrage/solana-arbitrage/redis-viewer
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      args:
        BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE: 1
    image: arbitrage-redis-viewer:latest
    container_name: redis-viewer
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      - PORT=5001
      - REFRESH_INTERVAL=5
    ports:
      - "5001:5001"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--no-verbose", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:5001/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
          cpus: '0.1'

  # Prometheus for metrics collection
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:latest
    container_name: prometheus
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--web.console.libraries=/etc/prometheus/console_libraries'
      - '--web.console.templates=/etc/prometheus/consoles'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=200h'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--no-verbose", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:9090/-/healthy"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'

  # Grafana for metrics visualization
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:latest
    container_name: grafana
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin123
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
    volumes:
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
      - ./grafana/dashboards:/etc/grafana/provisioning/dashboards
      - ./grafana/datasources:/etc/grafana/provisioning/datasources
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      prometheus:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--no-verbose", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:3000/api/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'

  # =============================================================================
  # DATABASE SERVICES
  # =============================================================================

  postgres:
    image: postgres:15
    container_name: postgres
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-mev}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-mevpassword}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-mevdb}
      POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS: "--encoding=UTF-8 --lc-collate=C --lc-ctype=C"
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./migrations:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-mev} -d ${POSTGRES_DB:-mevdb}"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 10s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.25'

  adminer:
    image: adminer
    container_name: adminer
    ports:
      - "8082:8080"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--no-verbose", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:8080/"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
          cpus: '0.1'

  # =============================================================================
  # DEVELOPMENT SERVICES (Optional)
  # =============================================================================

  # Development service with hot reloading
  stream-orca-dev:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: stream-orca/Dockerfile.dev
    environment:
      - SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT=${SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT}
      - SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN=${SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN}
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-debug}
      - HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL=30
    volumes:
      - ../stream-orca:/app
      - cargo_cache:/usr/local/cargo/registry
      - target_cache:/app/target
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "pgrep", "-f", "cargo-watch"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 20s
    profiles:
      - dev
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'

  # =============================================================================
  # CACHE LAYERS (for faster rebuilds)
  # =============================================================================

  stream-orca-cache:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: stream-orca/Dockerfile
      target: builder
    image: arbitrage-stream-orca:cache
    profiles:
      - cache

  stream-raydium-cache:
    build:
      context: ../stream-raydium
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: builder
    image: arbitrage-stream-raydium:cache
    profiles:
      - cache

  price-aggregator:
    build:
      context: ../../crates/price-aggregator
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: price-aggregator:latest
    container_name: price-aggregator
    environment:
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      - IN_TOPIC=${AGG_IN_TOPIC:-orca-swaps.parsed.v2}
      - OUT_TOPIC=${AGG_OUT_TOPIC:-prices.latest}
      - GROUP_ID=${AGG_GROUP_ID:-price-aggregator}
      - EMIT_SECS=${AGG_EMIT_SECS:-5}
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped

networks:
  mevana_net:
    external: true
    name: mevana_net

volumes:
  postgres_data:
    driver: local
  prometheus_data:
    driver: local
  grafana_data:
    driver: local
  cargo_cache:
    driver: local
  target_cache:
    driver: local
```

```rust
use anyhow::Result;
use dotenv::dotenv;
use env_logger;
use log::{info, warn};
use redis::{AsyncCommands, from_redis_value, Value};

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    dotenv().ok();
    env_logger::init();

    let redis_url = std::env::var("REDIS_URL").unwrap_or_else(|_| "redis://127.0.0.1:6379/0".into());
    let client = redis::Client::open(redis_url.clone())?;
    let mut conn = client.get_multiplexed_tokio_connection().await?;
    info!("depth-builder: redis={}", redis_url);

    // Simple loop: read from XREAD on tickarray stream; compute/update per-pool summaries
    // Stream: dex:whirlpool:tickarray_updates
    let mut last_id = String::from("$"); // start now; change to "0" for history
    loop {
        let resp: Value = redis::cmd("XREAD")
            .arg("BLOCK").arg(5000)
            .arg("STREAMS").arg("dex:whirlpool:tickarray_updates").arg(&last_id)
            .query_async(&mut conn).await.unwrap_or(Value::Nil);
        // Expect structure: [[stream_key, [[id, [field, value, ...]], ...]]]
        if let Value::Array(streams) = resp {
            if let Some(Value::Array(mut top)) = streams.into_iter().next() {
                if top.len() >= 2 {
                    if let Value::Array(items) = top.remove(1) {
                        for item in items {
                            if let Value::Array(mut pair) = item {
                                if pair.len() != 2 { continue; }
                                let id = match &pair[0] { Value::BulkString(b) => String::from_utf8_lossy(b).to_string(), _ => continue };
                                last_id = id;
                                let mut pool = String::new();
                                let mut start: i64 = 0;
                                let mut num_init: i64 = 0;
                                let mut sum_gross = String::new();
                                if let Value::Array(kvs) = &pair[1] {
                                    let mut it = kvs.iter();
                                    while let (Some(k), Some(v)) = (it.next(), it.next()) {
                                        let key = match k { Value::BulkString(b) => String::from_utf8_lossy(b).to_string(), _ => continue };
                                        match key.as_str() {
                                            "pool" => if let Value::BulkString(b) = v { pool = String::from_utf8_lossy(b).to_string() },
                                            "start" => if let Value::BulkString(b) = v { start = String::from_utf8_lossy(b).parse().unwrap_or(0) },
                                            "num_init" => if let Value::BulkString(b) = v { num_init = String::from_utf8_lossy(b).parse().unwrap_or(0) },
                                            "sum_gross" => if let Value::BulkString(b) = v { sum_gross = String::from_utf8_lossy(b).to_string() },
                                            _ => {}
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                if pool.is_empty() { continue; }
                                let key = format!("dex:pool_depth:{}", pool);
                                let _: () = redis::cmd("HSET")
                                    .arg(&key)
                                    .arg("last_start").arg(start)
                                    .arg("last_num_init").arg(num_init)
                                    .arg("last_sum_gross").arg(&sum_gross)
                                    .query_async(&mut conn).await.unwrap_or(());
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // else Nil or unexpected → loop
    }
}
```

```dockercompose
# =============================================================================
# SOLANA AI TRADING PLATFORM - ENHANCED DOCKER COMPOSE
# =============================================================================
# Enhanced version with improved connectivity, monitoring, and resource management

services:
  # =============================================================================
  # INFRASTRUCTURE SERVICES
  # =============================================================================
  
  zookeeper:
    image: confluentinc/cp-zookeeper:7.4.0
    container_name: zookeeper
    environment:
      ZOOKEEPER_CLIENT_PORT: 2181
      ZOOKEEPER_TICK_TIME: 2000
      ZOOKEEPER_MAX_CLIENT_CNXNS: 60
      ZOOKEEPER_SYNC_LIMIT: 2
      ZOOKEEPER_INIT_LIMIT: 5
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "bash", "-c", "echo stat | nc localhost 2181"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 10s
    ports:
      - "2181:2181"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'

  kafka:
    image: confluentinc/cp-kafka:7.4.0
    container_name: kafka
    depends_on:
      zookeeper:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      KAFKA_BROKER_ID: 1
      KAFKA_ZOOKEEPER_CONNECT: zookeeper:2181
      KAFKA_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://0.0.0.0:9092,PLAINTEXT_HOST://0.0.0.0:29092
      KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://kafka:9092,PLAINTEXT_HOST://host.docker.internal:29092
      KAFKA_LISTENER_SECURITY_PROTOCOL_MAP: PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,PLAINTEXT_HOST:PLAINTEXT
      KAFKA_INTER_BROKER_LISTENER_NAME: PLAINTEXT
      KAFKA_AUTO_CREATE_TOPICS_ENABLE: "true"
      KAFKA_OFFSETS_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
      KAFKA_HEAP_OPTS: "-Xmx1G -Xms1G"
      KAFKA_LOG_RETENTION_HOURS: 168
      KAFKA_LOG_SEGMENT_BYTES: 1073741824
      KAFKA_NUM_PARTITIONS: 3
      KAFKA_DEFAULT_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
      KAFKA_MIN_INSYNC_REPLICAS: 1
      KAFKA_DELETE_TOPIC_ENABLE: "true"
    ports:
      - "9092:9092"
      - "29092:29092"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "kafka-topics --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 --list"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2G
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '0.5'

  kafka-ui:
    image: provectuslabs/kafka-ui:latest
    container_name: kafka-ui
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    environment:
      KAFKA_CLUSTERS_0_NAME: local
      KAFKA_CLUSTERS_0_BOOTSTRAPSERVERS: kafka:9092
      KAFKA_CLUSTERS_0_READONLY: false
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--no-verbose", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:8080/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"

      options:

        max-file: "3"

      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.25'

  adminer:

    container_name: adminer
    ports:
      - "8082:8080"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped

      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--no-verbose", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:8080/"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
          cpus: '0.1'

  # =============================================================================
  # DEVELOPMENT SERVICES (Optional)
  # =============================================================================

  # Development service with hot reloading
  stream-orca-dev:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: stream-orca/Dockerfile.dev
    environment:
      - SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT=${SHYFT_GRPC_ENDPOINT}
      - SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN=${SHYFT_GRPC_TOKEN}
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      - RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-debug}
      - HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL=30
    volumes:
      - ../stream-orca:/app
      - cargo_cache:/usr/local/cargo/registry
      - target_cache:/app/target
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "pgrep", "-f", "cargo-watch"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 20s
    profiles:
      - dev
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'

  # =============================================================================
  # CACHE LAYERS (for faster rebuilds)
  # =============================================================================

  stream-orca-cache:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: stream-orca/Dockerfile
      target: builder
    image: arbitrage-stream-orca:cache
    profiles:
      - cache

  stream-raydium-cache:
    build:
      context: ../stream-raydium
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: builder
    image: arbitrage-stream-raydium:cache
    profiles:
      - cache

  price-aggregator:
    build:
      context: ../../crates/price-aggregator
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: price-aggregator:latest
    container_name: price-aggregator
    environment:
      - KAFKA_BROKER=kafka:9092
      - IN_TOPIC=${AGG_IN_TOPIC:-orca-swaps.parsed.v2}
      - OUT_TOPIC=${AGG_OUT_TOPIC:-prices.latest}
      - GROUP_ID=${AGG_GROUP_ID:-price-aggregator}
      - EMIT_SECS=${AGG_EMIT_SECS:-5}
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped

networks:
  mevana_net:
    external: true
    name: mevana_net

volumes:
  postgres_data:
    driver: local
  prometheus_data:
    driver: local
  grafana_data:
    driver: local
  cargo_cache:
    driver: local
  target_cache:
    driver: local
```

```rust
use anyhow::Result;
use dotenv::dotenv;
use env_logger;
use log::{info, warn};
use redis::{AsyncCommands, from_redis_value, Value};

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    dotenv().ok();
    env_logger::init();

    let redis_url = std::env::var("REDIS_URL").unwrap_or_else(|_| "redis://127.0.0.1:6379/0".into());
    let client = redis::Client::open(redis_url.clone())?;
    let mut conn = client.get_multiplexed_tokio_connection().await?;
    info!("depth-builder: redis={}", redis_url);

    // Simple loop: read from XREAD on tickarray stream; compute/update per-pool summaries
    // Stream: dex:whirlpool:tickarray_updates
    let mut last_id = std::env::var("START_ID").unwrap_or_else(|_| "$".into());
    loop {
        let resp: Value = redis::cmd("XREAD")
            .arg("BLOCK").arg(5000)
            .arg("STREAMS").arg("dex:whirlpool:tickarray_updates").arg(&last_id)
            .query_async(&mut conn).await.unwrap_or(Value::Nil);
        // Expect structure: [[stream_key, [[id, [field, value, ...]], ...]]]
        if let Value::Array(streams) = resp {
            if let Some(Value::Array(mut top)) = streams.into_iter().next() {
                if top.len() >= 2 {
                    if let Value::Array(items) = top.remove(1) {
                        for item in items {
                            if let Value::Array(mut pair) = item {
                                if pair.len() != 2 { continue; }
                                let id = match &pair[0] { Value::BulkString(b) => String::from_utf8_lossy(b).to_string(), _ => continue };
                                last_id = id;
                                let mut pool = String::new();
                                let mut start: i64 = 0;
                                let mut num_init: i64 = 0;
                                let mut sum_gross = String::new();
                                if let Value::Array(kvs) = &pair[1] {
                                    let mut it = kvs.iter();
                                    while let (Some(k), Some(v)) = (it.next(), it.next()) {
                                        let key = match k { Value::BulkString(b) => String::from_utf8_lossy(b).to_string(), _ => continue };
                                        match key.as_str() {
                                            "pool" => if let Value::BulkString(b) = v { pool = String::from_utf8_lossy(b).to_string() },
                                            "start" => if let Value::BulkString(b) = v { start = String::from_utf8_lossy(b).parse().unwrap_or(0) },
                                            "num_init" => if let Value::BulkString(b) = v { num_init = String::from_utf8_lossy(b).parse().unwrap_or(0) },
                                            "sum_gross" => if let Value::BulkString(b) = v { sum_gross = String::from_utf8_lossy(b).to_string() },
                                            _ => {}
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                if pool.is_empty() { continue; }
                                let key = format!("dex:pool_depth:{}", pool);
                                let _: () = redis::cmd("HSET")
                                    .arg(&key)
                                    .arg("last_start").arg(start)
                                    .arg("last_num_init").arg(num_init)
                                    .arg("last_sum_gross").arg(&sum_gross)
                                    .query_async(&mut conn).await.unwrap_or(());
                                info!("updated {} start={} num_init={} sum_gross={}", key, start, num_init, sum_gross);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // else Nil or unexpected → loop
    }
}
```

```dockercompose
# =============================================================================
# SOLANA AI TRADING PLATFORM - ENHANCED DOCKER COMPOSE
# =============================================================================
# Enhanced version with improved connectivity, monitoring, and resource management

services:
  # =============================================================================
  # INFRASTRUCTURE SERVICES
  # =============================================================================
  
  zookeeper:
    image: confluentinc/cp-zookeeper:7.4.0
    container_name: zookeeper
    environment:
      ZOOKEEPER_CLIENT_PORT: 2181
      ZOOKEEPER_TICK_TIME: 2000
      ZOOKEEPER_MAX_CLIENT_CNXNS: 60
      ZOOKEEPER_SYNC_LIMIT: 2
      ZOOKEEPER_INIT_LIMIT: 5
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "bash", "-c", "echo stat | nc localhost 2181"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 10s
    ports:
      - "2181:2181"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'

  kafka:
    image: confluentinc/cp-kafka:7.4.0
    container_name: kafka
    depends_on:
      zookeeper:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      KAFKA_BROKER_ID: 1
      KAFKA_ZOOKEEPER_CONNECT: zookeeper:2181
      KAFKA_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://0.0.0.0:9092,PLAINTEXT_HOST://0.0.0.0:29092
      KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://kafka:9092,PLAINTEXT_HOST://host.docker.internal:29092
      KAFKA_LISTENER_SECURITY_PROTOCOL_MAP: PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,PLAINTEXT_HOST:PLAINTEXT
      KAFKA_INTER_BROKER_LISTENER_NAME: PLAINTEXT
      KAFKA_AUTO_CREATE_TOPICS_ENABLE: "true"
      KAFKA_OFFSETS_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
      KAFKA_HEAP_OPTS: "-Xmx1G -Xms1G"
      KAFKA_LOG_RETENTION_HOURS: 168
      KAFKA_LOG_SEGMENT_BYTES: 1073741824
      KAFKA_NUM_PARTITIONS: 3
      KAFKA_DEFAULT_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
      KAFKA_MIN_INSYNC_REPLICAS: 1
      KAFKA_DELETE_TOPIC_ENABLE: "true"
    ports:
      - "9092:9092"
      - "29092:29092"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "kafka-topics --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 --list"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"

      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2G
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1G
          cpus: '0.5'

  kafka-ui:

    container_name: kafka-ui
    depends_on:
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    environment:
      KAFKA_CLUSTERS_0_NAME: local
      KAFKA_CLUSTERS_0_BOOTSTRAPSERVERS: kafka:9092
      KAFKA_CLUSTERS_0_READONLY: false
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--no-verbose", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:8080/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
```

```rust
use chrono::Utc;
use clap::{Parser, ArgAction};
use dotenv::dotenv;
use env_logger;
use log::{error, info};
use redis::{aio::MultiplexedConnection, AsyncCommands, pipe};
use std::{collections::HashMap, env, time::Duration};
use tokio::sync::Mutex;
use std::sync::Arc;
use bs58;
use lru::LruCache;

use whirlpool_interface::accounts::{
    Whirlpool, WhirlpoolAccount, WHIRLPOOL_ACCOUNT_DISCM,
    TICK_ARRAY_ACCOUNT_DISCM, POSITION_ACCOUNT_DISCM,
};
use whirlpool_interface::typedefs::TickArray;
use whirlpool_interface::accounts::TickArrayAccount;
use yellowstone_grpc_client::{GeyserGrpcClient, Interceptor};
use yellowstone_grpc_proto::geyser::{
    subscribe_request_filter_accounts_filter::Filter as AccountsFilterOneOf,
    subscribe_request_filter_accounts_filter_memcmp::Data as MemcmpData,
    CommitmentLevel, SubscribeRequest, SubscribeRequestFilterAccounts,
    SubscribeRequestFilterAccountsFilter, SubscribeRequestFilterAccountsFilterMemcmp,
    subscribe_update::UpdateOneof, SubscribeUpdateAccount,
};
use futures_util::StreamExt;

type AccountFilterMap = HashMap<String, SubscribeRequestFilterAccounts>;

const WHIRLPOOL_PROGRAM_ID: &str = "whirLbMiicVdio4qvUfM5KAg6Ct8VwpYzGff3uctyCc";


#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
struct MintMeta {
    decimals: u8,
    symbol: Option<String>,
    name: Option<String>,
}

struct MintCache {
    lru: LruCache<String, MintMeta>,
}

impl MintCache {
    fn new(cap: usize) -> Self {
        use std::num::NonZeroUsize;
        Self { lru: LruCache::new(NonZeroUsize::new(cap.max(16)).unwrap()) }
    }

    /// Pull from in-memory LRU first; if missing, read from Redis: HGET dex:mint:{MINT} decimals/symbol/name
    async fn get_from_redis(
        &mut self,
        redis: &mut redis::aio::MultiplexedConnection,
        mint: &str,
    ) -> anyhow::Result<MintMeta> {
        if let Some(meta) = self.lru.get(mint).cloned() {
            return Ok(meta);
        }
        let key = format!("dex:mint:{mint}");

        // HMGET returns a tuple of Options; missing fields are OK.
        // (We keep it tolerant; your backfill and streamer will fill these over time.)
        let (dec_opt, sym_opt, name_opt): (Option<i64>, Option<String>, Option<String>) =
            redis::cmd("HMGET")
                .arg(&key).arg("decimals").arg("symbol").arg("name")
                .query_async(redis).await
                .unwrap_or((None, None, None));

        let meta = MintMeta {
            decimals: dec_opt.map(|d| d as u8).unwrap_or(0), // 0 if unknown (you can default to 6 if you prefer)
            symbol: sym_opt,
            name: name_opt,
        };

        self.lru.put(mint.to_string(), meta.clone());
        Ok(meta)
    }
}



#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct ConnArgs {
    endpoint: String,
    x_token: String,
    redis_url: String,
}

impl ConnArgs {
    async fn connect(&self) -> anyhow::Result<GeyserGrpcClient<impl Interceptor>> {
        info!("🔒 Building gRPC client for endpoint: {}", self.endpoint);
        
        let builder = GeyserGrpcClient::build_from_shared(self.endpoint.clone())?
            .x_token(Some(self.x_token.clone()))?
            .connect_timeout(Duration::from_secs(20))
            .timeout(Duration::from_secs(20))
            .tls_config(tonic::transport::channel::ClientTlsConfig::new().with_native_roots())?
            .max_decoding_message_size(1024 * 1024 * 1024);
        
        info!("🚀 Attempting connection...");
        builder.connect().await.map_err(Into::into)
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Parser)]
#[clap(author, version, about)]
struct AppArgs {
    /// Subscribe to ALL accounts owned by the Whirlpool program (debug only)
    #[arg(long, env = "OWNER_ONLY", action = ArgAction::SetTrue)]
    owner_only: bool,

    /// Include TickArray accounts (stored to a Redis stream)
    #[arg(long, env = "INCLUDE_TICKARRAYS", action = ArgAction::SetTrue)]
    include_tickarrays: bool,

    /// Include Position accounts (stored to a Redis stream)
    #[arg(long, env = "INCLUDE_POSITIONS", action = ArgAction::SetTrue)]
    include_positions: bool,

    /// Backfill starting slot (optional)
    #[arg(long, env = "FROM_SLOT")]
    from_slot: Option<u64>,
}

impl AppArgs {
    fn build_connection_args(&self) -> ConnArgs {
        let endpoint = env::var("ENDPOINT").expect("ENDPOINT not found in .env file");
        let x_token = env::var("X_TOKEN").expect("X_TOKEN not found in .env file");
        let redis_url = env::var("REDIS_URL").expect("REDIS_URL not found in .env file");
        
        ConnArgs { endpoint, x_token, redis_url }
    }

    fn build_subscribe_request(&self) -> SubscribeRequest {
        let mut accounts: AccountFilterMap = HashMap::new();

        // helper: owner + optional memcmp(0, disc)
        let mut push = |label: &str, owner: &str, disc: Option<[u8; 8]>| {
            let filters = match disc {
                Some(bytes8) => vec![SubscribeRequestFilterAccountsFilter {
                    filter: Some(AccountsFilterOneOf::Memcmp(
                        SubscribeRequestFilterAccountsFilterMemcmp {
                            offset: 0,
                            data: Some(MemcmpData::Bytes(bytes8.to_vec())),
                        },
                    )),
                }],
                None => vec![],
            };
            accounts.insert(
                label.to_string(),
                SubscribeRequestFilterAccounts {
                    account: vec![],
                    owner: vec![owner.to_string()],
                    nonempty_txn_signature: None,
                    filters,
                },
            );
        };

        if self.owner_only {
            // Firehose
            push("whirlpool_owner_only", WHIRLPOOL_PROGRAM_ID, None);
        } else {
            // Safe default: only Whirlpool POOL accounts (ok to IDL-parse)
            push("whirlpool_pools", WHIRLPOOL_PROGRAM_ID, Some(WHIRLPOOL_ACCOUNT_DISCM));
            if self.include_tickarrays {
                push("whirlpool_tickarrays", WHIRLPOOL_PROGRAM_ID, Some(TICK_ARRAY_ACCOUNT_DISCM));
            }
            if self.include_positions {
                push("whirlpool_positions", WHIRLPOOL_PROGRAM_ID, Some(POSITION_ACCOUNT_DISCM));
            }
        }

        SubscribeRequest {
            accounts,
            slots: HashMap::default(),
            transactions: HashMap::default(),
            transactions_status: HashMap::default(),
            blocks: HashMap::default(),
            blocks_meta: HashMap::default(),
            entry: HashMap::default(),
            commitment: Some(CommitmentLevel::Processed as i32),
            accounts_data_slice: Vec::default(),
            ping: None,
            from_slot: self.from_slot,
        }
    }
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    dotenv().ok();
    
    // Set up logging
    env::set_var(
        env_logger::DEFAULT_FILTER_ENV,
        env::var_os(env_logger::DEFAULT_FILTER_ENV).unwrap_or_else(|| "info".into()),
    );
    env_logger::init();

    // At the start of your main function
    info!("🔍 Loading IDL files...");
    info!("📁 Current working directory: {:?}", std::env::current_dir()?);

    // Check if IDL files exist
    let idl_path = "idls/whirlpool_idl.json";
    if std::path::Path::new(idl_path).exists() {
        info!("✅ IDL file found: {}", idl_path);
    } else {
        error!("❌ IDL file not found: {}", idl_path);
    }

    // Read environment variables
    let endpoint = env::var("ENDPOINT").expect("ENDPOINT not found in .env file");
    let x_token = env::var("X_TOKEN").expect("X_TOKEN not found in .env file");
    let redis_url = env::var("REDIS_URL").expect("REDIS_URL not found in .env file");
    
    // Filter flags
    let flags = AppArgs::parse();

    let _zero_attempts = Arc::new(Mutex::new(true));

    // Display configuration at startup
    println!("🚀 Starting Whirlpool Account Updates Streamer");
    println!("================================================");
    println!("📡 Endpoint: {}", endpoint);
    println!("🔑 X-Token: {}...{}", &x_token[..8], &x_token[x_token.len()-4..]);
    println!("🗄️  Redis URL: {}", redis_url);
    println!("⚙️  Configuration:");
    println!("   Owner only mode: {}", flags.owner_only);
    println!("   Include tick arrays: {}", flags.include_tickarrays);
    println!("   Include positions: {}", flags.include_positions);
    if let Some(from_slot) = flags.from_slot {
        println!("   Starting from slot: {}", from_slot);
    } else {
        println!("   Starting from latest slot");
    }
    println!("================================================");

    info!("Starting Whirlpool streamer");
    info!("Endpoint: {}", endpoint);
    info!("Redis: {}", redis_url);
    info!("X-Token: {}", x_token);
    info!("Configuration flags: {:?}", flags);

    // Network creds
    let _conn_args = ConnArgs { endpoint, x_token, redis_url };

    // Simple retry loop for connection
    let mut attempts = 0;
    let max_attempts = 5;
    
    loop {
        attempts += 1;
        info!("🔄 Attempt {} of {}: Attempting to connect to geyser...", attempts, max_attempts);
        
        match try_connect(&flags).await {
            Ok(_) => {
                info!("✅ Connection and processing completed successfully");
                break;
            }
            Err(e) => {
                error!("❌ Attempt {} failed: {}", attempts, e);
                if attempts >= max_attempts {
                    error!("❌ Failed to establish connection after {} attempts", max_attempts);
                    return Err(e);
                }
                
                // Exponential backoff: wait longer between attempts
                let delay = std::cmp::min(1000 * (2_u64.pow(attempts as u32)), 30000);
                info!("⏳ Waiting {}ms before retry...", delay);
                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay)).await;
            }
        }
    }

    Ok(())
}

async fn try_connect(flags: &AppArgs) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    info!("🔌 Building connection arguments...");
    let conn_args = flags.build_connection_args();
    
    info!("📡 Connection details:");
    info!("   Endpoint: {}", conn_args.endpoint);
    info!("   X-Token: {}...{}", 
        &conn_args.x_token[..8], 
        &conn_args.x_token[conn_args.x_token.len()-4..]
    );
    info!("   Redis URL: {}", conn_args.redis_url);
    
    info!("🔄 Attempting to connect to geyser...");
    info!("   Setting connection timeout: 20s");
    info!("   Setting request timeout: 20s");
    info!("   Max message size: 1GB");
    
    let client = match conn_args.connect().await {
        Ok(client) => {
            info!("✅ Successfully connected to geyser!");
            client
        }
        Err(e) => {
            error!("❌ Failed to connect to geyser");
            error!("🔍 Connection error details: {:#?}", e);
            error!("📡 Endpoint: {}", conn_args.endpoint);
            error!("🔑 X-Token: {}...{}", 
                &conn_args.x_token[..8], 
                &conn_args.x_token[conn_args.x_token.len()-4..]
            );
            
            // Check if it's a TLS/certificate issue
            if e.to_string().contains("certificate") || e.to_string().contains("UnknownIssuer") {
                error!("🔒 TLS Certificate Issue Detected");
                error!("💡 This might be a certificate validation problem with the endpoint");
                error!("💡 Try checking if the endpoint URL is correct or if there are certificate issues");
            }
            
            // Check if it's a network issue
            if e.to_string().contains("transport") {
                error!("🌐 Network/Transport Issue Detected");
                error!("💡 Check your internet connection and firewall settings");
            }
            
            // Check if it's an authentication issue
            if e.to_string().contains("Unauthenticated") || e.to_string().contains("Invalid") {
                error!("🔐 Authentication Issue Detected");
                error!("💡 Check if your X-Token is valid and not expired");
                error!("💡 Verify your Shyft account status and API limits");
            }
            
            return Err(e);
        }
    };
    
    info!("📋 Building subscribe request...");
    let request = flags.build_subscribe_request();
    info!("   Account filters: {:?}", request.accounts.keys().collect::<Vec<_>>());
    info!("   Commitment level: {:?}", request.commitment);
    if let Some(from_slot) = request.from_slot {
        info!("   Starting from slot: {}", from_slot);
    }
    
    info!("🚀 Starting geyser subscription...");
    geyser_subscribe(client, request, &conn_args.redis_url, flags).await?;
    
    info!("✅ Geyser subscription completed successfully");
    Ok(())
}

async fn geyser_subscribe(
    mut client: GeyserGrpcClient<impl Interceptor>,
    request: SubscribeRequest,
    redis_url: &str,
    flags: &AppArgs,
) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    let (mut _tx, mut stream) = client.subscribe_with_request(Some(request)).await?;
    info!("stream opened");

    let redis_client = redis::Client::open(redis_url)?;
    let mut redis_conn: MultiplexedConnection = redis_client
        .get_multiplexed_tokio_connection()
        .await?;

    let pong: String = redis::cmd("PING").query_async(&mut redis_conn).await.unwrap_or_else(|_| "PONG".to_string());
    info!("Redis ping: {}", pong);

    // // Test Redis connection with a simple command
    // let pong: String = redis_conn.get("test_connection").await.unwrap_or_else(|_| "connected".to_string());
    // info!("Redis connection test: {}", pong);

    // In-process cache for mint metadata
    let mut mint_cache = MintCache::new(1024);

    // Redis client
    let redis_client = redis::Client::open(redis_url)?;
    let mut redis_conn: MultiplexedConnection = redis_client
        .get_multiplexed_tokio_connection()
        .await?;


    while let Some(message) = stream.next().await {
        match message {
            Ok(msg) => match msg.update_oneof {
                Some(UpdateOneof::Account(account)) => {
                    if let Err(e) = handle_account_update(&mut redis_conn, flags, &mut mint_cache, &account ).await {
                        error!("handle_account_update error: {e:?}");
                    }
                }
                Some(UpdateOneof::Ping(_)) => {
                    // no-op; some servers send ping/pong automatically
                }
                _ => {}
            },
            Err(e) => {
                error!("stream error: {e:?}");
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    info!("stream closed");
    Ok(())
}

async fn handle_account_update(
    redis: &mut MultiplexedConnection,
    flags: &AppArgs,
    mint_cache: &mut MintCache,
    upd: &SubscribeUpdateAccount
) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    let Some(acct) = &upd.account else { return Ok(()); };
    let data: &[u8] = &acct.data;
    if data.len() < 8 { return Ok(()); }

    let disc = &data[..8];

    // Only IDL-parse Whirlpool pools
    if disc == WHIRLPOOL_ACCOUNT_DISCM {
        let whirlpool_acc = WhirlpoolAccount::deserialize(data)
            .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("WhirlpoolAccount::deserialize: {e}"))?;
        let whirlpool: Whirlpool = whirlpool_acc.0;
    
        let pool_pubkey = bs58::encode(&acct.pubkey).into_string();
        let mint_a = whirlpool.token_mint_a.to_string();
        let mint_b = whirlpool.token_mint_b.to_string();
    
        // Pull decimals/symbols from Redis (w/ in-process LRU)
        let meta_a = mint_cache.get_from_redis(redis, &mint_a).await?;
        let meta_b = mint_cache.get_from_redis(redis, &mint_b).await?;
    
        let pair_symbol = match (&meta_a.symbol, &meta_b.symbol) {
            (Some(sa), Some(sb)) if !sa.is_empty() && !sb.is_empty() => Some(format!("{}/{}", sa, sb)),
            _ => None,
        };
    
        // Write full snapshot including decimals (+ optional pair_symbol)
        cache_whirlpool_snapshot(
            redis,
            &pool_pubkey,
            &whirlpool,
            meta_a.decimals,
            meta_b.decimals,
            pair_symbol.as_deref(),
            upd.slot,
        ).await?;
    
        // Optional verification
        let pool_key = format!("dex:pool:{pool_pubkey}");
        let snap: HashMap<String, String> = redis.hgetall(&pool_key).await?;
        info!("cached {}", pool_key);
        if let (Some(sp), Some(t)) = (snap.get("sqrt_price_x64"), snap.get("tick")) {
            info!("  sqrt_price_x64={} tick={}", sp, t);
        }
        return Ok(());
    }
    

    // Optionally stash TickArrays / Positions
    let now = Utc::now().timestamp();
    if flags.include_tickarrays && disc == TICK_ARRAY_ACCOUNT_DISCM {
        // Parse and emit a compact summary for depth builder
        let tick_array = TickArrayAccount::deserialize(data)
            .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("TickArrayAccount::deserialize: {e}"))?;
        let ta = tick_array.0;
        let pool_pubkey = ta.whirlpool.to_string();
        let start_tick = ta.start_tick_index as i64;
        let mut num_initialized: i64 = 0;
        let mut sum_gross: u128 = 0;
        for t in ta.ticks.iter() {
            if t.initialized {
                num_initialized += 1;
                sum_gross = sum_gross.saturating_add(t.liquidity_gross);
            }
        }
        let array_pubkey = bs58::encode(&upd.account.as_ref().unwrap().pubkey).into_string();

        let _id: String = redis::cmd("XADD")
            .arg("dex:whirlpool:tickarray_updates").arg("*")
            .arg("slot").arg(upd.slot as i64)
            .arg("pool").arg(&pool_pubkey)
            .arg("array").arg(&array_pubkey)
            .arg("start").arg(start_tick)
            .arg("num_init").arg(num_initialized)
            .arg("sum_gross").arg(sum_gross.to_string())
            .arg("ts").arg(now)
            .query_async(redis).await?;
        return Ok(());
    }

    if flags.include_positions && disc == POSITION_ACCOUNT_DISCM {
        let _id: String = redis::cmd("XADD")
            .arg("dex:whirlpool:position_updates").arg("*")
            .arg("slot").arg(upd.slot as i64)
            .arg("len").arg(data.len() as i64)
            .arg("ts").arg(now)
            .query_async(redis).await?;
        return Ok(());
    }

    // If --owner-only, you will see many other accounts; ignore by default
    Ok(())
}

/// Writes a single "latest snapshot" for a Whirlpool pool into Redis.
/// Creates the keys if they do not exist (Redis is schemaless).
/// Writes a single \"latest snapshot\" for a Whirlpool pool into Redis.
pub async fn cache_whirlpool_snapshot(
    redis_conn: &mut MultiplexedConnection,
    pool_pubkey: &str,
    whirlpool: &Whirlpool,
    decimals_a: u8,
    decimals_b: u8,
    pair_symbol: Option<&str>,
    slot: u64,
) -> redis::RedisResult<()> {
    let pool_key = format!("dex:pool:{pool_pubkey}");

    let mint_a = whirlpool.token_mint_a.to_string();
    let mint_b = whirlpool.token_mint_b.to_string();
    let fee_bps = whirlpool.fee_rate as i64;
    let sqrt_price_x64 = whirlpool.sqrt_price.to_string();
    let tick = whirlpool.tick_current_index as i64;
    let pair = format!("{mint_a}/{mint_b}");
    let now = Utc::now().timestamp();

    let mut p = pipe();
    p.cmd("HSET").arg(&pool_key)
        .arg("mint_a").arg(&mint_a)
        .arg("mint_b").arg(&mint_b)
        .arg("decimals_a").arg(decimals_a as i64)
        .arg("decimals_b").arg(decimals_b as i64)
        .arg("fee_bps").arg(fee_bps)
        .arg("sqrt_price_x64").arg(sqrt_price_x64)
        .arg("tick").arg(tick)
        .arg("updated_slot").arg(slot as i64)
        .arg("updated_at").arg(now)
        .arg("pair").arg(&pair);

    if let Some(ps) = pair_symbol {
        p.arg("pair_symbol").arg(ps);
        // symbol-based mapping too (if both symbols known)
        p.cmd("SET").arg(format!("dex:pair_symbol:latest_pool:{ps}")).arg(pool_pubkey).ignore();
    }

    // address-based pair mapping
    p.cmd("SET").arg(format!("dex:pair:latest_pool:{pair}")).arg(pool_pubkey).ignore();

    // Use explicit generic for older redis versions; both are fine:
    p.query_async::<()>(&mut *redis_conn).await
}
```

```rust
};

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
struct MintMeta {
    decimals: u8,
    symbol: Option<String>,
    name: Option<String>,
}

struct MintCache {
    lru: LruCache<String, MintMeta>,
}

impl MintCache {
    fn new(cap: usize) -> Self {
        use std::num::NonZeroUsize;
        Self { lru: LruCache::new(NonZeroUsize::new(cap.max(16)).unwrap()) }
    }

    /// Pull from in-memory LRU first; if missing, read from Redis: HGET dex:mint:{MINT} decimals/symbol/name
    async fn get_from_redis(
        &mut self,
        redis: &mut redis::aio::MultiplexedConnection,
        mint: &str,
    ) -> anyhow::Result<MintMeta> {
        if let Some(meta) = self.lru.get(mint).cloned() {
            return Ok(meta);
        }
        let key = format!("dex:mint:{mint}");

        // HMGET returns a tuple of Options; missing fields are OK.
        // (We keep it tolerant; your backfill and streamer will fill these over time.)
        let (dec_opt, sym_opt, name_opt): (Option<i64>, Option<String>, Option<String>) =
            redis::cmd("HMGET")
                .arg(&key).arg("decimals").arg("symbol").arg("name")
                .query_async(redis).await
                .unwrap_or((None, None, None));

        let meta = MintMeta {
            decimals: dec_opt.map(|d| d as u8).unwrap_or(0), // 0 if unknown (you can default to 6 if you prefer)
            symbol: sym_opt,
            name: name_opt,
        };

        self.lru.put(mint.to_string(), meta.clone());
        Ok(meta)
    }
}

struct ConnArgs {
```
