```rust
impl ConnArgs {
    async fn connect(&self) -> anyhow::Result<GeyserGrpcClient<impl Interceptor>> {
        info!("🔒 Building gRPC client for endpoint: {}", self.endpoint);
        
        let builder = GeyserGrpcClient::build_from_shared(self.endpoint.clone())?
            .x_token(Some(self.x_token.clone()))?
            .connect_timeout(Duration::from_secs(20))
            .timeout(Duration::from_secs(20))
            .tls_config(tonic::transport::channel::ClientTlsConfig::new().with_native_roots())?
            .max_decoding_message_size(1024 * 1024 * 1024);
        
        info!("🚀 Attempting connection...");
        builder.connect().await.map_err(Into::into)
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Parser)]
#[clap(author, version, about)]
struct AppArgs {
    /// Subscribe to ALL accounts owned by the Whirlpool program (debug only)
    #[arg(long, env = "OWNER_ONLY", action = ArgAction::SetTrue)]
    owner_only: bool,

    /// Include TickArray accounts (stored to a Redis stream)
    #[arg(long, env = "INCLUDE_TICKARRAYS", action = ArgAction::SetTrue)]
    include_tickarrays: bool,

    /// Include Position accounts (stored to a Redis stream)
    #[arg(long, env = "INCLUDE_POSITIONS", action = ArgAction::SetTrue)]
    include_positions: bool,

    /// Backfill starting slot (optional)
    #[arg(long, env = "FROM_SLOT")]
    from_slot: Option<u64>,
}

impl AppArgs {
    fn build_connection_args(&self) -> ConnArgs {
        let endpoint = env::var("ENDPOINT").expect("ENDPOINT not found in .env file");
        let x_token = env::var("X_TOKEN").expect("X_TOKEN not found in .env file");
        let redis_url = env::var("REDIS_URL").expect("REDIS_URL not found in .env file");
        
        ConnArgs { endpoint, x_token, redis_url }
    }

    fn build_subscribe_request(&self) -> SubscribeRequest {
        let mut accounts: AccountFilterMap = HashMap::new();

        // helper: owner + optional memcmp(0, disc)
        let mut push = |label: &str, owner: &str, disc: Option<[u8; 8]>| {
            let filters = match disc {
                Some(bytes8) => vec![SubscribeRequestFilterAccountsFilter {
                    filter: Some(AccountsFilterOneOf::Memcmp(
                        SubscribeRequestFilterAccountsFilterMemcmp {
                            offset: 0,
                            data: Some(MemcmpData::Bytes(bytes8.to_vec())),
                        },
                    )),
                }],
                None => vec![],
            };
            accounts.insert(
                label.to_string(),
                SubscribeRequestFilterAccounts {
                    account: vec![],
                    owner: vec![owner.to_string()],
                    nonempty_txn_signature: None,
                    filters,
                },
            );
        };

        if self.owner_only {
            // Firehose
            push("whirlpool_owner_only", WHIRLPOOL_PROGRAM_ID, None);
        } else {
            // Safe default: only Whirlpool POOL accounts (ok to IDL-parse)
            push("whirlpool_pools", WHIRLPOOL_PROGRAM_ID, Some(WHIRLPOOL_ACCOUNT_DISCM));
            if self.include_tickarrays {
                push("whirlpool_tickarrays", WHIRLPOOL_PROGRAM_ID, Some(TICK_ARRAY_ACCOUNT_DISCM));
            }
            if self.include_positions {
                push("whirlpool_positions", WHIRLPOOL_PROGRAM_ID, Some(POSITION_ACCOUNT_DISCM));
            }
        }

        SubscribeRequest {
            accounts,
            slots: HashMap::default(),
            transactions: HashMap::default(),
            transactions_status: HashMap::default(),
            blocks: HashMap::default(),
            blocks_meta: HashMap::default(),
            entry: HashMap::default(),
            commitment: Some(CommitmentLevel::Processed as i32),
            accounts_data_slice: Vec::default(),
            ping: None,
            from_slot: self.from_slot,
        }
    }
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    dotenv().ok();
    
    // Set up logging
    env::set_var(
        env_logger::DEFAULT_FILTER_ENV,
        env::var_os(env_logger::DEFAULT_FILTER_ENV).unwrap_or_else(|| "info".into()),
    );
    env_logger::init();

    // At the start of your main function
    info!("🔍 Loading IDL files...");
    info!("📁 Current working directory: {:?}", std::env::current_dir()?);

    // Check if IDL files exist
    let idl_path = "idls/whirlpool_idl.json";
    if std::path::Path::new(idl_path).exists() {
        info!("✅ IDL file found: {}", idl_path);
    } else {
        error!("❌ IDL file not found: {}", idl_path);
    }

    // Read environment variables
    let endpoint = env::var("ENDPOINT").expect("ENDPOINT not found in .env file");
    let x_token = env::var("X_TOKEN").expect("X_TOKEN not found in .env file");
    let redis_url = env::var("REDIS_URL").expect("REDIS_URL not found in .env file");
    
    // Filter flags
    let flags = AppArgs::parse();

    let _zero_attempts = Arc::new(Mutex::new(true));

    // Display configuration at startup
    println!("🚀 Starting Whirlpool Account Updates Streamer");
    println!("================================================");
    println!("📡 Endpoint: {}", endpoint);
    println!("🔑 X-Token: {}...{}", &x_token[..8], &x_token[x_token.len()-4..]);
    println!("🗄️  Redis URL: {}", redis_url);
    println!("⚙️  Configuration:");
    println!("   Owner only mode: {}", flags.owner_only);
    println!("   Include tick arrays: {}", flags.include_tickarrays);
    println!("   Include positions: {}", flags.include_positions);
    if let Some(from_slot) = flags.from_slot {
        println!("   Starting from slot: {}", from_slot);
    } else {
        println!("   Starting from latest slot");
    }
    println!("================================================");

    info!("Starting Whirlpool streamer");
    info!("Endpoint: {}", endpoint);
    info!("Redis: {}", redis_url);
    info!("X-Token: {}", x_token);
    info!("Configuration flags: {:?}", flags);

    // Network creds
    let _conn_args = ConnArgs { endpoint, x_token, redis_url };

    // Simple retry loop for connection
    let mut attempts = 0;
    let max_attempts = 5;
    
    loop {
        attempts += 1;
        info!("🔄 Attempt {} of {}: Attempting to connect to geyser...", attempts, max_attempts);
        
        match try_connect(&flags).await {
            Ok(_) => {
                info!("✅ Connection and processing completed successfully");
                break;
            }
            Err(e) => {
                error!("❌ Attempt {} failed: {}", attempts, e);
                if attempts >= max_attempts {
                    error!("❌ Failed to establish connection after {} attempts", max_attempts);
                    return Err(e);
                }
                
                // Exponential backoff: wait longer between attempts
                let delay = std::cmp::min(1000 * (2_u64.pow(attempts as u32)), 30000);
                info!("⏳ Waiting {}ms before retry...", delay);
                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay)).await;
            }
        }
    }

    Ok(())
}

async fn try_connect(flags: &AppArgs) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    info!("🔌 Building connection arguments...");
    let conn_args = flags.build_connection_args();
    
    info!("📡 Connection details:");
    info!("   Endpoint: {}", conn_args.endpoint);
    info!("   X-Token: {}...{}", 
        &conn_args.x_token[..8], 
        &conn_args.x_token[conn_args.x_token.len()-4..]
    );
    info!("   Redis URL: {}", conn_args.redis_url);
    
    info!("🔄 Attempting to connect to geyser...");
    info!("   Setting connection timeout: 20s");
    info!("   Setting request timeout: 20s");
    info!("   Max message size: 1GB");
    
    let client = match conn_args.connect().await {
        Ok(client) => {
            info!("✅ Successfully connected to geyser!");
            client
        }
        Err(e) => {
            error!("❌ Failed to connect to geyser");
            error!("🔍 Connection error details: {:#?}", e);
            error!("📡 Endpoint: {}", conn_args.endpoint);
            error!("🔑 X-Token: {}...{}", 
                &conn_args.x_token[..8], 
                &conn_args.x_token[conn_args.x_token.len()-4..]
            );
            
            // Check if it's a TLS/certificate issue
            if e.to_string().contains("certificate") || e.to_string().contains("UnknownIssuer") {
                error!("🔒 TLS Certificate Issue Detected");
                error!("💡 This might be a certificate validation problem with the endpoint");
                error!("💡 Try checking if the endpoint URL is correct or if there are certificate issues");
            }
            
            // Check if it's a network issue
            if e.to_string().contains("transport") {
                error!("🌐 Network/Transport Issue Detected");
                error!("💡 Check your internet connection and firewall settings");
            }
            
            // Check if it's an authentication issue
            if e.to_string().contains("Unauthenticated") || e.to_string().contains("Invalid") {
                error!("🔐 Authentication Issue Detected");
                error!("💡 Check if your X-Token is valid and not expired");
                error!("💡 Verify your Shyft account status and API limits");
            }
            
            return Err(e);
        }
    };
    
    info!("📋 Building subscribe request...");
    let request = flags.build_subscribe_request();
    info!("   Account filters: {:?}", request.accounts.keys().collect::<Vec<_>>());
    info!("   Commitment level: {:?}", request.commitment);
    if let Some(from_slot) = request.from_slot {
        info!("   Starting from slot: {}", from_slot);
    }
    
    info!("🚀 Starting geyser subscription...");
    geyser_subscribe(client, request, &conn_args.redis_url, flags).await?;
    
    info!("✅ Geyser subscription completed successfully");
    Ok(())
}

async fn geyser_subscribe(
    mut client: GeyserGrpcClient<impl Interceptor>,
    request: SubscribeRequest,
    redis_url: &str,
    flags: &AppArgs,
) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    let (mut _tx, mut stream) = client.subscribe_with_request(Some(request)).await?;
    info!("stream opened");

    let redis_client = redis::Client::open(redis_url)?;
    let mut redis_conn: MultiplexedConnection = redis_client
        .get_multiplexed_tokio_connection()
        .await?;

    let pong: String = redis::cmd("PING").query_async(&mut redis_conn).await.unwrap_or_else(|_| "PONG".to_string());
    info!("Redis ping: {}", pong);

    // // Test Redis connection with a simple command
    // let pong: String = redis_conn.get("test_connection").await.unwrap_or_else(|_| "connected".to_string());
    // info!("Redis connection test: {}", pong);

    // In-process cache for mint metadata
    let mut mint_cache = MintCache::new(1024);

    // Redis client
    let redis_client = redis::Client::open(redis_url)?;
    let mut redis_conn: MultiplexedConnection = redis_client
        .get_multiplexed_tokio_connection()
        .await?;


    while let Some(message) = stream.next().await {
        match message {
            Ok(msg) => match msg.update_oneof {
                Some(UpdateOneof::Account(account)) => {
                    if let Err(e) = handle_account_update(&mut redis_conn, flags, &mut mint_cache, &account ).await {
                        error!("handle_account_update error: {e:?}");
                    }
                }
                Some(UpdateOneof::Ping(_)) => {
                    // no-op; some servers send ping/pong automatically
                }
                _ => {}
            },
            Err(e) => {
                error!("stream error: {e:?}");
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    info!("stream closed");
    Ok(())
}

async fn handle_account_update(
    redis: &mut MultiplexedConnection,
    flags: &AppArgs,
    mint_cache: &mut MintCache,
    upd: &SubscribeUpdateAccount
) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    let Some(acct) = &upd.account else { return Ok(()); };
    let data: &[u8] = &acct.data;
    if data.len() < 8 { return Ok(()); }

    let disc = &data[..8];

    // Only IDL-parse Whirlpool pools
    if disc == WHIRLPOOL_ACCOUNT_DISCM {
        let whirlpool_acc = WhirlpoolAccount::deserialize(data)
            .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("WhirlpoolAccount::deserialize: {e}"))?;
        let whirlpool: Whirlpool = whirlpool_acc.0;
    
        let pool_pubkey = bs58::encode(&acct.pubkey).into_string();
        let mint_a = whirlpool.token_mint_a.to_string();
        let mint_b = whirlpool.token_mint_b.to_string();
    
        // Pull decimals/symbols from Redis (w/ in-process LRU)
        let meta_a = mint_cache.get_from_redis(redis, &mint_a).await?;
        let meta_b = mint_cache.get_from_redis(redis, &mint_b).await?;
    
        let pair_symbol = match (&meta_a.symbol, &meta_b.symbol) {
            (Some(sa), Some(sb)) if !sa.is_empty() && !sb.is_empty() => Some(format!("{}/{}", sa, sb)),
            _ => None,
        };
    
        // Write full snapshot including decimals (+ optional pair_symbol)
        cache_whirlpool_snapshot(
            redis,
            &pool_pubkey,
            &whirlpool,
            meta_a.decimals,
            meta_b.decimals,
            pair_symbol.as_deref(),
            upd.slot,
        ).await?;
    
        // Optional verification
        let pool_key = format!("dex:pool:{pool_pubkey}");
        let snap: HashMap<String, String> = redis.hgetall(&pool_key).await?;
        info!("cached {}", pool_key);
        if let (Some(sp), Some(t)) = (snap.get("sqrt_price_x64"), snap.get("tick")) {
            info!("  sqrt_price_x64={} tick={}", sp, t);
        }
        return Ok(());
    }
    

    // Optionally stash TickArrays / Positions
    let now = Utc::now().timestamp();
    if flags.include_tickarrays && disc == TICK_ARRAY_ACCOUNT_DISCM {
        // Parse and emit a compact summary for depth builder
        let tick_array = TickArrayAccount::deserialize(data)
            .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("TickArrayAccount::deserialize: {e}"))?;
        let ta = tick_array.0;
        let pool_pubkey = ta.whirlpool.to_string();
        let start_tick = ta.start_tick_index as i64;
        let mut num_initialized: i64 = 0;
        let mut sum_gross: u128 = 0;
        for t in ta.ticks.iter() {
            if t.initialized {
                num_initialized += 1;
                sum_gross = sum_gross.saturating_add(t.liquidity_gross);
            }
        }
        let array_pubkey = bs58::encode(&upd.account.as_ref().unwrap().pubkey).into_string();

        let _id: String = redis::cmd("XADD")
            .arg("dex:whirlpool:tickarray_updates").arg("*")
            .arg("slot").arg(upd.slot as i64)
            .arg("pool").arg(&pool_pubkey)
            .arg("array").arg(&array_pubkey)
            .arg("start").arg(start_tick)
            .arg("num_init").arg(num_initialized)
            .arg("sum_gross").arg(sum_gross.to_string())
            .arg("ts").arg(now)
            .query_async(redis).await?;
        return Ok(());
    }

    if flags.include_positions && disc == POSITION_ACCOUNT_DISCM {
        let _id: String = redis::cmd("XADD")
            .arg("dex:whirlpool:position_updates").arg("*")
            .arg("slot").arg(upd.slot as i64)
            .arg("len").arg(data.len() as i64)
            .arg("ts").arg(now)
            .query_async(redis).await?;
        return Ok(());
    }

    // If --owner-only, you will see many other accounts; ignore by default
    Ok(())
}

/// Writes a single "latest snapshot" for a Whirlpool pool into Redis.
/// Creates the keys if they do not exist (Redis is schemaless).
/// Writes a single \"latest snapshot\" for a Whirlpool pool into Redis.
pub async fn cache_whirlpool_snapshot(
    redis_conn: &mut MultiplexedConnection,
    pool_pubkey: &str,
    whirlpool: &Whirlpool,
    decimals_a: u8,
    decimals_b: u8,
    pair_symbol: Option<&str>,
    slot: u64,
) -> redis::RedisResult<()> {
    let pool_key = format!("dex:pool:{pool_pubkey}");

    let mint_a = whirlpool.token_mint_a.to_string();
    let mint_b = whirlpool.token_mint_b.to_string();
    let fee_bps = whirlpool.fee_rate as i64;
    let sqrt_price_x64 = whirlpool.sqrt_price.to_string();
    let tick = whirlpool.tick_current_index as i64;
    let pair = format!("{mint_a}/{mint_b}");
    let now = Utc::now().timestamp();

    let mut p = pipe();
    p.cmd("HSET").arg(&pool_key)
        .arg("mint_a").arg(&mint_a)
        .arg("mint_b").arg(&mint_b)
        .arg("decimals_a").arg(decimals_a as i64)
        .arg("decimals_b").arg(decimals_b as i64)
        .arg("fee_bps").arg(fee_bps)
        .arg("sqrt_price_x64").arg(sqrt_price_x64)
        .arg("tick").arg(tick)
        .arg("updated_slot").arg(slot as i64)
        .arg("updated_at").arg(now)
        .arg("pair").arg(&pair);

    if let Some(ps) = pair_symbol {
        p.arg("pair_symbol").arg(ps);
        // symbol-based mapping too (if both symbols known)
        p.cmd("SET").arg(format!("dex:pair_symbol:latest_pool:{ps}")).arg(pool_pubkey).ignore();
    }

    // address-based pair mapping
    p.cmd("SET").arg(format!("dex:pair:latest_pool:{pair}")).arg(pool_pubkey).ignore();

    // Use explicit generic for older redis versions; both are fine:
    p.query_async::<()>(&mut *redis_conn).await
}
```

```rust
use anyhow::Result;
use dotenv::dotenv;
use env_logger;
use log::{info, warn};
use redis::{from_redis_value, AsyncCommands, Value};
use serde_json::json;
use std::collections::HashMap;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    dotenv().ok();
    env_logger::init();

    let redis_url =
        std::env::var("REDIS_URL").unwrap_or_else(|_| "redis://127.0.0.1:6379/0".into());
    let client = redis::Client::open(redis_url.clone())?;
    let mut conn = client.get_multiplexed_tokio_connection().await?;
    info!("depth-builder: redis={}", redis_url);

    // Simple loop: read from XREAD on tickarray stream; compute/update per-pool summaries
    // Stream: dex:whirlpool:tickarray_updates
    let mut last_id = std::env::var("START_ID").unwrap_or_else(|_| "$".into());
    loop {
        let resp: Value = redis::cmd("XREAD")
            .arg("BLOCK")
            .arg(5000)
            .arg("STREAMS")
            .arg("dex:whirlpool:tickarray_updates")
            .arg(&last_id)
            .query_async(&mut conn)
            .await
            .unwrap_or(Value::Nil);
        // Expect structure: [[stream_key, [[id, [field, value, ...]], ...]]]
        if let Value::Array(streams) = resp {
            if let Some(Value::Array(mut top)) = streams.into_iter().next() {
                if top.len() >= 2 {
                    if let Value::Array(items) = top.remove(1) {
                        for item in items {
                            if let Value::Array(mut pair) = item {
                                if pair.len() != 2 {
                                    continue;
                                }
                                let id = match &pair[0] {
                                    Value::BulkString(b) => String::from_utf8_lossy(b).to_string(),
                                    _ => continue,
                                };
                                last_id = id;
                                let mut pool = String::new();
                                let mut start: i64 = 0;
                                let mut num_init: i64 = 0;
                                let mut sum_gross = String::new();
                                if let Value::Array(kvs) = &pair[1] {
                                    let mut it = kvs.iter();
                                    while let (Some(k), Some(v)) = (it.next(), it.next()) {
                                        let key = match k {
                                            Value::BulkString(b) => {
                                                String::from_utf8_lossy(b).to_string()
                                            }
                                            _ => continue,
                                        };
                                        match key.as_str() {
                                            "pool" => {
                                                if let Value::BulkString(b) = v {
                                                    pool = String::from_utf8_lossy(b).to_string()
                                                }
                                            }
                                            "start" => {
                                                if let Value::BulkString(b) = v {
                                                    start = String::from_utf8_lossy(b)
                                                        .parse()
                                                        .unwrap_or(0)
                                                }
                                            }
                                            "num_init" => {
                                                if let Value::BulkString(b) = v {
                                                    num_init = String::from_utf8_lossy(b)
                                                        .parse()
                                                        .unwrap_or(0)
                                                }
                                            }
                                            "sum_gross" => {
                                                if let Value::BulkString(b) = v {
                                                    sum_gross =
                                                        String::from_utf8_lossy(b).to_string()
                                                }
                                            }
                                            _ => {}
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                if pool.is_empty() {
                                    continue;
                                }
                                let key = format!("dex:pool_depth:{}", pool);
                                let _: () = redis::cmd("HSET")
                                    .arg(&key)
                                    .arg("last_start")
                                    .arg(start)
                                    .arg("last_num_init")
                                    .arg(num_init)
                                    .arg("last_sum_gross")
                                    .arg(&sum_gross)
                                    .query_async(&mut conn)
                                    .await
                                    .unwrap_or(());

                                // Read current pool snapshot for sqrt_price_x64 and decimals
                                let pool_meta_key = format!("dex:pool:{}", pool);
                                let snap_val: Value = redis::cmd("HGETALL")
                                    .arg(&pool_meta_key)
                                    .query_async(&mut conn)
                                    .await
                                    .unwrap_or(Value::Nil);
                                let mut meta: HashMap<String, String> = HashMap::new();
                                if let Value::Array(kvs) = snap_val.clone() {
                                    let mut it = kvs.into_iter();
                                    while let (Some(k), Some(v)) = (it.next(), it.next()) {
                                        if let (Value::BulkString(kb), Value::BulkString(vb)) = (k, v) {
                                            meta.insert(
                                                String::from_utf8_lossy(&kb).to_string(),
                                                String::from_utf8_lossy(&vb).to_string(),
                                            );
                                        }
                                    }
                                }

                                let sqrt_price_x64_opt = meta
                                    .get("sqrt_price_x64")
                                    .and_then(|s| s.parse::<u128>().ok());
                                let dec_a_opt = meta.get("decimals_a").and_then(|s| s.parse::<i32>().ok());
                                let dec_b_opt = meta.get("decimals_b").and_then(|s| s.parse::<i32>().ok());

                                // First-cut mid price in UI units for Whirlpool
                                let p0_ui: Option<f64> = match (sqrt_price_x64_opt, dec_a_opt, dec_b_opt) {
                                    (Some(sp), Some(da), Some(db)) => {
                                        const Q64: f64 = 18446744073709551616.0; // 2^64
                                        let sqrt = (sp as f64) / Q64;
                                        let price = (sqrt * sqrt) * 10f64.powi(db - da);
                                        Some(price)
                                    }
                                    _ => None,
                                };

                                let sum_gross_f: f64 = sum_gross.parse::<f64>().unwrap_or(0.0);
                                // Heuristic impact coefficient (smaller when liquidity larger)
                                let k_coeff: f64 = if sum_gross_f > 0.0 {
                                    1.0 / (sum_gross_f * 1000.0)
                                } else {
                                    0.0
                                };
                                let sample_sizes = [0.1_f64, 1.0, 5.0, 10.0];
                                let quotes = if let Some(p0) = p0_ui {
                                    let q: Vec<_> = sample_sizes
                                        .iter()
                                        .map(|s| {
                                            let px = (p0 * (1.0 - k_coeff * *s)).max(0.0);
                                            json!({"size_ui": s, "price_ui": px})
                                        })
                                        .collect();
                                    Some(serde_json::to_string(&q).unwrap_or("[]".to_string()))
                                } else {
                                    None
                                };

                                let now_ts = chrono::Utc::now().timestamp();
                                let mut hset = redis::cmd("HSET");
                                hset.arg(&key).arg("updated_at").arg(now_ts);
                                if let Some(p0) = p0_ui { hset.arg("p0_ui").arg(p0); }
                                hset.arg("k_coeff").arg(k_coeff);
                                if let Some(q) = quotes { hset.arg("sample_quotes").arg(q); }
                                let _: () = hset.query_async(&mut conn).await.unwrap_or(());

                                info!(
                                    "updated {} start={} num_init={} sum_gross={} p0_ui={:?} k_coeff={:.6}",
                                    key, start, num_init, sum_gross, p0_ui, k_coeff
                                );
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // else Nil or unexpected → loop
    }
}
```

```rust
use anyhow::Result;
use axum::{
    extract::ws::{Message as WsMessage, WebSocketUpgrade},
    extract::{Path, State},
    response::IntoResponse,
    routing::get,
    Json, Router,
};
use rdkafka::consumer::{Consumer, StreamConsumer};
use rdkafka::{ClientConfig, Message as _};
use std::sync::Arc;
use serde_json::json;
use tokio::net::TcpListener;
use tokio::sync::broadcast;
use tracing::{info, warn};

#[derive(Clone)]
struct AppState {
    prices: broadcast::Sender<String>,
    swaps: broadcast::Sender<String>,
    swaps_v2: broadcast::Sender<String>,
    redis_client: redis::Client,
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    tracing_subscriber::fmt().with_env_filter("info").init();

    let broker = std::env::var("KAFKA_BROKER").unwrap_or_else(|_| "localhost:29092".into());
    let prices_topic = std::env::var("PRICES_TOPIC").unwrap_or_else(|_| "prices.latest".into());
    let swaps_topic = std::env::var("SWAPS_TOPIC").unwrap_or_else(|_| "orca-swaps.parsed".into());
    let swaps_v2_topic =
        std::env::var("SWAPS_V2_TOPIC").unwrap_or_else(|_| "orca-swaps.parsed.v2".into());

    let (prices_tx, _) = broadcast::channel::<String>(2048);
    let (swaps_tx, _) = broadcast::channel::<String>(2048);
    let (swaps_v2_tx, _) = broadcast::channel::<String>(2048);
    let redis_url = std::env::var("REDIS_URL").unwrap_or_else(|_| "redis://redis:6379/0".into());
    let redis_client = redis::Client::open(redis_url.clone())?;
    let state = AppState {
        prices: prices_tx.clone(),
        swaps: swaps_tx.clone(),
        swaps_v2: swaps_v2_tx.clone(),
        redis_client,
    };

    // Kafka consumers
    tokio::spawn(consume_loop(
        broker.clone(),
        prices_topic.clone(),
        prices_tx.clone(),
        "prices",
    ));
    tokio::spawn(consume_loop(
        broker.clone(),
        swaps_topic.clone(),
        swaps_tx.clone(),
        "swaps",
    ));
    tokio::spawn(consume_loop(
        broker.clone(),
        swaps_v2_topic.clone(),
        swaps_v2_tx.clone(),
        "swaps_v2",
    ));

    // HTTP/WS
    let app = Router::new()
        .route("/ws/prices", get(ws_prices))
        .route("/ws/swaps", get(ws_swaps))
        .route("/ws/swaps.v2", get(ws_swaps_v2))
        .route("/depth/:pool", get(http_depth))
        .route("/ws/ping", get(ws_ping))
        .route("/healthz", get(|| async { "ok" }))
        .with_state(Arc::new(state));

    let addr = "0.0.0.0:8081";
    let listener = TcpListener::bind(addr).await?;
    info!("ui-gateway listening on {addr}");
    info!("consuming topic={}", prices_topic);
    info!("consuming topic={}", swaps_topic);
    info!("consuming topic={}", swaps_v2_topic);

    axum::serve(listener, app).await?;
    Ok(())
}

async fn consume_loop(
    broker: String,
    topic: String,
    tx: broadcast::Sender<String>,
    label: &'static str,
) {
    let c: StreamConsumer = ClientConfig::new()
        .set("bootstrap.servers", &broker)
        .set("group.id", format!("ui-{}-group", label))
        .set("enable.auto.commit", "true")
        .set("auto.offset.reset", "latest")
        .create()
        .expect("consumer");
    c.subscribe(&[&topic]).expect("subscribe");

    loop {
        match c.recv().await {
            Ok(m) => {
                if let Some(p) = m.payload_view::<str>().and_then(|r| r.ok()) {
                    let _ = tx.send(p.to_string());
                }
            }
            Err(e) => warn!(?e, "kafka recv error"),
        }
    }
}

async fn ws_prices(
    ws: WebSocketUpgrade,
    State(s): State<Arc<AppState>>,
) -> axum::response::Response {
    ws.on_upgrade(move |mut socket| async move {
        let mut rx = s.prices.subscribe();
        tracing::info!("WS /prices connected");
        loop {
            match rx.recv().await {
                Ok(msg) => {
                    if socket.send(WsMessage::Text(msg)).await.is_err() {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                Err(_) => break,
            }
        }
        tracing::info!("WS /prices disconnected");
    })
}

async fn ws_swaps(
    ws: WebSocketUpgrade,
    State(s): State<Arc<AppState>>,
) -> axum::response::Response {
    ws.on_upgrade(move |mut socket| async move {
        let mut rx = s.swaps.subscribe();
        tracing::info!("WS /swaps connected");
        loop {
            match rx.recv().await {
                Ok(msg) => {
                    if socket.send(WsMessage::Text(msg)).await.is_err() {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                Err(_) => break,
            }
        }
        tracing::info!("WS /swaps disconnected");
    })
}

async fn ws_swaps_v2(
    ws: WebSocketUpgrade,
    State(s): State<Arc<AppState>>,
) -> axum::response::Response {
    ws.on_upgrade(move |mut socket| async move {
        let mut rx = s.swaps_v2.subscribe();
        tracing::info!("WS /swaps.v2 connected");
        loop {
            match rx.recv().await {
                Ok(msg) => {
                    if socket.send(WsMessage::Text(msg)).await.is_err() {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                Err(_) => break,
            }
        }
        tracing::info!("WS /swaps.v2 disconnected");
    })
}

async fn ws_ping(ws: WebSocketUpgrade) -> axum::response::Response {
    ws.on_upgrade(move |mut socket| async move {
        tracing::info!("WS /ping connected");
        // keep-alive pings every 3s so the UI can show liveness reliably
        let mut iv = tokio::time::interval(std::time::Duration::from_secs(3));
        loop {
            iv.tick().await;
            if socket.send(WsMessage::Text("ok".into())).await.is_err() {
                break;
            }
        }
        tracing::info!("WS /ping disconnected");
    })
}

async fn http_depth(
    Path(pool): Path<String>,
    State(s): State<Arc<AppState>>,
) -> impl IntoResponse {
    let key = format!("dex:pool_depth:{}", pool);
    let mut map = serde_json::Map::new();
    match s.redis_client.get_multiplexed_tokio_connection().await {
        Ok(mut conn) => {
            let resp: redis::Value = redis::cmd("HGETALL")
                .arg(&key)
                .query_async(&mut conn)
                .await
                .unwrap_or(redis::Value::Nil);
            if let redis::Value::Array(kvs) = resp {
                let mut it = kvs.into_iter();
                while let (Some(k), Some(v)) = (it.next(), it.next()) {
                    if let (redis::Value::BulkString(kb), v) = (k, v) {
                        let name = String::from_utf8_lossy(&kb).to_string();
                        let val = match v {
                            redis::Value::BulkString(vb) => json!(String::from_utf8_lossy(&vb).to_string()),
                            redis::Value::Data(vb) => json!(String::from_utf8_lossy(&vb).to_string()),
                            redis::Value::Int(i) => json!(i),
                            redis::Value::Nil => json!(null),
                            _ => json!(""),
                        };
                        map.insert(name, val);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Err(_) => {}
    }
    Json(json!({
        "pool": pool,
        "key": key,
        "data": map,
    }))
}

```

```dockerfile
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM rust:1.83 as builder
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y cmake build-essential pkg-config && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN cargo build --release

FROM debian:bookworm-slim as runtime
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y ca-certificates && update-ca-certificates && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /app/target/release/ui-gateway /usr/local/bin/ui-gateway
ENV RUST_LOG=info
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/ui-gateway"]
```

```dockercompose
# =============================================================================
# SOLANA AI TRADING PLATFORM - ENHANCED DOCKER COMPOSE
# =============================================================================
# Enhanced version with improved connectivity, monitoring, and resource management

services:
  # =============================================================================
  # INFRASTRUCTURE SERVICES
  # =============================================================================
  
  zookeeper:
    image: confluentinc/cp-zookeeper:7.4.0
    container_name: zookeeper
    environment:
      ZOOKEEPER_CLIENT_PORT: 2181
      ZOOKEEPER_TICK_TIME: 2000
      ZOOKEEPER_MAX_CLIENT_CNXNS: 60
      ZOOKEEPER_SYNC_LIMIT: 2
      ZOOKEEPER_INIT_LIMIT: 5
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "bash", "-c", "echo stat | nc localhost 2181"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 10s
    ports:
      - "2181:2181"
    networks:
      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'

  kafka:
    image: confluentinc/cp-kafka:7.4.0
    container_name: kafka
    depends_on:
      zookeeper:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      KAFKA_BROKER_ID: 1
      KAFKA_ZOOKEEPER_CONNECT: zookeeper:2181
      KAFKA_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://0.0.0.0:9092,PLAINTEXT_HOST://0.0.0.0:29092
      KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://kafka:9092,PLAINTEXT_HOST://host.docker.internal:29092
      KAFKA_LISTENER_SECURITY_PROTOCOL_MAP: PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,PLAINTEXT_HOST:PLAINTEXT
      KAFKA_INTER_BROKER_LISTENER_NAME: PLAINTEXT
      KAFKA_AUTO_CREATE_TOPICS_ENABLE: "true"
      KAFKA_OFFSETS_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
      KAFKA_HEAP_OPTS: "-Xmx1G -Xms1G"
      KAFKA_LOG_RETENTION_HOURS: 168
      KAFKA_LOG_SEGMENT_BYTES: 1073741824
      KAFKA_NUM_PARTITIONS: 3
      KAFKA_DEFAULT_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
      KAFKA_MIN_INSYNC_REPLICAS: 1
      KAFKA_DELETE_TOPIC_ENABLE: "true"
    ports:
      - "9092:9092"
      - "29092:29092"
    networks:
      - mevana_net

    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "kafka-topics --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 --list"]

    logging:

        max-size: "50m"

      KAFKA_CLUSTERS_0_NAME: local

      - mevana_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--no-verbose", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:8080/health"]

      resources:

          memory: 256M

  # Prometheus for metrics collection
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:latest
    container_name: prometheus
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--web.console.libraries=/etc/prometheus/console_libraries'
      - '--web.console.templates=/etc/prometheus/consoles'

    networks:

    environment:
```

```rust
use anyhow::Result;
use axum::{
    extract::ws::{Message as WsMessage, WebSocketUpgrade},
    extract::{Path, State},
    response::IntoResponse,
    routing::get,
    Json, Router,
};
use rdkafka::consumer::{Consumer, StreamConsumer};
use rdkafka::{ClientConfig, Message as _};
use std::sync::Arc;
use serde_json::json;
use tokio::net::TcpListener;
use tokio::sync::broadcast;
use tracing::{info, warn};

#[derive(Clone)]
struct AppState {
    prices: broadcast::Sender<String>,
    swaps: broadcast::Sender<String>,
    swaps_v2: broadcast::Sender<String>,
    redis_client: redis::Client,
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    tracing_subscriber::fmt().with_env_filter("info").init();

    let broker = std::env::var("KAFKA_BROKER").unwrap_or_else(|_| "localhost:29092".into());
    let prices_topic = std::env::var("PRICES_TOPIC").unwrap_or_else(|_| "prices.latest".into());
    let swaps_topic = std::env::var("SWAPS_TOPIC").unwrap_or_else(|_| "orca-swaps.parsed".into());
    let swaps_v2_topic =
        std::env::var("SWAPS_V2_TOPIC").unwrap_or_else(|_| "orca-swaps.parsed.v2".into());

    let (prices_tx, _) = broadcast::channel::<String>(2048);
    let (swaps_tx, _) = broadcast::channel::<String>(2048);
    let (swaps_v2_tx, _) = broadcast::channel::<String>(2048);
    let redis_url = std::env::var("REDIS_URL").unwrap_or_else(|_| "redis://redis:6379/0".into());
    let redis_client = redis::Client::open(redis_url.clone())?;
    let state = AppState {
        prices: prices_tx.clone(),
        swaps: swaps_tx.clone(),
        swaps_v2: swaps_v2_tx.clone(),
        redis_client,
    };

    // Kafka consumers
    tokio::spawn(consume_loop(
        broker.clone(),
        prices_topic.clone(),
        prices_tx.clone(),
        "prices",
    ));
    tokio::spawn(consume_loop(
        broker.clone(),
        swaps_topic.clone(),
        swaps_tx.clone(),
        "swaps",
    ));
    tokio::spawn(consume_loop(
        broker.clone(),
        swaps_v2_topic.clone(),
        swaps_v2_tx.clone(),
        "swaps_v2",
    ));

    // HTTP/WS
    let app = Router::new()
        .route("/ws/prices", get(ws_prices))
        .route("/ws/swaps", get(ws_swaps))
        .route("/ws/swaps.v2", get(ws_swaps_v2))
        .route("/depth/:pool", get(http_depth))
        .route("/ws/ping", get(ws_ping))
        .route("/healthz", get(|| async { "ok" }))
        .with_state(Arc::new(state));

    let addr = "0.0.0.0:8081";
    let listener = TcpListener::bind(addr).await?;
    info!("ui-gateway listening on {addr}");
    info!("consuming topic={}", prices_topic);
    info!("consuming topic={}", swaps_topic);
    info!("consuming topic={}", swaps_v2_topic);

    axum::serve(listener, app).await?;
    Ok(())
}

async fn consume_loop(
    broker: String,
    topic: String,
    tx: broadcast::Sender<String>,
    label: &'static str,
) {
    let c: StreamConsumer = ClientConfig::new()
        .set("bootstrap.servers", &broker)
        .set("group.id", format!("ui-{}-group", label))
        .set("enable.auto.commit", "true")
        .set("auto.offset.reset", "latest")
        .create()
        .expect("consumer");
    c.subscribe(&[&topic]).expect("subscribe");

    loop {
        match c.recv().await {
            Ok(m) => {
                if let Some(p) = m.payload_view::<str>().and_then(|r| r.ok()) {
                    let _ = tx.send(p.to_string());
                }
            }
            Err(e) => warn!(?e, "kafka recv error"),
        }
    }
}

async fn ws_prices(
    ws: WebSocketUpgrade,
    State(s): State<Arc<AppState>>,
) -> axum::response::Response {
    ws.on_upgrade(move |mut socket| async move {
        let mut rx = s.prices.subscribe();
        tracing::info!("WS /prices connected");
        loop {
            match rx.recv().await {
                Ok(msg) => {
                    if socket.send(WsMessage::Text(msg)).await.is_err() {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                Err(_) => break,
            }
        }
        tracing::info!("WS /prices disconnected");
    })
}

async fn ws_swaps(
    ws: WebSocketUpgrade,
    State(s): State<Arc<AppState>>,
) -> axum::response::Response {
    ws.on_upgrade(move |mut socket| async move {
        let mut rx = s.swaps.subscribe();
        tracing::info!("WS /swaps connected");
        loop {
            match rx.recv().await {
                Ok(msg) => {
                    if socket.send(WsMessage::Text(msg)).await.is_err() {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                Err(_) => break,
            }
        }
        tracing::info!("WS /swaps disconnected");
    })
}

async fn ws_swaps_v2(
    ws: WebSocketUpgrade,
    State(s): State<Arc<AppState>>,
) -> axum::response::Response {
    ws.on_upgrade(move |mut socket| async move {
        let mut rx = s.swaps_v2.subscribe();
        tracing::info!("WS /swaps.v2 connected");
        loop {
            match rx.recv().await {
                Ok(msg) => {
                    if socket.send(WsMessage::Text(msg)).await.is_err() {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                Err(_) => break,
            }
        }
        tracing::info!("WS /swaps.v2 disconnected");
    })
}

async fn ws_ping(ws: WebSocketUpgrade) -> axum::response::Response {
    ws.on_upgrade(move |mut socket| async move {
        tracing::info!("WS /ping connected");
        // keep-alive pings every 3s so the UI can show liveness reliably
        let mut iv = tokio::time::interval(std::time::Duration::from_secs(3));
        loop {
            iv.tick().await;
            if socket.send(WsMessage::Text("ok".into())).await.is_err() {
                break;
            }
        }
        tracing::info!("WS /ping disconnected");
    })
}

async fn http_depth(
    Path(pool): Path<String>,
    State(s): State<Arc<AppState>>,
) -> impl IntoResponse {
    let key = format!("dex:pool_depth:{}", pool);
    let mut map = serde_json::Map::new();
    match s.redis_client.get_multiplexed_tokio_connection().await {
        Ok(mut conn) => {
            let resp: redis::Value = redis::cmd("HGETALL")
                .arg(&key)
                .query_async(&mut conn)
                .await
                .unwrap_or(redis::Value::Nil);
            if let redis::Value::Array(kvs) = resp {
                let mut it = kvs.into_iter();
                while let (Some(k), Some(v)) = (it.next(), it.next()) {
                    if let (redis::Value::BulkString(kb), v) = (k, v) {
                        let name = String::from_utf8_lossy(&kb).to_string();
                        let val = match v {
                            redis::Value::BulkString(vb) => json!(String::from_utf8_lossy(&vb).to_string()),
                            redis::Value::Int(i) => json!(i),
                            redis::Value::Nil => serde_json::Value::Null,
                            _ => serde_json::Value::Null,
                        };
                        map.insert(name, val);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Err(_) => {}
    }
    Json(json!({
        "pool": pool,
        "key": key,
        "data": map,
    }))
}
```

```rust
use anyhow::Result;
use dotenv::dotenv;
use env_logger;
use log::{info, warn};
use rdkafka::consumer::{Consumer, StreamConsumer};
use rdkafka::{ClientConfig, Message as _};
use redis::AsyncCommands;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use tokio::time::{Duration, Instant};

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, Serialize)]
struct NormalizedSwap {
    slot: u64,
    ts_unix: u64,
    sig: String,
    program_id: String,
    pool_id: String,
    token_in_mint: String,
    token_out_mint: String,
    amount_in_raw: String,
    amount_out_raw: String,
    price: Option<f64>,
    tick: Option<i32>,
    sqrt_price_x64: Option<String>,
    fee_bps: Option<u16>,
    signers: Vec<String>,
    success: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
struct ArbOpportunity {
    pool_id: String,
    token_in: String,
    token_out: String,
    amount_in_ui: f64,
    amount_out_ui: f64,
    price: f64,
    net_pnl_usd: f64,
    timestamp: u64,
}

struct ArbTestMode {
    kafka_consumer: StreamConsumer,
    redis_client: redis::Client,
    opportunities: Vec<ArbOpportunity>,
    total_swaps: u64,
    total_opportunities: u64,
}

impl ArbTestMode {
    async fn new(broker: &str, topic: &str, redis_url: &str) -> Result<Self> {
        let consumer: StreamConsumer = ClientConfig::new()
            .set("bootstrap.servers", broker)
            .set("group.id", "arb-test-mode-group")
            .set("enable.auto.commit", "true")
            .set("auto.offset.reset", "latest")
            .create()?;
        
        consumer.subscribe(&[topic])?;
        
        let redis_client = redis::Client::open(redis_url)?;
        
        Ok(Self {
            kafka_consumer: consumer,
            redis_client,
            opportunities: Vec::new(),
            total_swaps: 0,
            total_opportunities: 0,
        })
    }
    
    async fn run(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
        info!("arb-test-mode: starting arbitrage opportunity detection");
        
        loop {
            match self.kafka_consumer.recv().await {
                Ok(msg) => {
                    if let Some(payload) = msg.payload_view::<str>().and_then(|r| r.ok()) {
                        self.process_swap(payload).await?;
                    }
                }
                Err(e) => {
                    warn!("kafka recv error: {}", e);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    async fn process_swap(&mut self, payload: &str) -> Result<()> {
        let start = Instant::now();
        
        match serde_json::from_str::<NormalizedSwap>(payload) {
            Ok(swap) => {
                self.total_swaps += 1;
                
                // Basic arbitrage detection: look for large price movements
                if let Some(price) = swap.price {
                    let amount_in_ui = self.parse_amount(&swap.amount_in_raw, &swap.token_in_mint).await?;
                    let amount_out_ui = self.parse_amount(&swap.amount_out_raw, &swap.token_out_mint).await?;
                    
                    // Simple opportunity detection: large trades with significant price impact
                    let trade_size_usd = amount_in_ui * price; // Rough USD estimate
                    let price_impact = self.calculate_price_impact(&swap).await?;
                    
                    if trade_size_usd > 1000.0 && price_impact.abs() > 0.01 {
                        let net_pnl = self.estimate_net_pnl(&swap, price_impact).await?;
                        
                        if net_pnl > 0.0 {
                            let opportunity = ArbOpportunity {
                                pool_id: swap.pool_id.clone(),
                                token_in: swap.token_in_mint.clone(),
                                token_out: swap.token_out_mint.clone(),
                                amount_in_ui,
                                amount_out_ui,
                                price,
                                net_pnl_usd: net_pnl,
                                timestamp: swap.ts_unix,
                            };
                            
                            self.opportunities.push(opportunity);
                            self.total_opportunities += 1;
                            
                            info!("WOULD TRADE: pool={} size=${:.2} impact={:.3}% pnl=${:.2}", 
                                swap.pool_id, trade_size_usd, price_impact * 100.0, net_pnl);
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                if self.total_swaps % 100 == 0 {
                    let latency = start.elapsed();
                    info!("processed {} swaps, {} opportunities, latency: {:?}", 
                        self.total_swaps, self.total_opportunities, latency);
                }
            }
            Err(e) => {
                warn!("failed to parse swap: {}", e);
            }
        }
        
        Ok(())
    }
    
    async fn parse_amount(&self, raw_amount: &str, mint: &str) -> Result<f64> {
        // Get mint decimals from Redis cache
        let mut conn = self.redis_client.get_multiplexed_tokio_connection().await?;
        let decimals: Option<u8> = conn.hget(&format!("dex:mint:{}", mint), "decimals").await?;
        
        let decimals = decimals.unwrap_or(9) as u32;
        let raw: u128 = raw_amount.parse()?;
        let amount_ui = raw as f64 / 10f64.powi(decimals as i32);
        
        Ok(amount_ui)
    }
    
    async fn calculate_price_impact(&self, swap: &NormalizedSwap) -> Result<f64> {
        // Get pool depth from Redis
        let mut conn = self.redis_client.get_multiplexed_tokio_connection().await?;
        let depth_key = format!("dex:pool_depth:{}", swap.pool_id);
        
        // For now, use a simple heuristic based on trade size
        let amount_in_ui = self.parse_amount(&swap.amount_in_raw, &swap.token_in_mint).await?;
        let price = swap.price.unwrap_or(1.0);
        let trade_size_usd = amount_in_ui * price;
        
        // Rough impact estimate: larger trades = more impact
        let impact = (trade_size_usd / 10000.0).min(0.1); // Cap at 10%
        
        Ok(impact)
    }
    
    async fn estimate_net_pnl(&self, swap: &NormalizedSwap, price_impact: f64) -> Result<f64> {
        let amount_in_ui = self.parse_amount(&swap.amount_in_raw, &swap.token_in_mint).await?;
        let price = swap.price.unwrap_or(1.0);
        let trade_size_usd = amount_in_ui * price;
        
        // Estimate fees (DEX + Jito tip)
        let dex_fee_bps = swap.fee_bps.unwrap_or(100) as f64 / 10000.0;
        let dex_fee = trade_size_usd * dex_fee_bps;
        let jito_tip = 0.001; // $0.001 tip for now
        
        // Estimate profit from price impact
        let profit = trade_size_usd * price_impact * 0.5; // Assume 50% of impact is captured
        
        let net_pnl = profit - dex_fee - jito_tip;
        
        Ok(net_pnl)
    }
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    dotenv().ok();
    env_logger::init();
    
    let broker = std::env::var("KAFKA_BROKER").unwrap_or_else(|_| "localhost:29092".into());
    let topic = std::env::var("IN_TOPIC").unwrap_or_else(|_| "orca-swaps.parsed.v2".into());

    info!("arb-test-mode: starting with broker={}, topic={}, redis={}", broker, topic, redis_url);
    
    let mut arb_test = ArbTestMode::new(&broker, &topic, &redis_url).await?;
    arb_test.run().await?;
    
    Ok(())
}
```

```rust
}

struct ArbTestMode {
    kafka_consumer: StreamConsumer,

    total_opportunities: u64,
}

impl ArbTestMode {
    async fn new(broker: &str, topic: &str, redis_url: &str) -> Result<Self> {
        let consumer: StreamConsumer = ClientConfig::new()
            .set("bootstrap.servers", broker)
            .set("group.id", "arb-test-mode-group")
            .set("enable.auto.commit", "true")
            .set("auto.offset.reset", "latest")
            .create()?;
        
        consumer.subscribe(&[topic])?;
        
        let redis_client = redis::Client::open(redis_url)?;
        
        Ok(Self {
            kafka_consumer: consumer,
            redis_client,
            opportunities: Vec::new(),
            total_swaps: 0,
            total_opportunities: 0,
        })
    }
    
    async fn run(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
        info!("arb-test-mode: starting arbitrage opportunity detection");
        
        loop {
            let msg = self.kafka_consumer.recv().await?;
            if let Some(payload) = msg.payload_view::<str>().and_then(|r| r.ok()) {
                self.process_swap(payload).await?;
            }
        }
    }
    
    async fn process_swap(&mut self, payload: &str) -> Result<()> {
        let start = Instant::now();
        
        match serde_json::from_str::<NormalizedSwap>(payload) {
            Ok(swap) => {
                self.total_swaps += 1;
                
                // Basic arbitrage detection: look for large price movements
                if let Some(price) = swap.price {
                    let amount_in_ui = self.parse_amount(&swap.amount_in_raw, &swap.token_in_mint).await?;
                    let amount_out_ui = self.parse_amount(&swap.amount_out_raw, &swap.token_out_mint).await?;
                    
                    // Simple opportunity detection: large trades with significant price impact
                    let trade_size_usd = amount_in_ui * price; // Rough USD estimate

                    if trade_size_usd > 1000.0 && price_impact.abs() > 0.01 {

                        if net_pnl > 0.0 {
                            let opportunity = ArbOpportunity {
                                pool_id: swap.pool_id.clone(),
                                token_in: swap.token_in_mint.clone(),
                                token_out: swap.token_out_mint.clone(),
                                amount_in_ui,
                                amount_out_ui,
                                price,
                                net_pnl_usd: net_pnl,
                                timestamp: swap.ts_unix,
                            };
                            
                            self.opportunities.push(opportunity);
                            self.total_opportunities += 1;
                            
                            info!("WOULD TRADE: pool={} size=${:.2} impact={:.3}% pnl=${:.2}", 
                                swap.pool_id, trade_size_usd, price_impact * 100.0, net_pnl);
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                if self.total_swaps % 100 == 0 {
                    let latency = start.elapsed();
                    info!("processed {} swaps, {} opportunities, latency: {:?}", 
                        self.total_swaps, self.total_opportunities, latency);
                }
            }
            Err(e) => {
                warn!("failed to parse swap: {}", e);
            }
        }
        
        Ok(())
    }
    
    async fn parse_amount(&self, raw_amount: &str, mint: &str) -> Result<f64> {
        // Get mint decimals from Redis cache
        let mut conn = self.redis_client.get_multiplexed_tokio_connection().await?;

        let raw: u128 = raw_amount.parse()?;
        let amount_ui = raw as f64 / 10f64.powi(decimals as i32);
        
        Ok(amount_ui)
    }
    
    async fn calculate_price_impact(&self, swap: &NormalizedSwap) -> Result<f64> {
        // For now, use a simple heuristic based on trade size
        let amount_in_ui = self.parse_amount(&swap.amount_in_raw, &swap.token_in_mint).await?;
        let price = swap.price.unwrap_or(1.0);
        let trade_size_usd = amount_in_ui * price;
        
        // Rough impact estimate: larger trades = more impact
        let impact = (trade_size_usd / 10000.0).min(0.1); // Cap at 10%
        
        Ok(impact)
    }
    
    async fn estimate_net_pnl(&self, swap: &NormalizedSwap, price_impact: f64) -> Result<f64> {
        let amount_in_ui = self.parse_amount(&swap.amount_in_raw, &swap.token_in_mint).await?;
        let price = swap.price.unwrap_or(1.0);
        let trade_size_usd = amount_in_ui * price;
        
        // Estimate fees (DEX + Jito tip)
        let dex_fee_bps = swap.fee_bps.unwrap_or(100) as f64 / 10000.0;

        let net_pnl = profit - dex_fee - jito_tip;
```

```rust
use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use bs58;
use chrono::Utc;
use dotenv::dotenv;
use env_logger;
use log::{error, info, warn};
use normalizer_runtime as rt;
use rdkafka::consumer::{CommitMode, Consumer, StreamConsumer};
use rdkafka::producer::{FutureProducer, FutureRecord};
use rdkafka::ClientConfig;
use rdkafka::Message as _;
use redis::{aio::MultiplexedConnection, AsyncCommands};
use serde_json;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::time::Instant;
use yellowstone_grpc_proto::prelude as ypp;
use yellowstone_grpc_proto::prost::Message as _;

// Simple metrics collection
#[derive(Default)]
struct Metrics {
    total_messages: u64,
    successful_decodes: u64,
    decode_errors: u64,
    redis_errors: u64,
    kafka_errors: u64,
    latency_samples: Vec<f64>,
}

impl Metrics {
    fn record_latency(&mut self, latency_ms: f64) {
        self.latency_samples.push(latency_ms);
        // Keep only last 1000 samples for memory efficiency
        if self.latency_samples.len() > 1000 {
            self.latency_samples.remove(0);
        }
    }
    
    fn get_p50_latency(&self) -> Option<f64> {
        if self.latency_samples.is_empty() {
            return None;
        }
        let mut sorted = self.latency_samples.clone();
        sorted.sort_by(|a, b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap());
        let mid = sorted.len() / 2;
        Some(sorted[mid])
    }
    
    fn get_p99_latency(&self) -> Option<f64> {
        if self.latency_samples.is_empty() {
            return None;
        }
        let mut sorted = self.latency_samples.clone();
        sorted.sort_by(|a, b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap());
        let idx = (sorted.len() as f64 * 0.99) as usize;
        Some(sorted[idx.min(sorted.len() - 1)])
    }
    
    fn log_summary(&self) {
        info!("METRICS: total={} decodes={} errors={} redis_errors={} kafka_errors={} p50={:.2}ms p99={:.2}ms", 
            self.total_messages,
            self.successful_decodes,
            self.decode_errors,
            self.redis_errors,
            self.kafka_errors,
            self.get_p50_latency().unwrap_or(0.0),
            self.get_p99_latency().unwrap_or(0.0)
        );
    }
}
```

```rust
    async fn run(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
        info!("arb-test-mode: starting arbitrage opportunity detection");
        
        let mut metrics = Metrics::default();
        
        loop {
            let start = Instant::now();
            match self.kafka_consumer.recv().await {
                Ok(msg) => {
                    if let Some(payload) = msg.payload_view::<str>().and_then(|r| r.ok()) {
                        let payload = payload.to_string(); // Clone the payload to avoid borrow issues
                        match self.process_swap(&payload).await {
                            Ok(_) => {
                                metrics.total_swaps += 1;
                                let latency = start.elapsed();
                                metrics.record_latency(latency.as_micros() as f64 / 1000.0);
                            }
                            Err(e) => {
                                metrics.parse_errors += 1;
                                warn!("failed to process swap: {}", e);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                Err(e) => {
                    metrics.kafka_errors += 1;
                    warn!("kafka recv error: {}", e);
                }
            }
            
            if metrics.total_swaps % 1000 == 0 {
                metrics.log_summary();
            }
        }
    }
```

```rust
use anyhow::Result;
use dotenv::dotenv;
use env_logger;
use log::{info, warn, error};
use rdkafka::consumer::{Consumer, StreamConsumer};
use rdkafka::producer::{FutureProducer, FutureRecord};
use rdkafka::{ClientConfig, Message as _};
use redis::AsyncCommands;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::time::Instant;
use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};

// AI-ready data structures for program discovery
#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct UnknownProgram {
    program_id: String,
    first_seen: DateTime<Utc>,
    last_seen: DateTime<Utc>,
    encounter_count: u64,
    account_types: Vec<String>,
    data_patterns: Vec<DataPattern>,
    potential_dex: bool,
    confidence_score: f64,
    ai_analysis_status: AIAnalysisStatus,
}

#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct DataPattern {
    discriminator: String,
    data_length: usize,
    byte_patterns: Vec<u8>,
    frequency: u64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
enum AIAnalysisStatus {
    Pending,
    InProgress,
    Completed,
    Failed,
}

#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct DiscoveryMetrics {
    total_unknown_programs: u64,
    programs_analyzed: u64,
    potential_dexes_found: u64,
    ai_analysis_time_ms: f64,
}

struct DiscoveryService {
    kafka_consumer: StreamConsumer,
    kafka_producer: FutureProducer,
    redis_client: redis::Client,
    unknown_programs: HashMap<String, UnknownProgram>,
    metrics: DiscoveryMetrics,
}

impl DiscoveryService {
    async fn new() -> Result<Self> {
        dotenv().ok();
        env_logger::init();

        // Kafka consumer for unknown program IDs
        let consumer: StreamConsumer = ClientConfig::new()
            .set("group.id", "discovery-service-group")
            .set("bootstrap.servers", std::env::var("KAFKA_BROKER")?)
            .set("enable.partition.eof", "false")
            .set("session.timeout.ms", "6000")
            .set("enable.auto.commit", "true")
            .create()?;

        // Kafka producer for AI analysis queue
        let producer: FutureProducer = ClientConfig::new()
            .set("bootstrap.servers", std::env::var("KAFKA_BROKER")?)
            .set("message.timeout.ms", "5000")
            .create()?;

        // Redis client for caching and metrics
        let redis_url = std::env::var("REDIS_URL").unwrap_or_else(|_| "redis://localhost:6379/0".to_string());
        let redis_client = redis::Client::open(redis_url)?;

        Ok(Self {
            kafka_consumer,
            kafka_producer,
            redis_client,
            unknown_programs: HashMap::new(),
            metrics: DiscoveryMetrics::default(),
        })
    }

    async fn run(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
        info!("discovery-service: starting program discovery and AI preparation");
        
        // Subscribe to unknown program ID topic
        self.kafka_consumer.subscribe(&[&std::env::var("UNKNOWN_PROGRAMS_TOPIC").unwrap_or_else(|_| "unknown-programs".to_string())])?;

        loop {
            match self.kafka_consumer.recv().await {
                Ok(msg) => {
                    if let Some(payload) = msg.payload_view::<str>().and_then(|r| r.ok()) {
                        match self.process_unknown_program(&payload).await {
                            Ok(_) => {
                                self.metrics.total_unknown_programs += 1;
                                info!("Processed unknown program: {}", payload);
                            }
                            Err(e) => {
                                error!("Failed to process unknown program: {}", e);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                Err(e) => {
                    error!("Kafka consumer error: {}", e);
                }
            }

            // Periodic metrics reporting
            if self.metrics.total_unknown_programs % 100 == 0 {
                self.report_metrics().await?;
            }
        }
    }

    async fn process_unknown_program(&mut self, payload: &str) -> Result<()> {
        let start = Instant::now();
        
        // Parse the unknown program data
        let program_data: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(payload)?;
        
        // Extract program ID and analyze patterns
        if let Some(program_id) = program_data.get("program_id").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
            let entry = self.unknown_programs.entry(program_id.to_string()).or_insert_with(|| UnknownProgram {
                program_id: program_id.to_string(),
                first_seen: Utc::now(),
                last_seen: Utc::now(),
                encounter_count: 0,
                account_types: Vec::new(),
                data_patterns: Vec::new(),
                potential_dex: false,
                confidence_score: 0.0,
                ai_analysis_status: AIAnalysisStatus::Pending,
            });

            entry.last_seen = Utc::now();
            entry.encounter_count += 1;

            // Analyze data patterns for AI learning
            self.analyze_data_patterns(entry, &program_data).await?;

            // Queue for AI analysis if meets criteria
            if self.should_queue_for_ai_analysis(entry) {
                self.queue_for_ai_analysis(entry).await?;
            }

            // Cache in Redis for persistence
            self.cache_program_data(entry).await?;
        }

        let analysis_time = start.elapsed();
        self.metrics.ai_analysis_time_ms = analysis_time.as_millis() as f64;

        Ok(())
    }

    async fn analyze_data_patterns(&mut self, program: &mut UnknownProgram, data: &serde_json::Value) -> Result<()> {
        // Extract account type discriminators
        if let Some(account_data) = data.get("account_data") {
            if let Some(discriminator) = account_data.get("discriminator").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
                if !program.account_types.contains(&discriminator.to_string()) {
                    program.account_types.push(discriminator.to_string());
                }
            }
        }

        // Analyze byte patterns for AI learning
        if let Some(raw_data) = data.get("raw_data").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
            if let Ok(bytes) = bs58::decode(raw_data).into_vec() {
                let pattern = DataPattern {
                    discriminator: data.get("discriminator").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("unknown").to_string(),
                    data_length: bytes.len(),
                    byte_patterns: bytes.iter().take(16).cloned().collect(), // First 16 bytes for pattern recognition
                    frequency: 1,
                };

                // Update existing pattern or add new one
                if let Some(existing) = program.data_patterns.iter_mut().find(|p| p.discriminator == pattern.discriminator) {
                    existing.frequency += 1;
                } else {
                    program.data_patterns.push(pattern);
                }
            }
        }

        Ok(())
    }

    fn should_queue_for_ai_analysis(&self, program: &UnknownProgram) -> bool {
        // Queue programs that show potential DEX characteristics
        program.encounter_count >= 5 && // Seen multiple times
        program.account_types.len() >= 2 && // Multiple account types
        program.data_patterns.iter().any(|p| p.data_length > 100) // Substantial data
    }

    async fn queue_for_ai_analysis(&mut self, program: &UnknownProgram) -> Result<()> {
        program.ai_analysis_status = AIAnalysisStatus::InProgress;
        
        // Send to AI analysis queue
        let ai_payload = serde_json::to_string(&program)?;
        let record = FutureRecord::to("ai-analysis-queue")
            .payload(ai_payload.as_bytes())
            .key(&program.program_id);

        match self.kafka_producer.send(record, std::time::Duration::from_secs(5)).await {
            Ok(_) => {
                info!("Queued program {} for AI analysis", program.program_id);
                self.metrics.programs_analyzed += 1;
            }
            Err((e, _)) => {
                error!("Failed to queue program for AI analysis: {}", e);
                program.ai_analysis_status = AIAnalysisStatus::Failed;
            }
        }

        Ok(())
    }

    async fn cache_program_data(&self, program: &UnknownProgram) -> Result<()> {
        let mut conn = self.redis_client.get_multiplexed_tokio_connection().await?;
        let key = format!("discovery:program:{}", program.program_id);
        
        let program_json = serde_json::to_string(program)?;
        conn.set_ex(&key, program_json, 86400).await?; // Cache for 24 hours

        Ok(())
    }

    async fn report_metrics(&self) -> Result<()> {
        info!("DISCOVERY METRICS: {:?}", self.metrics);
        
        // Cache metrics in Redis
        let mut conn = self.redis_client.get_multiplexed_tokio_connection().await?;
        let metrics_json = serde_json::to_string(&self.metrics)?;
        conn.set_ex("discovery:metrics", metrics_json, 3600).await?; // Cache for 1 hour

        Ok(())
    }
}

impl Default for DiscoveryMetrics {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            total_unknown_programs: 0,
            programs_analyzed: 0,
            potential_dexes_found: 0,
            ai_analysis_time_ms: 0.0,
        }
    }
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    let mut service = DiscoveryService::new().await?;
    service.run().await
}
```

```rust
    let fast_mode = std::env::var("FAST_MODE").ok().as_deref() == Some("1");
    let producer = create_producer(&broker, fast_mode)?;
    
    // Create a set of known program IDs for fast lookup
    let known_program_ids: HashSet<String> = program_ids.iter().cloned().collect();
    
    // Discovery mode: emit unknown program IDs for AI analysis
    let discovery_mode = std::env::var("DISCOVERY_MODE").ok().as_deref() == Some("1");
    let discovery_producer = if discovery_mode {
        Some(create_producer(&broker, true)?)
    } else {
        None
    };

    retry(ExponentialBackoff::default(), move || {
        let producer = producer.clone();
        let discovery_producer = discovery_producer.clone();
        let endpoint = endpoint.clone();
        let x_token = x_token.clone();
        let topic = topic.clone();
        let request = build_request(program_ids.clone());
        let known_program_ids = known_program_ids.clone();

        async move {
            let mut client = GeyserGrpcClient::build_from_shared(endpoint.clone())
                .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?
                .x_token(Some(x_token.clone()))
                .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?
                .connect_timeout(Duration::from_secs(10))
                .timeout(Duration::from_secs(10))
                .tls_config(ClientTlsConfig::new().with_native_roots())
                .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?
                .max_decoding_message_size(1024 * 1024 * 1024)
                .connect()
                .await
                .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;

            let (mut subscribe_tx, mut stream) =
                client.subscribe_with_request(Some(request)).await?;
            info!("stream opened");
            
            let mut unknown_program_count = 0u64;
            
            while let Some(msg) = stream.next().await {
                match msg {
                    Ok(update_msg) => match update_msg.update_oneof {
                        Some(UpdateOneof::Transaction(update)) => {
                            let mut buf = Vec::new();
                            update.encode(&mut buf)?;
                            
                            // Emit to main topic
                            let _ = producer
                                .send(
                                    FutureRecord::<(), _>::to(&topic).payload(&buf),
                                    Duration::from_secs(10),
                                )
                                .await;
                            
                            // Discovery mode: analyze transaction for unknown program IDs
                            if discovery_mode {
                                if let Some(discovery_prod) = &discovery_producer {
                                    if let Some(unknown_programs) = analyze_transaction_for_discovery(&update, &known_program_ids) {
                                        for program_id in unknown_programs {
                                            unknown_program_count += 1;
                                            let discovery_data = json!({
                                                "program_id": program_id,
                                                "timestamp": chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
                                                "transaction_signature": update.signature,
                                                "slot": update.slot,
                                                "encounter_count": unknown_program_count,
                                                "source": "dex-stream-universal"
                                            });
                                            
                                            let discovery_payload = discovery_data.to_string();
                                            let _ = discovery_prod
                                                .send(
                                                    FutureRecord::<(), _>::to("unknown-programs")
                                                        .payload(discovery_payload.as_bytes())
                                                        .key(&program_id),
                                                    Duration::from_secs(5),
                                                )
                                                .await;
                                            
                                            if unknown_program_count % 100 == 0 {
                                                info!("Discovered {} unknown program IDs", unknown_program_count);
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        Some(UpdateOneof::Ping(_)) => {
                            let _ = subscribe_tx
                                .send(SubscribeRequest {
                                    ping: Some(SubscribeRequestPing { id: 1 }),
                                    ..Default::default()
                                })
                                .await;
                        }
                        _ => {}
                    },
                    Err(e) => {
                        error!("stream error: {e:?}");
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            info!("stream closed");
            Ok::<(), anyhow::Error>(())
        }
        .map_err(backoff::Error::transient)
    })
    .await?;

    Ok(())
}
```

```rust
type TxnFilterMap = std::collections::HashMap<String, SubscribeRequestFilterTransactions>;

/// Analyzes a transaction to find unknown program IDs for discovery
fn analyze_transaction_for_discovery(
    update: &yellowstone_grpc_proto::prelude::SubscribeUpdateTransaction,
    known_program_ids: &HashSet<String>,
) -> Option<Vec<String>> {
    let mut unknown_programs = Vec::new();
    
    // Extract program IDs from transaction instructions
    if let Some(transaction) = &update.transaction {
        if let Some(message) = &transaction.message {
            for instruction in &message.instructions {
                if let Some(program_id) = instruction.program_id.as_ref() {
                    let program_id_str = bs58::encode(program_id).into_string();
                    if !known_program_ids.contains(&program_id_str) {
                        unknown_programs.push(program_id_str);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Extract program IDs from account keys
    if let Some(transaction) = &update.transaction {
        if let Some(message) = &transaction.message {
            for account_key in &message.account_keys {
                let account_key_str = bs58::encode(account_key).into_string();
                if !known_program_ids.contains(&account_key_str) {
                    // This might be a program ID, add it for discovery
                    unknown_programs.push(account_key_str);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    if unknown_programs.is_empty() {
        None
    } else {
        // Remove duplicates
        unknown_programs.sort();
        unknown_programs.dedup();
        Some(unknown_programs)
    }
}
```
