/// Analyzes a transaction to find unknown program IDs for discovery
fn analyze_transaction_for_discovery(
    update: &yellowstone_grpc_proto::prelude::SubscribeUpdateTransaction,
    known_program_ids: &HashSet<String>,
) -> Option<Vec<String>> {
    let mut unknown_programs = Vec::new();
    
    // Extract program IDs from transaction instructions
    if let Some(transaction_info) = &update.transaction {
        if let Some(transaction) = &transaction_info.transaction {
            if let Some(message) = &transaction.message {
                for instruction in &message.instructions {
                    let program_id_index = instruction.program_id_index as usize;
                    if let Some(program_id) = message.account_keys.get(program_id_index) {
                        let program_id_str = bs58::encode(program_id).into_string();
                        if !known_program_ids.contains(&program_id_str) {
                            unknown_programs.push(program_id_str);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Extract program IDs from account keys
    if let Some(transaction_info) = &update.transaction {
        if let Some(transaction) = &transaction_info.transaction {
            if let Some(message) = &transaction.message {
                for account_key in &message.account_keys {
                    let account_key_str = bs58::encode(account_key).into_string();
                    if !known_program_ids.contains(&account_key_str) {
                        // This might be a program ID, add it for discovery
                        unknown_programs.push(account_key_str);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    if unknown_programs.is_empty() {
        None
    } else {
        // Remove duplicates
        unknown_programs.sort();
        unknown_programs.dedup();
        Some(unknown_programs)
    }
}

### **5. Fix Discovery Service Compilation Errors**


```rust
use anyhow::Result;
use dotenv::dotenv;
use env_logger;
use log::{info, error};
use rdkafka::consumer::{Consumer, StreamConsumer};
use rdkafka::producer::{FutureProducer, FutureRecord};
use rdkafka::{ClientConfig, Message as _};
use redis::AsyncCommands;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::time::Instant;
use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};

// AI-ready data structures for program discovery
#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct UnknownProgram {
    program_id: String,
    first_seen: DateTime<Utc>,
    last_seen: DateTime<Utc>,
    encounter_count: u64,
    account_types: Vec<String>,
    data_patterns: Vec<DataPattern>,
    potential_dex: bool,
    confidence_score: f64,
    ai_analysis_status: AIAnalysisStatus,
}

#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct DataPattern {
    discriminator: String,
    data_length: usize,
    byte_patterns: Vec<u8>,
    frequency: u64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
enum AIAnalysisStatus {
    Pending,
    InProgress,
    Completed,
    Failed,
}

#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct DiscoveryMetrics {
    total_unknown_programs: u64,
    programs_analyzed: u64,
    potential_dexes_found: u64,
    ai_analysis_time_ms: f64,
}

struct DiscoveryService {
    kafka_consumer: StreamConsumer,
    kafka_producer: FutureProducer,
    redis_client: redis::Client,
    unknown_programs: HashMap<String, UnknownProgram>,
    metrics: DiscoveryMetrics,
}

impl DiscoveryService {
    async fn new() -> Result<Self> {
        dotenv().ok();
        env_logger::init();

        // Kafka consumer for unknown program IDs
        let consumer: StreamConsumer = ClientConfig::new()
            .set("group.id", "discovery-service-group")
            .set("bootstrap.servers", std::env::var("KAFKA_BROKER")?)
            .set("enable.partition.eof", "false")
            .set("session.timeout.ms", "6000")
            .set("enable.auto.commit", "true")
            .create()?;

        // Kafka producer for AI analysis queue
        let producer: FutureProducer = ClientConfig::new()
            .set("bootstrap.servers", std::env::var("KAFKA_BROKER")?)
            .set("message.timeout.ms", "5000")
            .create()?;

        // Redis client for caching and metrics
        let redis_url = std::env::var("REDIS_URL").unwrap_or_else(|_| "redis://localhost:6379/0".to_string());
        let redis_client = redis::Client::open(redis_url)?;

        Ok(Self {
            kafka_consumer: consumer,
            kafka_producer: producer,
            redis_client,
            unknown_programs: HashMap::new(),
            metrics: DiscoveryMetrics::default(),
        })
    }

    async fn run(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
        info!("discovery-service: starting program discovery and AI preparation");
        
        // Subscribe to unknown program ID topic
        self.kafka_consumer.subscribe(&[&std::env::var("UNKNOWN_PROGRAMS_TOPIC").unwrap_or_else(|_| "unknown-programs".to_string())])?;

        loop {
            match self.kafka_consumer.recv().await {
                Ok(msg) => {
                    if let Some(payload) = msg.payload_view::<str>().and_then(|r| r.ok()) {
                        let payload = payload.to_string();
                        match self.process_unknown_program(&payload).await {
                            Ok(_) => {
                                self.metrics.total_unknown_programs += 1;
                                info!("Processed unknown program: {}", payload);
                            }
                            Err(e) => {
                                error!("Failed to process unknown program: {}", e);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                Err(e) => {
                    error!("Kafka consumer error: {}", e);
                }
            }

            // Periodic metrics reporting
            if self.metrics.total_unknown_programs % 100 == 0 {
                self.report_metrics().await?;
            }
        }
    }

    async fn process_unknown_program(&mut self, payload: &str) -> Result<()> {
        let start = Instant::now();
        
        // Parse the unknown program data
        let program_data: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(payload)?;
        
        // Extract program ID and analyze patterns
        if let Some(program_id) = program_data.get("program_id").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
            let entry = self.unknown_programs.entry(program_id.to_string()).or_insert_with(|| UnknownProgram {
                program_id: program_id.to_string(),
                first_seen: Utc::now(),
                last_seen: Utc::now(),
                encounter_count: 0,
                account_types: Vec::new(),
                data_patterns: Vec::new(),
                potential_dex: false,
                confidence_score: 0.0,
                ai_analysis_status: AIAnalysisStatus::Pending,
            });

            entry.last_seen = Utc::now();
            entry.encounter_count += 1;

            // Analyze data patterns for AI learning
            self.analyze_data_patterns(entry, &program_data).await?;

            // Queue for AI analysis if meets criteria
            if self.should_queue_for_ai_analysis(entry) {
                self.queue_for_ai_analysis(entry).await?;
            }

            // Cache in Redis for persistence
            self.cache_program_data(entry).await?;
        }

        let analysis_time = start.elapsed();
        self.metrics.ai_analysis_time_ms = analysis_time.as_millis() as f64;

        Ok(())
    }

    async fn analyze_data_patterns(&mut self, program: &mut UnknownProgram, data: &serde_json::Value) -> Result<()> {
        // Extract account type discriminators
        if let Some(account_data) = data.get("account_data") {
            if let Some(discriminator) = account_data.get("discriminator").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
                if !program.account_types.contains(&discriminator.to_string()) {
                    program.account_types.push(discriminator.to_string());
                }
            }
        }

        // Analyze byte patterns for AI learning
        if let Some(raw_data) = data.get("raw_data").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
            if let Ok(bytes) = bs58::decode(raw_data).into_vec() {
                let pattern = DataPattern {
                    discriminator: data.get("discriminator").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("unknown").to_string(),
                    data_length: bytes.len(),
                    byte_patterns: bytes.iter().take(16).cloned().collect(), // First 16 bytes for pattern recognition
                    frequency: 1,
                };

                // Update existing pattern or add new one
                if let Some(existing) = program.data_patterns.iter_mut().find(|p| p.discriminator == pattern.discriminator) {
                    existing.frequency += 1;
                } else {
                    program.data_patterns.push(pattern);
                }
            }
        }

        Ok(())
    }

    fn should_queue_for_ai_analysis(&self, program: &UnknownProgram) -> bool {
        // Queue programs that show potential DEX characteristics
        program.encounter_count >= 5 && // Seen multiple times
        program.account_types.len() >= 2 && // Multiple account types
        program.data_patterns.iter().any(|p| p.data_length > 100) // Substantial data
    }

    async fn queue_for_ai_analysis(&mut self, program: &mut UnknownProgram) -> Result<()> {
        program.ai_analysis_status = AIAnalysisStatus::InProgress;
        
        // Send to AI analysis queue
        let ai_payload = serde_json::to_string(&program)?;
        let record = FutureRecord::to("ai-analysis-queue")
            .payload(ai_payload.as_bytes())
            .key(&program.program_id);

        match self.kafka_producer.send(record, std::time::Duration::from_secs(5)).await {
            Ok(_) => {
                info!("Queued program {} for AI analysis", program.program_id);
                self.metrics.programs_analyzed += 1;
            }
            Err((e, _)) => {
                error!("Failed to queue program for AI analysis: {}", e);
                program.ai_analysis_status = AIAnalysisStatus::Failed;
            }
        }

        Ok(())
    }

    async fn cache_program_data(&self, program: &UnknownProgram) -> Result<()> {
        let mut conn = self.redis_client.get_multiplexed_tokio_connection().await?;
        let key = format!("discovery:program:{}", program.program_id);
        
        let program_json = serde_json::to_string(program)?;
        conn.set_ex(&key, program_json, 86400).await?; // Cache for 24 hours

        Ok(())
    }

    async fn report_metrics(&self) -> Result<()> {
        info!("DISCOVERY METRICS: {:?}", self.metrics);
        
        // Cache metrics in Redis
        let mut conn = self.redis_client.get_multiplexed_tokio_connection().await?;
        let metrics_json = serde_json::to_string(&self.metrics)?;
        conn.set_ex("discovery:metrics", metrics_json, 3600).await?; // Cache for 1 hour

        Ok(())
    }
}

impl Default for DiscoveryMetrics {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            total_unknown_programs: 0,
            programs_analyzed: 0,
            potential_dexes_found: 0,
            ai_analysis_time_ms: 0.0,
        }
    }
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    let mut service = DiscoveryService::new().await?;
    service.run().await
}

                    account_types: Vec::new(),
                    data_patterns: Vec::new(),
                    potential_dex: false,
                    confidence_score: 0.0,
                    ai_analysis_status: AIAnalysisStatus::Pending,
                });

                entry.last_seen = Utc::now();
                entry.encounter_count += 1;

                // Analyze data patterns for AI learning
                self.analyze_data_patterns(entry, &program_data).await?;

                // Check if should queue for AI analysis
                self.should_queue_for_ai_analysis(entry)
            };

            // Queue for AI analysis if meets criteria
            if should_queue {
                if let Some(entry) = self.unknown_programs.get_mut(program_id) {
                    self.queue_for_ai_analysis(entry).await?;
                }
            }

            // Cache in Redis for persistence
            if let Some(entry) = self.unknown_programs.get(program_id) {
                self.cache_program_data(entry).await?;
            }
        }

        let analysis_time = start.elapsed();
        self.metrics.ai_analysis_time_ms = analysis_time.as_millis() as f64;

        Ok(())
    }
```

Now let me create a utility script for future AI-driven IDL generation and then update the dex-backfill service to use the fresh IDL:


```shellscript
#!/bin/bash

# AI-Driven IDL Generation Utility
# This script generates fresh IDL files from live Solana programs
# Useful for keeping type definitions up-to-date and for AI analysis

set -e

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Default values
CLUSTER="mainnet"
OUTPUT_DIR="idls"
PROGRAM_ID=""

# Function to print colored output
print_status() {
    echo -e "${BLUE}[INFO]${NC} $1"
}

print_success() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[SUCCESS]${NC} $1"
}

print_warning() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARNING]${NC} $1"
}

print_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"
}

# Function to show usage
show_usage() {
    echo "Usage: $0 -p <PROGRAM_ID> [-c <CLUSTER>] [-o <OUTPUT_DIR>]"
    echo ""
    echo "Options:"
    echo "  -p <PROGRAM_ID>    Solana program ID (required)"
    echo "  -c <CLUSTER>       Solana cluster (default: mainnet)"
    echo "  -o <OUTPUT_DIR>    Output directory (default: idls)"
    echo "  -h                 Show this help message"
    echo ""
    echo "Examples:"
    echo "  $0 -p whirLbMiicVdio4qvUfM5KAg6Ct8VwpYzGff3uctyCc"
    echo "  $0 -p whirLbMiicVdio4qvUfM5KAg6Ct8VwpYzGff3uctyCc -c devnet"
    echo "  $0 -p whirLbMiicVdio4qvUfM5KAg6Ct8VwpYzGff3uctyCc -o custom_idls"
}

# Parse command line arguments
while getopts "p:c:o:h" opt; do
    case $opt in
        p) PROGRAM_ID="$OPTARG" ;;
        c) CLUSTER="$OPTARG" ;;
        o) OUTPUT_DIR="$OPT_DIR" ;;
        h) show_usage; exit 0 ;;
        \?) print_error "Invalid option: -$OPTARG"; show_usage; exit 1 ;;
    esac
done

# Check if program ID is provided
if [ -z "$PROGRAM_ID" ]; then
    print_error "Program ID is required"
    show_usage
    exit 1
fi

# Check if Anchor is installed
if ! command -v anchor &> /dev/null; then
    print_error "Anchor CLI is not installed. Please install it first:"
    echo "  cargo install --git https://github.com/coral-xyz/anchor avm --locked --force"
    exit 1
fi

# Create output directory if it doesn't exist
mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR"

# Generate filename based on program ID (first 8 chars)
PROGRAM_SHORT=$(echo "$PROGRAM_ID" | cut -c1-8)
OUTPUT_FILE="$OUTPUT_DIR/${PROGRAM_SHORT}_idl.json"
BACKUP_FILE="$OUTPUT_DIR/${PROGRAM_SHORT}_idl_backup_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).json"

print_status "Generating IDL for program: $PROGRAM_ID"
print_status "Cluster: $CLUSTER"
print_status "Output: $OUTPUT_FILE"

# Backup existing file if it exists
if [ -f "$OUTPUT_FILE" ]; then
    print_status "Backing up existing IDL to: $BACKUP_FILE"
    cp "$OUTPUT_FILE" "$BACKUP_FILE"
fi

# Generate fresh IDL using Anchor
print_status "Fetching IDL from live program..."
if anchor idl fetch "$PROGRAM_ID" --provider.cluster "$CLUSTER" -o "$OUTPUT_FILE"; then
    print_success "IDL generated successfully!"
    
    # Show file info
    FILE_SIZE=$(wc -c < "$OUTPUT_FILE")
    LINE_COUNT=$(wc -l < "$OUTPUT_FILE")
    print_status "File size: $FILE_SIZE bytes"
    print_status "Line count: $LINE_COUNT"
    
    # Validate JSON
    if jq empty "$OUTPUT_FILE" 2>/dev/null; then
        print_success "IDL is valid JSON"
    else
        print_warning "IDL may not be valid JSON - please verify"
    fi
    
    # Show first few lines for verification
    print_status "First few lines of generated IDL:"
    head -10 "$OUTPUT_FILE"
    
else
    print_error "Failed to generate IDL"
    exit 1
fi

print_success "IDL generation complete! File saved to: $OUTPUT_FILE"
print_status "You can now use this IDL in your Rust code for up-to-date type definitions."
```

```rust
use anyhow::{bail, Context, Result};
use chrono::Utc;
use clap::Parser;
use dotenv::dotenv;
use env_logger::Env;
use log::{error, info, warn};
use redis::{aio::MultiplexedConnection, AsyncCommands};
use reqwest::Client;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::time::Duration;

#[derive(Debug, Parser)]
#[command(author, version, about = "Shyft Pool Depth Service - Get pool depth data directly from Shyft APIs")]
struct Args {
    /// Shyft API key
    #[arg(long, env = "SHYFT_API_KEY")]
    shyft_api_key: String,

    /// Network: devnet | mainnet-beta
    #[arg(long, env = "SHYFT_NETWORK", default_value = "mainnet-beta")]
    network: String,

    /// Redis URL
    #[arg(long, env = "REDIS_URL", default_value = "redis://127.0.0.1:6379/0")]
    redis_url: String,

    /// Update interval in seconds
    #[arg(long, default_value_t = 30)]
    update_interval: u64,

    /// Max pools to process per update
    #[arg(long, default_value_t = 100)]
    max_pools: usize,

    /// Dry run (don't write to Redis)
    #[arg(long, action = clap::ArgAction::SetTrue)]
    dry_run: bool,
}

// ---------- Shyft API Models ----------
#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct GraphQLResponse<T> {
    data: T,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct WhirlpoolRows {
    #[serde(rename = "ORCA_WHIRLPOOLS_whirlpool")]
    rows: Vec<PoolRow>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, Clone)]
struct PoolRow {
    pubkey: String,
    tokenMintA: String,
    tokenMintB: String,
    feeRate: i64,
    tickCurrentIndex: i32,
    sqrtPrice: String,
    liquidity: String,
    tickSpacing: i32,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct ShyftTokenInfoResp {
    success: bool,
    result: Option<ShyftTokenInfo>,
    message: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, Clone)]
struct ShyftTokenInfo {
    address: String,
    decimals: u8,
    #[serde(default)]
    symbol: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    name: Option<String>,
}

// ---------- Pool Depth Models ----------
#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Clone)]
struct PoolDepth {
    pool: String,
    mint_a: String,
    mint_b: String,
    decimals_a: u8,
    decimals_b: u8,
    fee_bps: i64,
    tick_current: i32,
    sqrt_price: String,
    liquidity: String,
    tick_spacing: i32,
    depth_levels: Vec<DepthLevel>,
    updated_at: i64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Clone)]
struct DepthLevel {
    tick: i32,
    liquidity_net: i64,
    price: f64,
    size_usd: f64,
}

// ---------- Shyft API Client ----------
struct ShyftClient {
    client: Client,
    api_key: String,
    network: String,
}

impl ShyftClient {
    fn new(api_key: String, network: String) -> Self {
        let client = Client::builder()
            .timeout(Duration::from_secs(30))
            .build()
            .expect("Failed to build HTTP client");
        
        Self {
            client,
            api_key,
            network,
        }
    }

    fn graphql_endpoint(&self) -> String {
        format!("https://programs.shyft.to/v0/graphql/?api_key={}&network={}", 
                self.api_key, self.network)
    }

    fn token_info_url(&self, mint: &str) -> String {
        format!("https://api.shyft.to/sol/v1/token/get_info?network={}&token_address={}", 
                self.network, mint)
    }

    async fn get_pools(&self, limit: usize, offset: usize) -> Result<Vec<PoolRow>> {
        let query = format!(
            r#"
            query Pools($limit: Int!, $offset: Int!) {{
              ORCA_WHIRLPOOLS_whirlpool(
                where: {{ liquidity: {{ _gt: "0" }} }}
                order_by: {{ liquidity: desc }}
                limit: $limit
                offset: $offset
              ) {{
                pubkey
                tokenMintA
                tokenMintB
                feeRate
                tickCurrentIndex
                sqrtPrice
                liquidity
                tickSpacing
              }}
            }}
            "#
        );

        let body = serde_json::json!({
            "query": query,
            "variables": {
                "limit": limit,
                "offset": offset
            }
        });

        let response = self.client
            .post(self.graphql_endpoint())
            .json(&body)
            .send()
            .await
            .context("GraphQL request failed")?
            .error_for_status()
            .context("GraphQL non-200 response")?;

        let response_text = response.text().await?;
        let graphql_response: GraphQLResponse<WhirlpoolRows> = serde_json::from_str(&response_text)
            .context("Failed to parse GraphQL response")?;

        Ok(graphql_response.data.rows)
    }

    async fn get_token_info(&self, mint: &str) -> Result<ShyftTokenInfo> {
        let url = self.token_info_url(mint);
        let resp = self.client
            .get(&url)
            .header("x-api-key", &self.api_key)
            .send()
            .await
            .context("Token info request failed")?
            .error_for_status()
            .context("Token info non-200 response")?;

        let info: ShyftTokenInfoResp = resp.json().await?;
        info.result.ok_or_else(|| {
            anyhow::anyhow!("No token info for {}: {:?}", mint, info.message)
        })
    }

    async fn calculate_pool_depth(&self, pool: &PoolRow) -> Result<PoolDepth> {
        // Get token metadata
        let token_a = self.get_token_info(&pool.tokenMintA).await?;
        let token_b = self.get_token_info(&pool.tokenMintB).await?;

        // Calculate depth levels around current tick
        let current_tick = pool.tickCurrentIndex;
        let tick_spacing = pool.tickSpacing;
        let mut depth_levels = Vec::new();

        // Generate depth levels around current tick
        for tick_offset in -10..=10 {
            let tick = current_tick + (tick_offset * tick_spacing);
            let liquidity_net = if tick_offset == 0 {
                pool.liquidity.parse::<i64>().unwrap_or(0)
            } else {
                // Simulate liquidity distribution (in real implementation, this would come from TickArray data)
                (pool.liquidity.parse::<i64>().unwrap_or(0) / 20).max(0)
            };

            // Calculate price from tick (simplified)
            let price = self.tick_to_price(tick, &token_a, &token_b);
            let size_usd = self.liquidity_to_usd_size(liquidity_net, price, &token_a, &token_b);

            depth_levels.push(DepthLevel {
                tick,
                liquidity_net,
                price,
                size_usd,
            });
        }

        Ok(PoolDepth {
            pool: pool.pubkey.clone(),
            mint_a: pool.tokenMintA.clone(),
            mint_b: pool.tokenMintB.clone(),
            decimals_a: token_a.decimals,
            decimals_b: token_b.decimals,
            fee_bps: pool.feeRate,
            tick_current: pool.tickCurrentIndex,
            sqrt_price: pool.sqrtPrice.clone(),
            liquidity: pool.liquidity.clone(),
            tick_spacing: pool.tickSpacing,
            depth_levels,
            updated_at: Utc::now().timestamp(),
        })
    }

    fn tick_to_price(&self, tick: i32, token_a: &ShyftTokenInfo, token_b: &ShyftTokenInfo) -> f64 {
        // Simplified tick to price conversion
        // In reality, this would use the proper Whirlpool formula
        let tick_ratio = (tick as f64 / 1000.0).exp();
        tick_ratio * (10.0_f64.powi((token_b.decimals - token_a.decimals) as i32))
    }

    fn liquidity_to_usd_size(&self, liquidity_net: i64, price: f64, token_a: &ShyftTokenInfo, token_b: &ShyftTokenInfo) -> f64 {
        // Simplified liquidity to USD size conversion
        // In reality, this would use proper liquidity math
        let liquidity_f64 = liquidity_net as f64;
        let base_size = liquidity_f64 / (10.0_f64.powi(token_a.decimals as i32));
        base_size * price
    }
}

// ---------- Redis Operations ----------
async fn write_pool_depth_to_redis(
    redis: &mut MultiplexedConnection,
    depth: &PoolDepth,
) -> Result<()> {
    let pool_key = format!("dex:pool_depth:{}", depth.pool);
    
    // Write pool depth data
    let depth_json = serde_json::to_string(depth)?;
    redis.set_ex(&pool_key, depth_json, 300).await?; // 5 minute TTL

    // Write summary data for quick access
    let summary_key = format!("dex:pool_summary:{}", depth.pool);
    let summary = serde_json::json!({
        "pool": depth.pool,
        "mint_a": depth.mint_a,
        "mint_b": depth.mint_b,
        "fee_bps": depth.fee_bps,
        "tick_current": depth.tick_current,
        "sqrt_price": depth.sqrt_price,
        "liquidity": depth.liquidity,
        "depth_levels_count": depth.depth_levels.len(),
        "updated_at": depth.updated_at,
    });
    
    redis.set_ex(&summary_key, summary.to_string(), 300).await?;

    info!("Updated pool depth for {} with {} depth levels", depth.pool, depth.depth_levels.len());
    Ok(())
}

// ---------- Main Service Loop ----------
async fn run_service(args: Args) -> Result<()> {
    let shyft_client = ShyftClient::new(args.shyft_api_key, args.network);
    
    let redis_client = redis::Client::open(args.redis_url)?;
    let mut redis_conn = redis_client.get_multiplexed_async_connection().await?;

    info!("Starting Shyft Pool Depth Service");
    info!("Update interval: {} seconds", args.update_interval);
    info!("Max pools per update: {}", args.max_pools);

    let mut offset = 0;
    
    loop {
        info!("Fetching pools (offset: {})", offset);
        
        match shyft_client.get_pools(args.max_pools, offset).await {
            Ok(pools) => {
                if pools.is_empty() {
                    info!("No more pools, resetting offset");
                    offset = 0;
                    continue;
                }

                info!("Processing {} pools", pools.len());
                
                for pool in pools {
                    match shyft_client.calculate_pool_depth(&pool).await {
                        Ok(depth) => {
                            if !args.dry_run {
                                if let Err(e) = write_pool_depth_to_redis(&mut redis_conn, &depth).await {
                                    error!("Failed to write pool depth to Redis: {}", e);
                                }
                            } else {
                                info!("[DRY RUN] Would write pool depth for {}", pool.pubkey);
                            }
                        }
                        Err(e) => {
                            error!("Failed to calculate depth for pool {}: {}", pool.pubkey, e);
                        }
                    }
                }

                offset += pools.len();
            }
            Err(e) => {
                error!("Failed to fetch pools: {}", e);
            }
        }

        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(args.update_interval)).await;
    }
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    dotenv().ok();
    env_logger::init_from_env(Env::default().default_filter_or("info"));

    let args = Args::parse();
    
    if args.shyft_api_key.is_empty() {
        bail!("SHYFT_API_KEY is required");
    }

    run_service(args).await
}
```

  - **No decoding overhead** - data is pre-processed
  - **Human-readable format** - ready for frontend display
  - **Structured information** - organized by transaction type
  - **Comprehensive coverage** - supports major transaction types

### **Redis Cache Schema Design:**
```rust
// Pool Data Cache
"dex:pool:{pool_address}" -> {
    "liquidity": {...},
    "tokens": {...},
    "fees": {...},
    "last_updated": timestamp,
    "source": "shyft_api"
}

// Token Pair Cache
"dex:token_pair:{token_a}:{token_b}" -> {
    "pools": [pool_addresses],
    "best_prices": {...},
    "liquidity_summary": {...},
    "last_updated": timestamp
}

// Transaction Cache
"dex:tx:{signature}" -> {
    "parsed_data": {...},
    "pool_impact": {...},
    "timestamp": timestamp
}
```

```
Geyser Stream (1ms) → Redis Cache (1ms) → Decision Engine (5ms) → Trade Execution (3ms)

Real-time updates    Pre-validated data    Combined logic      Execute trades
     ↓                      ↓                    ↓                    ↓

## Cache Schema
```rust

- **Warm Data**: 30-60 seconds (moderately accessed)

- Pre-fetch for anticipated trading pairs
- Continuous updates without blocking hot path
- Fallback to geyser data if cache miss

- Pre-fetch for anticipated trading pairs
- Continuous updates without blocking hot path
- Fallback to geyser data if cache miss

## Performance Targets
- **Cache Hit Rate**: >95% for hot data
- **Cache Access Time**: <1ms
- **Update Frequency**: Real-time for critical data
- **Fallback Latency**: <5ms to geyser data
```

```bash
#!/bin/bash

# Shyft API Testing Script
# Created: 2024-08-19 15:30 UTC
# Purpose: Test Shyft APIs for hybrid strategy implementation
# API Key: fWrVh_mDygK358FC (CONFIDENTIAL)

set -e

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Configuration
API_KEY="fWrVh_mDygK358FC"
NETWORK="mainnet-beta"
SOL_TOKEN="So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112"
TEST_POOL="3nMFwZXwY1s1M5s8vYAHqd4wGs4iSxXE4LRoUMMYqEgF"
TEST_WALLET="9B5XszUGdMaxCZ7uSQhPzdks5ZQSmWxrmzCSvtJ6Ns6g"

# Function to print colored output
print_status() {
    echo -e "${BLUE}[INFO]${NC} $1"
}

print_success() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[SUCCESS]${NC} $1"
}

print_warning() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARNING]${NC} $1"
}

print_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"
}

# Function to test API response time
test_api_response_time() {
    local api_name="$1"
    local url="$2"
    
    print_status "Testing $api_name..."
    echo "URL: $url"
    
    # Measure response time
    start_time=$(date +%s%N)
    response=$(curl -s -H "x-api-key: $API_KEY" "$url")
    end_time=$(date +%s%N)
    
    # Calculate response time in milliseconds
    response_time=$(( (end_time - start_time) / 1000000 ))
    
    echo "Response Time: ${response_time}ms"
    
    # Check if response is valid JSON
    if echo "$response" | jq . >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        print_success "Valid JSON response received"
        echo "Response Preview:"
        echo "$response" | jq . | head -20
    else
        print_error "Invalid JSON response"
        echo "Raw Response:"
        echo "$response"
    fi
    
    echo "----------------------------------------"
}

# Main testing function
main() {
    print_status "Starting Shyft API Testing Suite"
    print_status "API Key: ${API_KEY:0:8}..."
    print_status "Network: $NETWORK"
    echo ""
    
    # Test 1: DeFi Pool Discovery API - SOL Token
    test_api_response_time "DeFi Pool Discovery API (SOL)" \
        "https://defi.shyft.to/v0/pools/get_all_pools_for_token?token=$SOL_TOKEN"
    
    # Test 2: Liquidity Details API - Known Pool
    test_api_response_time "Liquidity Details API" \
        "https://defi.shyft.to/v0/pools/get_liquidity_details?address=$TEST_POOL"
    
    # Test 3: Wallet Balance API - Test Wallet
    test_api_response_time "Wallet Balance API" \
        "https://api.shyft.to/sol/v1/wallet/balance?network=$NETWORK&wallet_address=$TEST_WALLET"
    
    # Test 4: Transaction History API
    test_api_response_time "Transaction History API" \
        "https://api.shyft.to/sol/v1/transaction/history?network=$NETWORK&account=$TEST_WALLET&tx_num=5"
    
    # Test 5: Token Balance API
    test_api_response_time "Token Balance API" \
        "https://api.shyft.to/sol/v1/wallet/token_balance?network=$NETWORK&wallet_address=$TEST_WALLET&token_address=$SOL_TOKEN"
    
    print_status "All API tests completed!"
    print_status "Check the results above for response times and data quality"
}

# Run the main function
main "$@"
```

cat > docs/strategy/redis-cache-design.md << 'EOF'
# Redis Cache Architecture

**Last Updated**: 2024-08-19 15:30 UTC  
**Version**: 1.0.0  
**Changes**: Initial cache architecture document creation

## Cache Schema
```rust
// Pool Data Cache
"dex:pool:{pool_address}" -> {
    "liquidity": {...},
    "tokens": {...},
    "fees": {...},
    "last_updated": timestamp,
    "source": "shyft_api"
}

// Token Pair Cache
"dex:token_pair:{token_a}:{token_b}" -> {
    "pools": [pool_addresses],
    "best_prices": {...},
    "liquidity_summary": {...},
    "last_updated": timestamp
}

// Transaction Cache
"dex:tx:{signature}" -> {
    "parsed_data": {...},
    "pool_impact": {...},
    "timestamp": timestamp
}
```

## TTL Strategies
- **Hot Data**: 1-5 seconds (frequently accessed)
- **Warm Data**: 30-60 seconds (moderately accessed)
- **Cold Data**: 5-15 minutes (rarely accessed)

## Cache Warming
- Background population via Shyft APIs
- Pre-fetch for anticipated trading pairs
- Continuous updates without blocking hot path
- Fallback to geyser data if cache miss

## Performance Targets
- **Cache Hit Rate**: >95% for hot data
- **Cache Access Time**: <1ms
- **Update Frequency**: Real-time for critical data
- **Fallback Latency**: <5ms to geyser data
EOF

# Redis Cache Architecture

**Last Updated**: 2024-08-19 15:30 UTC  
**Version**: 1.0.0  
**Changes**: Initial cache architecture document creation

## Cache Schema
```rust
// Pool Data Cache
"dex:pool:{pool_address}" -> {
    "liquidity": {...},
    "tokens": {...},
    "fees": {...},
    "last_updated": timestamp,
    "source": "shyft_api"
}

// Token Pair Cache
"dex:token_pair:{token_a}:{token_b}" -> {
    "pools": [pool_addresses],
    "best_prices": {...},
    "liquidity_summary": {...},
    "last_updated": timestamp
}

// Transaction Cache
"dex:tx:{signature}" -> {
    "parsed_data": {...},
    "pool_impact": {...},
    "timestamp": timestamp
}
```

## TTL Strategies
- **Hot Data**: 1-5 seconds (frequently accessed)
- **Warm Data**: 30-60 seconds (moderately accessed)
- **Cold Data**: 5-15 minutes (rarely accessed)

## Cache Warming
- Background population via Shyft APIs
- Pre-fetch for anticipated trading pairs
- Continuous updates without blocking hot path
- Fallback to geyser data if cache miss

## Performance Targets
- **Cache Hit Rate**: >95% for hot data
- **Cache Access Time**: <1ms
- **Update Frequency**: Real-time for critical data
- **Fallback Latency**: <5ms to geyser data
EOF

#!/bin/bash

# Shyft API Testing Script
# Created: 2024-08-19 15:30 UTC
# Purpose: Test Shyft APIs for hybrid strategy implementation
# API Key: fWrVh_mDygK358FC (CONFIDENTIAL)

set -e

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Configuration
API_KEY="fWrVh_mDygK358FC"
NETWORK="mainnet-beta"
SOL_TOKEN="So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112"
TEST_POOL="3nMFwZXwY1s1M5s8vYAHqd4wGs4iSxXE4LRoUMMYqEgF"
TEST_WALLET="9B5XszUGdMaxCZ7uSQhPzdks5ZQSmWxrmzCSvtJ6Ns6g"

# Function to print colored output
print_status() {
    echo -e "${BLUE}[INFO]${NC} $1"
}

print_success() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[SUCCESS]${NC} $1"
}

print_warning() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARNING]${NC} $1"
}

print_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"
}

# Function to test API response time
test_api_response_time() {
    local api_name="$1"
    local url="$2"
    
    print_status "Testing $api_name..."
    echo "URL: $url"
    
    # Measure response time
    start_time=$(date +%s%N)
    response=$(curl -s -H "x-api-key: $API_KEY" "$url")
    end_time=$(date +%s%N)
    
    # Calculate response time in milliseconds
    response_time=$(( (end_time - start_time) / 1000000 ))
    
    echo "Response Time: ${response_time}ms"
    
    # Check if response is valid JSON
    if echo "$response" | jq . >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        print_success "Valid JSON response received"
        echo "Response Preview:"
        echo "$response" | jq . | head -20
    else
        print_error "Invalid JSON response"
        echo "Raw Response:"
        echo "$response"
    fi
    
    echo "----------------------------------------"
}

# Main testing function
main() {
    print_status "Starting Shyft API Testing Suite"
    print_status "API Key: ${API_KEY:0:8}..."
    print_status "Network: $NETWORK"
    echo ""
    
    # Test 1: DeFi Pool Discovery API - SOL Token
    test_api_response_time "DeFi Pool Discovery API (SOL)" \
        "https://defi.shyft.to/v0/pools/get_all_pools_for_token?token=$SOL_TOKEN"
    
    # Test 2: Liquidity Details API - Known Pool
    test_api_response_time "Liquidity Details API" \
        "https://defi.shyft.to/v0/pools/get_liquidity_details?address=$TEST_POOL"
    
    # Test 3: Wallet Balance API - Test Wallet
    test_api_response_time "Wallet Balance API" \
        "https://api.shyft.to/sol/v1/wallet/balance?network=$NETWORK&wallet_address=$TEST_WALLET"
    
    # Test 4: Transaction History API
    test_api_response_time "Transaction History API" \
        "https://api.shyft.to/sol/v1/transaction/history?network=$NETWORK&account=$TEST_WALLET&tx_num=5"
    
    # Test 5: Token Balance API
    test_api_response_time "Token Balance API" \
        "https://api.shyft.to/sol/v1/wallet/token_balance?network=$NETWORK&wallet_address=$TEST_WALLET&token_address=$SOL_TOKEN"
    
    print_status "All API tests completed!"
    print_status "Check the results above for response times and data quality"
}

# Run the main function
main "$@"
EOF

# Make script executable
chmod +x scripts/test-shyft-apis.sh

test_api_response_time() {
    local api_name="$1"
    local url="$2"
    
    print_status "Testing $api_name..."
    echo "URL: $url"
    
    # Measure response time
    start_time=$(date +%s%N)
    response=$(curl -s -H "x-api-key: $API_KEY" "$url")
    end_time=$(date +%s%N)
    
    # Calculate response time in milliseconds
    response_time=$(( (end_time - start_time) / 1000000 ))
    
    echo "Response Time: ${response_time}ms"
    
    # Check if response is valid JSON
    if echo "$response" | jq . >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        print_success "Valid JSON response received"
        echo "Response Preview:"
        echo "$response" | jq . | head -20
    else
        print_error "Invalid JSON response"
        echo "Raw Response:"
        echo "$response"
    fi
    
    echo "----------------------------------------"
}

# Main testing function
main() {
    print_status "Starting Shyft API Testing Suite"
    print_status "API Key: ${API_KEY:0:8}..."
    print_status "Network: $NETWORK"
    echo ""
    
    # Test 1: DeFi Pool Discovery API - SOL Token
    test_api_response_time "DeFi Pool Discovery API (SOL)" \
        "https://defi.shyft.to/v0/pools/get_all_pools_for_token?token=$SOL_TOKEN"
    
    # Test 2: Liquidity Details API - Known Pool
    test_api_response_time "Liquidity Details API" \
        "https://defi.shyft.to/v0/pools/get_liquidity_details?address=$TEST_POOL"
    
    # Test 3: Wallet Balance API - Test Wallet
    test_api_response_time "Wallet Balance API" \
        "https://api.shyft.to/sol/v1/wallet/balance?network=$NETWORK&wallet_address=$TEST_WALLET"
    
    # Test 4: Transaction History API
    test_api_response_time "Transaction History API" \
        "https://api.shyft.to/sol/v1/transaction/history?network=$NETWORK&account=$TEST_WALLET&tx_num=5"
    
    # Test 5: Token Balance API
    test_api_response_time "Token Balance API" \
        "https://api.shyft.to/sol/v1/wallet/token_balance?network=$NETWORK&wallet_address=$TEST_WALLET&token_address=$SOL_TOKEN"
    
    print_status "All API tests completed!"
    print_status "Check the results above for response times and data quality"
}

# Run the main function
main "$@"
EOF

chmod +x scripts/test-shyft-apis.sh
